articles.title: Domination condition fails on the triangle
articles.statement: The domination condition fails for the single current through all edges of the triangle.

articles.title: Edges of the triangle on three vertices
articles.statement: The three edges `{0, 1}`, `{1, 2}`, `{0, 2}` of the triangle on `Fin 3`.

articles.title: Current connecting all three site pairs
articles.statement: The current `m` connects each of the pairs `{x, y}`, `{o, y}`, `{o, x}`.

articles.title: GHS gap of a sourced current
articles.statement: The GHS gap `mass(A) - mass(A ∆ {x, y}) - mass(A ∆ {o, y}) - mass(A ∆ {o, x})`.

articles.title: Mass of sub-currents with a given source set
articles.statement: The total weight `∑ φ(K)` of the sub-currents `K ⊆ m` with source set `S`.

articles.title: Current connecting none of the three site pairs
articles.statement: The current `m` connects none of the pairs `{x, y}`, `{o, y}`, `{o, x}`.

articles.title: Three-site backbone factor
articles.statement:
The three-site backbone factor: `1`, `0` or `-2` according to how many of the pairs `{x, y},
{o, y}, {o, x}` the current connects.

articles.title: Backbone cluster of a site in a current
articles.statement: The cluster of `o` in the current `m`: the sites connected to `o` by edges of `m`.

articles.title: Conditioned domination condition over a set of currents
articles.statement:
The domination condition `2 · mass(all connected) ≤ mass(none connected)`, summed over
currents in `M`.

articles.title: Griffiths' second inequality for two distinct spins
articles.statement: Griffiths' second inequality for two distinct spins: `⟨σ_x⟩⟨σ_y⟩ ≤ ⟨σ_x σ_y⟩` for `β, h ≥ 0`.

articles.title: Field derivative of the magnetization as a sum of covariances
articles.statement:
The field derivative of the magnetization is `β` times the sum of the two-point covariances
`⟨σ_o σ_x⟩ - ⟨σ_o⟩⟨σ_x⟩` (the finite-volume susceptibility).

articles.title: Three-replica variable $d_w$
articles.statement: The three-replica variable `d_w = σ_w(b) + σ_w(c) - 2σ_w(a)`.

articles.title: Third Ursell function of the finite Ising model
articles.statement:
The third Ursell function (joint cumulant) `u₃(o, x, y) = ⟨σ_oσ_xσ_y⟩ - ⟨σ_o⟩⟨σ_xσ_y⟩ -
⟨σ_oσ_x⟩⟨σ_y⟩ - ⟨σ_oσ_y⟩⟨σ_x⟩ + 2⟨σ_o⟩⟨σ_x⟩⟨σ_y⟩` of the finite Ising model at `(β, h)`.

articles.title: Global spin flip
articles.statement: The global spin flip `σ ↦ -σ`.

articles.title: Global spin flip as an involutive equivalence
articles.statement: The global spin flip as an involutive equivalence of configuration space.

articles.title: Field derivative of the two-point covariance
articles.statement:
The field derivative of the two-point covariance `Cov(σ_o, σ_x)`, written as a combination of
Gibbs expectations involving the total spin.

articles.title: Lebowitz four-point combination
articles.statement:
Lebowitz's four-point combination `⟨σ_oσ_xσ_y⟩ - ⟨σ_oσ_x⟩⟨σ_y⟩ - ⟨σ_oσ_y⟩⟨σ_x⟩ - ⟨σ_o⟩⟨σ_xσ_y⟩`,
which differs from the Ursell function `u₃` by `2⟨σ_o⟩⟨σ_x⟩⟨σ_y⟩`.

articles.title: GHS gap on an edge equals the third Ursell function
articles.statement:
On an edge `{x, y}`, the gap `cov3sym - ghsBoundSym` between the three-point covariance and the
GHS bound equals `u₃(o, x, y)`.

articles.title: Griffiths–Hurst–Sherman inequality
articles.statement:
For the ferromagnetic Ising model on a finite graph
with `β ≥ 0` and `h ≥ 0`, the third Ursell function `u₃(o, x, y)` is nonpositive for every
site `o` and every edge `{x, y}`.

R. B. Griffiths, C. A. Hurst and S. Sherman, *Concavity of magnetization of an Ising
ferromagnet in a positive external field*, J. Math. Phys. 11 (1970); proof of J. L. Lebowitz,
*GHS and other inequalities*, Comm. Math. Phys. 35 (1974).

articles.title: Set of sites where an agreement configuration is true
articles.statement: The set of sites where `q` is `true`.

articles.title: FKG lattice condition for the agreement law when $\beta, h \ge 0$
articles.statement: The law of the agreement configuration satisfies the FKG lattice condition.

articles.title: Law of the agreement configuration of two replicas
articles.statement: The probability that two independent replicas have agreement configuration `q`.

articles.title: Agreement configuration of two spin configurations
articles.statement: The agreement configuration of `a` and `b`: `true` exactly at the sites where they agree.

articles.title: Conditional two-replica expectation given the agreement
articles.statement: The conditional two-replica expectation of `F` given the agreement configuration `q`.

articles.title: Total two-replica weight of an agreement fibre
articles.statement: The total two-replica weight of the fibre over `q`.

articles.title: Fibre weight integrated against an observable
articles.statement: The two-replica weight of the fibre over `q`, integrated against `F`.

articles.title: Conditional expectation of $t_y$ given the agreement
articles.statement: The conditional expectation `E[t_y | q]` of the rotated variable.

articles.title: Conditional expectation of $u_o u_x$ given the agreement
articles.statement: The conditional expectation `E[u_o u_x | q]` of the rotated variables.

articles.title: Two-replica weight in an agreement fibre
articles.statement: The two-replica weight of `a` and its mate in the fibre over the agreement configuration `q`.

articles.title: Mate of a configuration over an agreement pattern
articles.statement:
The configuration that agrees with `a` where `q` is `true` and disagrees where `q` is
`false`.

articles.title: Field weight of the disagreement set
articles.statement: The field weight `exp (2βh ∑_{v ∉ q} σ_v(a))` of the disagreement set.

articles.title: Splitting a configuration along the agreement set
articles.statement: Configurations split into their restrictions to the agreement and disagreement sets of `q`.

articles.title: Completion of agreement-set spins to a full configuration
articles.statement: The configuration with given spins on the agreement set of `q` and `false` elsewhere.

articles.title: Expectation with field on the agreement set
articles.statement: The expectation with field on the subgraph induced by the agreement set of `q`.

articles.title: Agreement-set Boltzmann weight with doubled couplings and field
articles.statement:
The Boltzmann weight, with couplings `2β` and field `2βh`, of `a` on the subgraph induced by
the agreement set of `q`.

articles.title: Completion of disagreement-set spins to a full configuration
articles.statement: The configuration with given spins on the disagreement set of `q` and `false` elsewhere.

articles.title: Zero-field expectation on the disagreement set
articles.statement: The zero-field expectation on the subgraph induced by the disagreement set of `q`.

articles.title: Zero-field disagreement-set Boltzmann weight
articles.statement:
The zero-field Boltzmann weight, with couplings `2β`, of `a` on the subgraph induced by the
disagreement set of `q`.

articles.title: Change of variables from replica pairs to agreement and first copy
articles.statement: The change of variables `(a, b) ↦ (agreement of a and b, a)` on pairs of configurations.

articles.title: GHS concavity of the magnetization in the field
articles.statement:
GHS concavity: for `β ≥ 0` the magnetization `h ↦ ⟨σ_o⟩_{β,h}` is concave on `[0, ∞)`.
Reference: R. B. Griffiths, C. A. Hurst, S. Sherman, "Concavity of magnetization of an Ising
ferromagnet in a positive external field", J. Math. Phys. 11 (1970) 790–795.

articles.title: Three-site duplicated-variable factor
articles.statement:
The three-site duplicated-variable factor `1 - σ_x σ_y - σ_o σ_y - σ_o σ_x` of the configuration
`q`.

articles.title: Griffiths–Hurst–Sherman inequality
articles.statement:
The Griffiths–Hurst–Sherman inequality: for `β ≥ 0` and `h ≥ 0`, the third Ursell function
`u₃(o, x, y)` is nonpositive for distinct sites. Reference: R. B. Griffiths, C. A. Hurst, S.
Sherman, "Concavity of magnetization of an Ising ferromagnet in a positive external field", J. Math.
Phys. 11 (1970) 790–795; proof via J. L. Lebowitz, "GHS and other inequalities", Comm. Math. Phys.
35 (1974) 87–92.

articles.title: Susceptibility bound $\chi(h) \le m(h)/h \le 1/h$ from concavity
articles.statement:
If the magnetization is concave in the field on `[0, ∞)` (the GHS inequality), then for `h > 0`
the susceptibility satisfies `χ(h) ≤ m(h)/h ≤ 1/h`. Reference: R. B. Griffiths, C. A. Hurst, S.
Sherman, "Concavity of magnetization of an Ising ferromagnet in a positive external field", J. Math.
Phys. 11 (1970) 790–795.

articles.title: GHS susceptibility bound $\chi \le 1/h$
articles.statement:
The GHS susceptibility bound: for `β ≥ 0` and `h > 0`, the field derivative of the magnetization
equals `β ∑_x (⟨σ_oσ_x⟩ - ⟨σ_o⟩⟨σ_x⟩)` and is at most `1/h`. Reference: R. B. Griffiths, C. A.
Hurst, S. Sherman, "Concavity of magnetization of an Ising ferromagnet in a positive external
field", J. Math. Phys. 11 (1970) 790–795. Scope: a finite graph with uniform coupling and uniform
field, the field entering the Hamiltonian as `-h ∑ σ_x` and the derivative taken in `h`; `χ ≤ 1/h`
is the weak form of the GHS consequence `χ ≤ m/h`, the full concavity statement being
`ghs_magnetization_concaveOn`. The hypotheses `β ≥ 0`, `h > 0` are satisfiable.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous magnetization on the agreement set
articles.statement:
The magnetization `⟨σ_y⟩` on the subgraph induced by `A` (couplings `2K`, fields `2hf`), or
`0` if `y ∉ A`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous law of the agreement configuration
articles.statement: The probability that two independent replicas have agreement configuration `q`.

articles.title: Spin covariance in the inhomogeneous model
articles.statement: The spin covariance `⟨σ_o σ_x⟩ - ⟨σ_o⟩⟨σ_x⟩`.

articles.title: Directional spin sum
articles.statement: The directional spin `∑_x d_x σ_x`.

articles.title: Covariance with the directional spin
articles.statement: The covariance of `f` with the directional spin `∑_x d_x σ_x`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous two-point correlation on the disagreement set
articles.statement:
The zero-field correlation `⟨σ_o σ_x⟩` on the subgraph induced by `Aᶜ` (couplings `2K`), or
`0` if `o` or `x` lies in `A`.

articles.title: Two-replica expectation with inhomogeneous couplings
articles.statement:
The expectation of `F a b` over two independent copies of the Ising model with couplings `K`
and fields `hf`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous conditional expectation given the agreement
articles.statement: The conditional two-replica expectation of `F` given the agreement configuration `q`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous total weight of an agreement fibre
articles.statement: The total two-replica weight of the fibre over `q`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous fibre weight integrated against an observable
articles.statement: The two-replica weight of the fibre over `q`, integrated against `F`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous conditional expectation of $t_y$
articles.statement: The conditional expectation `E[t_y | q]` of the rotated variable.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous conditional expectation of $u_o u_x$
articles.statement: The conditional expectation `E[u_o u_x | q]` of the rotated variables.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous two-replica weight in an agreement fibre
articles.statement: The two-replica weight of `a` and its mate in the fibre over the agreement configuration `q`.

articles.title: Field line in a given direction
articles.statement: The field line `t ↦ h + t·d`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous ghost-vertex couplings
articles.statement: The ghost-vertex couplings: `2K_{xy}` on an edge `{x, y}`, `2h_x` between `x` and the ghost.

articles.title: GHS concavity
articles.statement:
With couplings `K_e ≥ 0`, fields `h_x ≥ 0`, and a direction `d ≥ 0` with
`d_o = 0`, the magnetization `⟨σ_o⟩` is concave in `t ≥ 0` along the field line `h + t·d`.

R. B. Griffiths, C. A. Hurst and S. Sherman, J. Math. Phys. 11 (1970).

articles.title: Inhomogeneous field weight of the disagreement set
articles.statement: The field weight `exp (∑_{v ∉ q} 2h_v σ_v(a))` of the disagreement set.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous weight of an agreement set
articles.statement: The weight of the agreement set `A` in the duplicated inhomogeneous system.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous expectation with field on the agreement set
articles.statement: The expectation with field on the subgraph induced by the agreement set of `q`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous agreement-set Boltzmann weight
articles.statement:
The Boltzmann weight, with couplings `2K` and fields `2hf`, of `a` on the subgraph induced by
the agreement set of `q`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous induced-subgraph partition function with field
articles.statement:
The partition function of the subgraph induced by `A` with couplings `2K` and fields `2h` on
`A`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous zero-field expectation on the disagreement set
articles.statement: The zero-field expectation on the subgraph induced by the disagreement set of `q`.

articles.title: Third Ursell function nonpositive for $o \ne x$, $K, h \ge 0$
articles.statement: The GHS inequality `u₃(o, x, y) ≤ 0` for the named Ursell function, when `o ≠ x`.

articles.title: Third Ursell function of the inhomogeneous Ising model
articles.statement: The third Ursell function `u₃(o, x, y)` of the inhomogeneous Ising model.

articles.title: Griffiths–Hurst–Sherman inequality
articles.statement:
**Griffiths–Hurst–Sherman inequality** for inhomogeneous ferromagnets. With couplings `K_e ≥
0` and fields `h_x ≥ 0`, the third Ursell function satisfies `u₃(o, x, y) ≤ 0` whenever `o ≠
x`.

R. B. Griffiths, C. A. Hurst and S. Sherman, *Concavity of magnetization of an Ising
ferromagnet in a positive external field*, J. Math. Phys. 11 (1970); J. L. Lebowitz, *GHS and
other inequalities*, Comm. Math. Phys. 35 (1974).

articles.title: Inhomogeneous zero-field disagreement-set weight
articles.statement:
The zero-field Boltzmann weight, with couplings `2K`, of `a` on the subgraph induced by the
disagreement set of `q`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous zero-field induced-subgraph partition function
articles.statement: The zero-field partition function of the subgraph induced by `A` with couplings `2K`.

articles.title: Fibre factorization property for $u_o u_x$ and $t_y$
articles.statement: Conditioned on the agreement configuration, `u_o u_x` and `t_y` are uncorrelated.

articles.title: GHS sign condition
articles.statement:
The GHS sign condition at `(β, h)` and root `o`: the third Ursell function `u₃(o, x, y)` is
nonpositive for all pairwise distinct `o, x, y`. It holds for `β, h ≥ 0` by `ghs_signDominance`.

articles.title: Induced-subgraph partition function over the active sites only
articles.statement:
The partition function of the induced subgraph on `S`, summed over configurations on `S`
only.

articles.title: Magnetization on the agreement subgraph
articles.statement:
The magnetization `⟨σ_y⟩` in the subgraph induced by `A` (couplings `2β`, field `2βh`), or
`0` if `y ∉ A`.

articles.title: Two-point correlation on the disagreement subgraph
articles.statement:
The zero-field correlation `⟨σ_o σ_x⟩` in the subgraph induced by `Aᶜ` (couplings `2β`), or
`0` if `o` or `x` lies in `A`.

articles.title: Image of a vertex set together with the ghost vertex
articles.statement: The image of `A` together with the ghost vertex `none`.

articles.title: Configuration merged from two configurations along a set
articles.statement: The configuration equal to `a` on `S` and to `b` off `S`.

articles.title: Image of a vertex set among non-ghost vertices
articles.statement: The image of `A` among the non-ghost vertices `some x` of `Option V`.

articles.title: Splitting a configuration into a set and its complement
articles.statement: Configurations split into their restrictions to `S` and to its complement.

articles.title: Weight of an agreement set in the duplicated system
articles.statement:
The weight of the agreement set `A` in the duplicated system: the product of the ghost-vertex
partition functions of `A ∪ {ghost}` and of `Aᶜ`, with doubled couplings `2β` and field
`2βh`.

articles.title: Induced-subgraph partition function with doubled coupling and field
articles.statement: The partition function on the induced subgraph on `A` with couplings `2β` and field `2βh`.

articles.title: Zero-field induced-subgraph partition function with doubled coupling
articles.statement: The zero-field partition function on the induced subgraph on `A` with couplings `2β`.

articles.title: Correlation with field in an induced subgraph
articles.statement: The correlation `⟨σ_P⟩` in the induced subgraph on `S`, with field `hf`.

articles.title: Zero-field correlation in an induced subgraph
articles.statement: The zero-field correlation `⟨σ_P⟩` in the induced subgraph on `S`.

articles.title: Edges of the induced subgraph on a vertex set
articles.statement: The edges of `E` with both endpoints in `S` (the edges of the induced subgraph on `S`).

articles.title: Zero-field partition function of an induced subgraph
articles.statement: The zero-field partition function of the induced subgraph on `S`, with couplings `J`.

articles.title: Two-replica Ising expectation
articles.statement:
The expectation of `F a b` over two independent copies `a, b` of the Ising Gibbs
distribution.

articles.title: Three-replica Ising expectation
articles.statement:
The expectation of `F a b c` over three independent copies `a, b, c` of the Ising Gibbs
distribution.

articles.title: Magnetization vanishes at zero field
articles.statement: At zero field the global spin-flip symmetry forces the magnetization `⟨σ_o⟩_{β,0}` to vanish.

articles.title: Derivative of a concave function is at most a secant slope
articles.statement:
The derivative of a concave function on `[0, ∞)` at `b` is at most the secant slope over `[a,
b]`. This is Mathlib's `ConcaveOn.deriv_le_slope` with the slope unfolded.

articles.title: Concavity from a nonpositive second derivative on $(0, \infty)$
articles.statement:
A continuous function on `[0, ∞)`, twice differentiable on the interior with nonpositive second
derivative, is concave. This is Mathlib's `concaveOn_of_deriv2_nonpos` specialized to `Ici 0`.

articles.title: Susceptibility bound $\chi(h) \le m(h)/h$ from concavity
articles.statement:
If the magnetization is concave in the field on `[0, ∞)`, then for `h > 0` the susceptibility
satisfies `χ(h) ≤ m(h)/h`, using `m(0) = 0`.

articles.title: Total spin of a configuration
articles.statement: The total spin `∑_x σ_x` of a configuration.

articles.title: Rotated two-replica sum variable $t_w$
articles.statement: The rotated two-replica variable `t_w = (σ_w(a) + σ_w(b)) / 2`.

articles.title: Rotated two-replica difference variable $u_w$
articles.statement: The rotated two-replica variable `u_w = (σ_w(a) - σ_w(b)) / 2`.

articles.title: Monotonicity of correlations
articles.statement:
**Monotonicity of correlations** (a consequence of the second Griffiths inequality): for `h ≥
0`, every spin correlation `⟨σ_A⟩_{β,h}` is nondecreasing in `β ≥ 0` (Griffiths, J. Math. Phys.
8 (1967)).

articles.title: Ginibre's duplicated-variable change of variables
articles.statement: Ginibre's duplicated-variable change of variables `(σ, q) ↦ (σ, σ q)` as an equivalence.

articles.title: Duplicated-variable involution on configuration pairs
articles.statement: The involution `(σ, q) ↦ (σ, σ q)` of pairs of configurations.

articles.title: Energy observable of the Ising model
articles.statement:
The energy observable `∑_{e ∈ E(G)} σ_x σ_y + h ∑_x σ_x`, the `β`-derivative of the
log-weight.

articles.title: Gibbs expectation with inhomogeneous couplings and site fields
articles.statement: The Gibbs expectation `⟨f⟩_{E,J,h} = ∑_σ f(σ) w(σ) / Z`.

articles.title: Edge-removal weight with hyperbolic sine factors
articles.statement: The weight `ρ(S) = ζ(S) ∏_{e ∈ S} tanh J_e = (Z_{E∖S} / Z_E) ∏_{e ∈ S} sinh J_e`.

articles.title: Edge-removal ratio of partition functions
articles.statement: The edge-removal ratio `ζ(S) = (Z_{E∖S} / Z_E) ∏_{e ∈ S} cosh J_e`.

articles.title: First Griffiths inequality (GKS I)
articles.statement:
For the ferromagnetic Ising model on a finite graph with
`β ≥ 0` and `h ≥ 0`, every spin correlation is nonnegative: `0 ≤ ⟨σ_A⟩`.

R. B. Griffiths, *Correlations in Ising ferromagnets. I*, J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967); D. G. Kelly
and S. Sherman, *General Griffiths' inequalities on correlations in Ising ferromagnets*, J.
Math. Phys. 9 (1968).

articles.title: Nonnegativity of the GKS positivity kernel
articles.statement:
The positivity kernel of the GKS inequalities: for nonnegative `c_i, d_i` and spin monomials
`fac i`, `obs`, the configuration sum of `obs · ∏_i (c_i + d_i · fac_i)` is nonnegative.

articles.title: Griffiths' second inequality for inhomogeneous couplings
articles.statement:
Griffiths' second inequality for nonnegative couplings and fields: `⟨σ_A⟩⟨σ_B⟩ ≤ ⟨σ_{A ∆ B}⟩`.
Reference: R. B. Griffiths, "Correlations in Ising ferromagnets I", J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967) 478–483;
J. Ginibre, "General formulation of Griffiths' inequalities", Comm. Math. Phys. 16 (1970) 310–328.
See also `gks_second` (GKS2) for uniform couplings.

articles.title: Second Griffiths inequality (GKS II)
articles.statement:
For the ferromagnetic Ising model on a finite graph
with `β ≥ 0` and `h ≥ 0`, spin correlations are positively correlated: `⟨σ_A⟩ ⟨σ_B⟩ ≤ ⟨σ_A σ_B⟩
= ⟨σ_{A ∆ B}⟩`.

R. B. Griffiths, *Correlations in Ising ferromagnets. I*, J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967); D. G. Kelly
and S. Sherman, *General Griffiths' inequalities on correlations in Ising ferromagnets*, J.
Math. Phys. 9 (1968).

articles.title: Griffiths monotonicity of correlations in the edge set
articles.statement:
Griffiths monotonicity: adding edges with nonnegative couplings increases every correlation
`⟨σ_A⟩`. Reference: R. B. Griffiths, "Correlations in Ising ferromagnets I", J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967)
478–483.

articles.title: Being a spin monomial
articles.statement: `f` is a spin monomial `∏_x σ_x^{m_x}` for some exponents `m`.

articles.title: Finite-volume Ising expectation
articles.statement: The finite-volume Ising expectation `⟨f⟩ = ∑_s P(s) f(s)` of an observable `f`.

articles.title: Boltzmann weight as a product of cosh-plus-sinh factors
articles.statement:
The Boltzmann weight factorizes as a product over edges and vertices of `cosh + sinh · σ`
terms.

articles.title: Spin monomial with given exponents
articles.statement: The spin monomial `∏_x σ_x^{m_x}` with exponents `m : V → ℕ`.

articles.title: Spin value of a Boolean
articles.statement:
The spin value `±1` of a Boolean: `1` for `true`, `-1` for `false`. See also
`CondensedMatter.IsingModel.spin` and `StatMech.Ising.spinB_eq_isingModelSpin`.

articles.title: Spin product over a vertex set
articles.statement: The spin product `σ_A = ∏_{x ∈ A} σ_x`.

articles.title: Configuration sum of a spin monomial is nonnegative
articles.statement: The sum of a spin monomial over all configurations is nonnegative.

articles.title: Unnormalized second Griffiths inequality
articles.statement: The unnormalized second Griffiths inequality: `Z² (⟨σ_{A ∆ B}⟩ - ⟨σ_A⟩⟨σ_B⟩) ≥ 0`.

articles.title: Boltzmann weight with inhomogeneous couplings and site fields
articles.statement: The Boltzmann weight `exp(∑_{e ∈ E} J_e σ_e + ∑_x h_x σ_x)`.

articles.title: Pointwise product of two configurations
articles.statement:
The pointwise product of two configurations: spin `σ_y σ'_y` at `y` (`true` when the spins
agree).

articles.title: Partition function with inhomogeneous couplings and site fields
articles.statement: The partition function `∑_σ wJ E J h σ`.

articles.title: FKG inequality
articles.statement:
**FKG inequality** for the Ising model. For `β ≥ 0` and any field, increasing functions are
positively correlated under the Ising Gibbs distribution on a finite graph.

C. M. Fortuin, P. W. Kasteleyn and J. Ginibre, *Correlation inequalities on some partially
ordered sets*, Comm. Math. Phys. 22 (1971). See also
`MathlibExt.Probability.CorrelationInequalities.FKG`.

articles.title: States of the first $N + 1$ periods of a periodic walk
articles.statement:
The states of the first `N` periods of a periodic walk followed by the initial state of the next
period.

articles.title: Periodic lift anchored at the base point
articles.statement: The periodic lift translated to start at the base point over the starting site.

articles.title: Cyclic turning sum of a direction list
articles.statement:
The total turning of a direction list read cyclically, including the turn from the last
direction back to the first.

articles.title: Edge set of a closed walk of darts
articles.statement: The set of torus edges traversed by a closed walk of darts.

articles.title: $N$ repetitions of a direction sequence
articles.statement: `N` repetitions of the direction sequence.

articles.title: Indicator bit of an edge in an edge set
articles.statement: The indicator of `e ∈ F` in `Fin 2`.

articles.title: Mod 2 intersection number of two torus edge sets
articles.statement: The mod-2 intersection number of edge sets `F` and `G` on the torus.

articles.title: Intersection number of torus edge sets in the field $\mathbb{Z}/2$
articles.statement: The intersection number of two edge sets, valued in `ZMod 2`.

articles.title: Mod 2 homology class of an edge set
articles.statement:
The homology class mod 2 of an edge set: the parities of its numbers of edges crossing the
vertical and the horizontal seam.

articles.title: Intersection form on the mod 2 homology of the torus
articles.statement: The intersection form `h₁ k₂ + h₂ k₁` on `H₁(T², ℤ/2) = (ℤ/2)²`.

articles.title: Horizontal edge bit of an edge set at a site
articles.statement: Whether `F` contains the horizontal edge from `p` eastward.

articles.title: Horizontal edge bit as an element of $\mathbb{Z}/2$
articles.statement: The horizontal edge bit as an element of `ZMod 2`.

articles.title: Rotation of a lattice point by quarter turns

articles.title: Sector weight of the trivial homology class
articles.statement: The sector weight of the trivial homology class.

articles.title: Sector weight of the homology class $(0, 1)$
articles.statement: The sector weight of the homology class `(0, 1)`.

articles.title: Sector weight of the homology class $(1, 0)$

articles.title: Sector weight of the homology class $(1, 1)$
articles.statement: The sector weight of the homology class `(1, 1)`.

The sector weight `Z_h(x) = ∑ x^|F|` over even subgraphs `F` of the torus with homology class

The even-subgraph sum of the torus with each subgraph weighted by the spin character of its

The spin-structure character `(-1)^{(1 + a) h₁ + (1 + b) h₂ + h₁ h₂}` of a homology class `h`

articles.title: Linear character of the boundary phases
articles.statement: The linear character `(-1)^{a h₁ + b h₂}` of the boundary phases on homology classes mod 2.

articles.title: Vertical edge bit of an edge set at a site

articles.statement: The vertical edge bit as an element of `ZMod 2`.

articles.title: Mod 2 homology class of a winding
articles.statement: The homology class mod 2 of the winding `(m₁, m₂)`.

articles.title: Translation of $\mathbb{Z}^2$ for a winding around the torus
articles.statement: The translation `(L m₁, L m₂)` of `ℤ²` corresponding to winding `(m₁, m₂)` around the torus.

articles.title: Horizontal flux of an edge set through a column

articles.statement: Edges of the torus crossing the vertical seam between the columns `x = -1` and `x = 0`.

articles.title: Vertical-seam edge in a given row
articles.statement: The edge of the vertical seam in row `y`.

articles.title: Signed crossing of the vertical seam by a dart
articles.statement: The signed crossing of the vertical seam by a dart: `1` eastward, `-1` westward, `0` otherwise.

articles.title: Crossing of the vertical seam by a dart
articles.statement: A dart crosses the vertical seam between the columns `x = -1` and `x = 0`.

articles.title: Vertical flux of an edge set through a row
articles.statement: The number mod 2 of vertical edges of `F` leaving row `y` northward.

articles.title: Edges crossing the horizontal seam of the torus
articles.statement: Edges of the torus crossing the horizontal seam between the rows `y = -1` and `y = 0`.

articles.title: Horizontal-seam edge in a given column
articles.statement: The edge of the horizontal seam in column `x`.

articles.title: Signed crossing of the horizontal seam by a dart
articles.statement:
The signed crossing of the horizontal seam by a dart: `1` northward, `-1` southward, `0`
otherwise.

articles.title: Crossing of the horizontal seam by a dart
articles.statement: A dart crosses the horizontal seam between the rows `y = -1` and `y = 0`.

articles.title: Horizontal part of the zero-flux potential construction
articles.statement: The horizontal part of the potential construction for an edge set of zero flux.

articles.title: Face potential of an even subgraph of zero homology
articles.statement: A face potential `P` whose boundary is a given even subgraph of zero homology.

articles.title: Vertical part of the zero-flux potential construction
articles.statement: The vertical part of the potential construction for an edge set of zero flux.

articles.title: Prefix sum of a function on $\mathbb{Z}/L$
articles.statement: The prefix sum `∑_{k < x} f k` along `ZMod L`, using the representatives `0, …, L - 1`.

articles.title: Darts of the square-lattice torus
articles.statement: Darts (directed edges) of the torus: a starting site and a direction.

articles.title: Walk-series square root of det(1 − Λ)
articles.statement:
The walk-series square root of `det (1 - Λ)`: the exponential of minus one half of
`∑ₙ (∑ over closed walks of length n + 1 of their weight) / (n + 1)`.

articles.title: Horizontal displacement of a step in a direction
articles.statement: The horizontal displacement `1, 0, -1, 0` of a step in direction `μ`.

articles.title: Vertical displacement of a step in a direction
articles.statement: The vertical displacement `0, 1, 0, -1` of a step in direction `μ`.

articles.title: Boundary phase of a step in a direction
articles.statement: The phase of a step in direction `μ`: `u, v, u⁻¹, v⁻¹` for east, north, west, south.

articles.title: Neighbouring site in a given direction on the torus
articles.statement: The neighbor of a site in direction `μ`: `0` east, `1` north, `2` west, `3` south.

articles.title: Block of the twisted Kac-Ward matrix between a site and the origin
articles.statement: The `4 × 4` block of the twisted Kac-Ward matrix between the darts at `g` and at the origin.

articles.title: 4 × 4 block of the Kac-Ward matrix between a site and the origin
articles.statement:
The `4 × 4` block of the Kac-Ward matrix between the darts at site `g` and the darts at the
origin.

articles.title: Convergence radius of the twisted Kac-Ward walk expansion
articles.statement:
The radius `1 / (number of darts) = 1 / (4L²)` below which the walk expansion of the twisted
Kac-Ward determinant converges.

articles.title: Twisted Kac-Ward matrix with direction phases
articles.statement: The Kac-Ward matrix with each step multiplied by its direction phase `ons_dirPhase u v`.

articles.title: Edge-weighted Kac-Ward matrix with direction phases
articles.statement: The edge-weighted Kac-Ward matrix with each step multiplied by its direction phase.

articles.title: Edge-weighted Kac-Ward matrix
articles.statement:
The edge-weighted Kac-Ward matrix: the entry from `d₁` to `d₂` is the weight of the torus edge
of `d₁` times the turn weight, when `d₂` starts at the head of `d₁`.

articles.title: Kac–Ward matrix of the square-lattice torus
articles.statement:
The Kac-Ward matrix: the entry from `d₁` to `d₂` is `x * ons_turnW ω d₁.2 d₂.2` when `d₂` starts
at the head of `d₁`, and `0` otherwise.

articles.title: Fourier symbol of one minus the Kac-Ward matrix
articles.statement:
The `4 × 4` Fourier symbol of `1 - ons_KWmat` at `zⱼ = e^{i kⱼ}`, rows and columns indexed by
the directions east, north, west, south.

articles.title: Matrix with forbidden rows and columns set to zero
articles.statement: The matrix `Λ` with every row and column indexed by a state of `forbidden` set to zero.

articles.title: Masked edge-weighted bucket: walks through a dart, not its reverse
articles.statement: As `ons_weightedPhaseBucketE`, with the darts of `forbidden` masked.

articles.title: Masked edge-weighted bucket: walks avoiding a dart and its reverse
articles.statement: As `ons_weightedPhaseBucketN`, with the darts of `forbidden` masked.

articles.title: Matrix with selected columns scaled
articles.statement: The matrix `Λ` with every column indexed by an element of `S` multiplied by `t`.

articles.title: Edge weight function with one weight scaled by t
articles.statement: The edge weight function with the weight of `edge` multiplied by `t`.

articles.title: Translation of a dart by a lattice vector
articles.statement: Translation of a dart by a lattice vector `t`.

articles.title: Primitive L-th root of unity $e^{2\pi i/L}$
articles.statement: The primitive `L`-th root of unity `e^{2πi/L}`.

articles.title: Sector determinant with boundary phases
articles.statement:
The sector determinant: the product of `ons_symbolDispersion β` over the momenta
`(2π(i + a/2) / L, 2π(j + b/2) / L)`, `i, j < L`, for boundary phases `a, b ∈ {0, 1}`.

articles.title: Boundary phase $e^{i\pi a/L}$
articles.statement: The boundary phase `e^{iπa/L}`, whose `L`-th power is `(-1)^a`.

articles.title: Turning phase $\omega = e^{i\pi/4}$
articles.statement: The turning phase `ω = e^{iπ/4}`, so a turn by `±π/2` contributes `ω^{±1}` and `ω² = i`.

articles.title: Turn weight between two lattice directions
articles.statement:
The turn weight from direction `μ` to direction `ν`: `1` straight, `ω` for a left turn, `0` for
a U-turn, `ω⁻¹` for a right turn.

articles.title: Sites of the square-lattice torus
articles.statement: The sites `ℤ_L × ℤ_L` of the `L × L` square-lattice torus.

articles.title: Edge-weighted twisted bucket: walks through a dart, not its reverse
articles.statement:
The total edge-weighted twisted Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` visiting `e`
but not its reverse.

articles.title: Edge-weighted twisted bucket: walks avoiding a dart and its reverse
articles.statement:
The total edge-weighted twisted Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` visiting
neither `e` nor its reverse.

articles.title: Trace of a power as a power sum of characteristic roots
articles.statement:
The trace of `φ ^ k` is the sum of the `k`-th powers of the roots of the characteristic
polynomial of `φ`. See also `Matrix.trace_eq_sum_roots_charpoly`, the case `k = 1`.

articles.title: Cycle-parity compatibility of closed dual walks
articles.statement: Every closed walk of `Gd` has edge set whose pullback is cycle-parity compatible.

articles.title: Closed Eulerian walk of a component of an even edge set
articles.statement: A closed Eulerian walk of the component of `f` in an even edge set `F`.

articles.title: Component of a vertex in the graph spanned by an edge set
articles.statement: The component of `f` in the graph spanned by `F`.

articles.title: Vertex set of a component of the graph spanned by an edge set
articles.statement: The vertices of the component of `f` in the graph spanned by `F`.

articles.title: Edges cut by a configuration via the edge disagreement test
articles.statement: The edges cut by `s`, defined through `edgeDiff`.

articles.title: Edges cut by a spin configuration
articles.statement: The edges `{x, y}` of `G` whose endpoints have different spins in `s`.

articles.title: Proportionality of the cut sum and the dual even-subgraph sum
articles.statement:
The cut sum `∑_s t^{|∂s|}` of `Gp` equals `mult` times the even-subgraph sum `∑_F t^{|F|}` of
`Gd`.

articles.title: Cut space defined through Boolean cut edges
articles.statement: The cut space, defined through `cutEdgesB`.

articles.title: Cut space of a graph
articles.statement: The cut space: the edge sets `∂s` cut by configurations `s`.

articles.title: Cycle-parity compatibility of a dual edge set
articles.statement: Every closed walk of `Gp` crosses the pullback of `F` an even number of times.

articles.title: Dual high-temperature expansion proportional to the partition function
articles.statement:
`tanh β* = exp (-2β)` and the high-temperature expansion of `Gd` at `β*` equals `c` times
`Z_{Gp}(β)`.

articles.title: Region-bounding property of closed dual walks
articles.statement: Every closed walk of `Gd` pulls back to the boundary of a region of `Gp`.

articles.title: Side-colouring property of closed dual walks
articles.statement:
Every closed walk of `Gd` has a two-colouring of the vertices of `Gp` whose boundary is the
pullback of its edges.

articles.title: Edge crossing from region-bounding dual walks, no decomposition needed
articles.statement:
An edge crossing built from dual walks bounding regions (variant using
`even_to_cut_of_boundsRegion'`).

articles.title: Edge crossing from region-bounding dual walks and a walk decomposition
articles.statement: An edge crossing built from dual walks bounding regions.

articles.title: Edge crossing from closed-walk parities and walk decompositions
articles.statement:
An edge crossing built from closed-walk parities and the decomposition of even subgraphs into
closed walks.

articles.title: Edge crossing from cycle-parity compatibility of even subgraphs
articles.statement: An edge crossing built from cycle-parity compatibility of all even subgraphs of `Gd`.

articles.title: Edge crossing from side colourings of dual walks
articles.statement: An edge crossing built from side colourings of dual walks.

articles.title: Edge crossing between a graph and its dual
articles.statement:
An edge bijection `ψ` from `Gp` to `Gd` carrying edges to edges, cuts to even subgraphs, and
even subgraphs back to cuts.

articles.title: Spin disagreement test across an edge
articles.statement: Whether the spins of `s` differ at the endpoints of `e`.

articles.title: Evenness of an edge set on every closed walk
articles.statement: Every closed walk of `Gp` uses edges of `δ` an even number of times.

articles.title: Even subgraphs of a finite graph decompose into closed walks
articles.statement: Every even subgraph decomposes into closed walks.

articles.title: Closed-walk decomposition property of even subgraphs
articles.statement: Every even subgraph of `Gd` is a symmetric difference of edge sets of closed walks.

articles.title: Even subgraphs defined by a Boolean test
articles.statement: The even subgraphs, defined with a Boolean test.

articles.title: Even subgraphs of a graph
articles.statement: The even subgraphs of `G`.

articles.title: Number of edges of an edge set incident to a vertex
articles.statement: The number of edges of `F` incident to `v`.

articles.title: Even subgraph condition on an edge set
articles.statement: Every vertex has even degree in the edge set `F`.

articles.title: High-temperature expansion
articles.statement:
At zero field, `Z(β) = 2^{|V|} (cosh β)^{|E|} ∑_{F even}
(tanh β)^{|F|}`.

S. Friedli and Y. Velenik, *Statistical Mechanics of Lattice Systems*, Cambridge University
Press (2017), Section 3.7.

articles.title: Kramers–Wannier duality
articles.statement:
**Kramers–Wannier duality** on the self-dual graph `K₄`: if `tanh β* = e^{-2β}` then `Z(β*) =
(2⁴ (cosh β*)^{|E|} / (e^{β|E|} · 2)) Z(β)` at zero field.

H. A. Kramers and G. H. Wannier, *Statistics of the two-dimensional ferromagnet. Part I*,
Phys. Rev. 60 (1941).

articles.title: Kramers–Wannier duality
articles.statement:
**Kramers–Wannier duality** for a preconnected graph `Gp` and a graph `Gd` whose closed walks
pull back to region boundaries, for `tanh β* = e^{-2β}`.

H. A. Kramers and G. H. Wannier, *Statistics of the two-dimensional ferromagnet. Part I*,
Phys. Rev. 60 (1941).

articles.title: Kramers–Wannier duality
articles.statement:
For a preconnected graph `Gp` with an edge crossing to `Gd` and
`tanh β* = e^{-2β}`, `Z_{Gd}(β*) = (2^{|V|} (cosh β*)^{|E_d|} / (e^{β|E_p|} · 2)) Z_{Gp}(β)`
at zero field.

H. A. Kramers and G. H. Wannier, *Statistics of the two-dimensional ferromagnet. Part I*,
Phys. Rev. 60 (1941).

articles.title: Edge complementation of K₄ as an involutive equivalence
articles.statement: Complementation of edges of `K₄` as an involutive equivalence.

articles.title: Complementary edge of a pair in K₄
articles.statement: The edge of `K₄` complementary to `{a, b}`.

articles.title: Complementary-edge map of K₄ on unordered pairs
articles.statement: The complementary edge of `K₄`, as a function on `Sym2 (Fin 4)`.

articles.title: Self-dual edge crossing of K₄ by complementary edges
articles.statement: The edge crossing of the self-dual graph `K₄` given by complementary edges.

articles.title: Vertices of K₄ outside a given pair
articles.statement: The two vertices of `Fin 4` other than `a` and `b`.

articles.title: Complete graph on four vertices
articles.statement: The complete graph `K₄` on `Fin 4`.

articles.title: Boolean indicator of a set of sites of ℤ²
articles.statement: The indicator of a set of sites of `ℤ²`, as a Boolean function.

articles.title: Spin configuration from crossing parities along walks
articles.statement: The configuration assigning to `v` the crossing parity of `δ` along a walk from `v₀` to `v`.

articles.title: Edge boundary of a region in a graph
articles.statement: The edges of `Gp` whose endpoints lie on different sides of the region `S`.

articles.title: Cycle-parity compatibility of a family of dual cycle sets
articles.statement: Every edge set in `cycleSets` is cycle-parity compatible.

articles.title: Simple graph spanned by an edge set
articles.statement: The simple graph with edge set `F`.

articles.title: Image of an edge set under a vertex bijection
articles.statement: The image of an edge set under a vertex equivalence `V ≃ W`.

articles.title: Number of disagreeing steps along a walk
articles.statement: The number of steps of a walk whose endpoints have different spins in `s`.

articles.title: Crossing parity of a walk with respect to an edge set
articles.statement: The parity of the number of steps of a walk that use an edge of `δ`.

articles.title: Uniform bound constant for the inner integrals near β_c
articles.statement: A uniform bound for the inner integrals `∫ log g dk₂` near `β_c`.

articles.title: Integrable dominating function for log g near the critical point
articles.statement: The dominating function `log 9 + log 2 + |log (1 - cos y)|` for `log g` near `β_c`.

articles.title: Spin Kac-Ward identities at inverse temperature $\beta$
articles.statement:
The spin Kac-Ward identities at inverse temperature `β`: on every `L × L` torus with `L > 2`,
each signed sector sum at `tanh β` squares to the corresponding sector determinant.

articles.title: Spin Kac-Ward identities via twisted Kac-Ward determinants
articles.statement:
The spin Kac-Ward identities written with the twisted Kac-Ward determinants `det (1 - Λ_{ab})`
at `x = tanh β`.

articles.title: High-temperature expansion
articles.statement:
**High-temperature expansion** (van der Waerden 1941). `Z(β) = 2^|V| (cosh β)^|E| X(tanh β)` for
the zero-field Ising model on a finite graph (B. L. van der Waerden, *Die lange Reichweite der
regelmässigen Atomanordnung in Mischkristallen*, 1941).

articles.title: Even-subgraph generating function of a graph
articles.statement:
The even-subgraph generating function `∑_F x^|F|` of `G`, over edge sets `F` in which every
vertex has even degree.

articles.title: Zero-field Ising partition function with unit couplings
articles.statement: The zero-field Ising partition function of `G` with unit couplings at inverse temperature `β`.

articles.title: Finite-volume pressure
articles.statement:
The finite-volume pressure `log Z_G(β) / |V|` (the negative of `β` times the free energy per
site).

articles.title: Kac-Ward symbol determinant at t = tanh β
articles.statement: The Kac-Ward symbol determinant `(1 + t²)² - 2t(1 - t²)(cos k₁ + cos k₂)` at `t = tanh β`.

articles.title: Torus pressure sequence of the zero-field Ising model
articles.statement:
The pressure `log Z_L(β) / L²` of the zero-field Ising model on the `L × L` torus, as a sequence
in `L` (set to `0` for `L ≤ 2`, where the torus graph is not defined).

articles.title: Ising free energy density along side lengths $n + 1$
articles.statement:
For a natural number $n$ and real
$\beta$, this is the finite-volume free energy density of the Ising model on the periodic
$(n + 1) \times (n + 1)$ square lattice at inverse temperature $\beta$, namely
$\log Z_{n+1}(\beta) / (n + 1)^2$, where $Z_{n+1}(\beta)$ is the partition function of that
lattice at inverse temperature $\beta$.

articles.title: Finite-volume Ising free energy density
articles.statement:
For a positive integer $L$ and real $\beta$, the
free energy density of the Ising model on the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice is
$\log Z_L(\beta) / L^2$, where $Z_L(\beta)$ is the partition function at inverse temperature
$\beta$.

No factor $-1/\beta$ is included.

articles.title: Onsager's phase transition for the two-dimensional Ising model
articles.statement:
For a positive integer $L$
and real $\beta$, let $Z_L(\beta)$ be the partition function of the zero-field ferromagnetic Ising
model on the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice at inverse temperature $\beta$. There exist a
function $F : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and a real number $\beta_c > 0$ such that, for every real
$\beta$, $\log Z_{n+1}(\beta) / (n+1)^2$ converges to $F(\beta)$ as $n \to \infty$, and $F$ is not
real analytic at $\beta_c$.

## Sources

- L. Onsager, *Crystal statistics I*, Phys. Rev. 65 (1944). Knill, §158. Problem `ising_2d_phase_transition` of the lean-eval benchmark.

articles.title: Energy of an Ising configuration
articles.statement:
For a positive integer $L$, let $\sigma$ be a spin
configuration on the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice, assigning to each site $p$ a spin
$\sigma_p \in \{1, -1\}$. Its energy in the zero-field ferromagnetic Ising model with unit
coupling is

$$H_L(\sigma) = -\sum_p \left(\sigma_p \sigma_{p + e_1} + \sigma_p \sigma_{p + e_2}\right),$$

where $p$ runs over all sites, and $p + e_1$ and $p + e_2$ are obtained from $p$ by adding $1$
modulo $L$ to its first and to its second coordinate respectively.

articles.title: Ising partition function
articles.statement:
For a positive integer $L$ and real $\beta$, the partition
function of the Ising model on the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice at inverse temperature
$\beta$ is $Z_L(\beta) = \sum_\sigma e^{-\beta H_L(\sigma)}$, where $\sigma$ runs over all spin
configurations on the lattice and $H_L(\sigma)$ is the Ising energy of $\sigma$.

articles.title: Sites of the periodic square lattice
articles.statement:
For a positive integer $L$, the sites of the
periodic $L \times L$ square lattice are the pairs $(i, j)$ with
$i, j \in \mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z}$.

articles.title: Right neighbour
articles.statement:
For a positive integer $L$, the right neighbour of a site $(i, j)$ of
the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice is $(i + 1, j)$, with addition in
$\mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z}$.

articles.title: Numerical value of a spin
articles.statement:
A spin, recorded as a Boolean, has the real value $1$ if it is
true and $-1$ if it is false.

articles.title: Upward neighbour
articles.statement:
For a positive integer $L$, the upward neighbour of a site $(i, j)$ of
the periodic $L \times L$ square lattice is $(i, j + 1)$, with addition in
$\mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z}$.

articles.title: Onsager's free-energy double integral
articles.statement:
The integral
`(1 / (8π²)) ∫_{-π}^{π} ∫_{-π}^{π} log (cosh² 2β - sinh 2β (cos k₁ + cos k₂)) dk₁ dk₂` in Onsager's
formula.

articles.title: Limit statement for $\log X_L(\tanh\beta)/L^2$ on the torus
articles.statement:
The statement that `log X_L(tanh β) / L²` on the `L × L` torus converges to
`ons_freeEnergyIntegral β - 2 log cosh β` as `L → ∞`.

articles.title: Onsager's pressure of the square-lattice Ising model
articles.statement:
Onsager's pressure (minus `β` times the free energy per site) of the square-lattice Ising model:
`log 2` plus `ons_freeEnergyIntegral β`.

articles.title: $\beta_c$ is the unique positive root of $\sinh 2\beta = 1$
articles.statement: `β_c` is the only positive `β` with `sinh 2β = 1`.

articles.title: Kramers-Wannier critical point
articles.statement:
`β_c = ½ log (1 + √2)` satisfies `sinh 2β_c = 1` (H. A.
Kramers and G. H. Wannier, *Statistics of the two-dimensional ferromagnet. Part I*, 1941).

articles.title: Finite-volume pressure decomposition for $\beta \ge 0$
articles.statement: The finite-volume pressure as `log 2 + (|E|/|V|) log cosh β + log X(tanh β) / |V|`, for `β ≥ 0`.

articles.title: Onsager's formula from the spin Kac-Ward identities
articles.statement: Onsager's formula follows from the spin Kac-Ward identities at all `β`.

articles.title: Onsager's formula
articles.statement:
**Onsager's formula** (L. Onsager, *Crystal statistics. I. A two-dimensional model with an
order-disorder transition*, Phys. Rev. 65, 1944). For the zero-field nearest-neighbor Ising model
with unit coupling on the `L × L` torus, the pressure `log Z_L(β) / L²` converges, for every
`β ≥ 0`, to `log 2 + (1 / 8π²) ∫∫_{[-π, π]²} log (cosh² 2β - sinh 2β (cos k₁ + cos k₂))`.

The limit runs over all `L` (the sequence is `0` for `L ≤ 2`, which does not affect it). Negative
`β` (antiferromagnetic coupling) is not covered: the right-hand side is even in `β`, but on odd tori the corresponding limit involves frustrated configurations.
Non-analyticity at `β_c` is not part of the statement.

articles.title: High-temperature expansion
articles.statement:
**High-temperature expansion** (van der Waerden 1941). On a finite graph,
`Z(β) = 2^|V| (cosh β)^|E| X(tanh β)` with `X` the even-subgraph generating function.

articles.title: Continuity of Onsager's pressure at the critical point
articles.statement: Onsager's pressure is continuous at `β_c`. Its non-analyticity there is not part of the statement.

articles.title: Spin Kac-Ward identities from the decorated-torus formal identity
articles.statement: The spin Kac-Ward identities follow from the formal Kac-Ward identity on all decorated tori.

articles.title: Spin Kac-Ward identities from the edge-weighted root identity
articles.statement: The spin Kac-Ward identities follow from the edge-weighted root identity on all tori.

articles.title: Pressure decomposition on the $L \times L$ torus for $\beta \ge 0$
articles.statement: On the `L × L` torus, `p_L(β) = log 2 + 2 log cosh β + log X_L(tanh β) / L²` for `β ≥ 0`.

articles.title: Edge-weighted root identity from the decorated-torus formal identity
articles.statement:
The edge-weighted root identity follows from the formal Kac-Ward identity on the decorated
torus.

articles.title: Kramers-Wannier critical point
articles.statement:
`sinh 2β_c = 1` (H. A. Kramers and G. H. Wannier,
*Statistics of the two-dimensional ferromagnet. Part I*, 1941).

articles.title: β_c is the unique positive solution of sinh 2β = 1
articles.statement:
`β_c` is the unique positive inverse temperature with `sinh 2β = 1`, the self-dual point of the
Kramers-Wannier duality.

articles.title: Critical inverse temperature ½ log(1 + √2) of the square lattice
articles.statement:
The critical inverse temperature `β_c = ½ log (1 + √2)` of the square-lattice Ising model with
unit couplings.

articles.title: Onsager integrand of the square-lattice Ising model
articles.statement:
The Onsager integrand `cosh² 2β - sinh 2β (cos k₁ + cos k₂)` at inverse temperature `β` and
momentum `(k₁, k₂)`.

articles.title: Nearest-neighbor adjacency on the discrete torus
articles.statement:
Nearest-neighbor adjacency on `ℤ_L × ℤ_L`: the two sites differ by `±1` in exactly one
coordinate.

articles.title: The torus graph is a circulant graph with jumps $(1,0)$ and $(0,1)$
articles.statement: The torus graph is the circulant graph of `ℤ_L × ℤ_L` with jumps `(1, 0)` and `(0, 1)`.

articles.title: The $L \times L$ square-lattice torus graph
articles.statement: The `L × L` square-lattice torus as a simple graph on `ℤ_L × ℤ_L`, for `L > 2`.

articles.title: Adding a dart and its reverse to the masked set
articles.statement: Add a dart and its reverse to a set of masked darts.

articles.title: Kac-Ward bucket: walks through a dart, not its reverse
articles.statement: The total Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` that visit `e` but not its reverse.

articles.title: Kac-Ward bucket: walks avoiding a dart and its reverse
articles.statement:
The total Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` that visit neither `e` nor its
reverse.

articles.title: Rotation of a cyclic sequence by one step
articles.statement: Rotation of a cyclic sequence by one step: `(ons_cyclicShift v) k = v (k + 1)`.

articles.title: Edge weight of a walk
articles.statement:
The edge weight `Λ e₀ e₁ * Λ e₁ e₂ * ⋯ * Λ eₖ₋₁ eₖ` of a walk `[e₀, …, eₖ]`; walks with at most
one entry have weight `1`.

articles.title: Majorant $q^{|s|-1}$ for the weight of a walk
articles.statement:
The majorant `q^{|s| - 1}` for the weight of a walk `s` with at least two states, and `0` for
shorter lists.

articles.title: First-return segments of a closed walk
articles.statement: The first-return segments of a closed walk at `e`, without the trailing one-element piece `[e]`.

articles.title: Splitting a list at the occurrences of a root
articles.statement:
Splitting of a list at the occurrences of `e`: each piece runs from one occurrence of `e` to the
next.

articles.title: Weight of a first-return segment avoiding a state
articles.statement: The edge weight of `s` if `s` is a first-return segment at `e` avoiding `r`, and `0` otherwise.

articles.title: Gluing of walk segments at a root
articles.statement:
Concatenation of walk segments sharing their end points at `e`: each segment except the last
loses its final entry, and the result ends in `e`.

articles.title: Positions where a sequence meets an edge or its reverse
articles.statement: The positions where `v` meets `e` or `rev e`.

articles.title: Reversal of a cyclic sequence of states
articles.statement:
Reversal of a cyclic sequence of states: position `k` carries `rev` of the state at position
`-k`.

articles.title: First-return segment at a state
articles.statement: A first-return segment at `e`: a list `e :: interior ++ [e]` whose interior avoids `e`.

articles.title: First-return loop at a directed edge
articles.statement:
A cyclic sequence `v` is a first-return loop at `e` (avoiding `rev e`) if it starts at `e`, does
not visit `e` again, and never uses the reverse edge `rev e`.

articles.title: First position meeting an edge or its reverse
articles.statement: The first position where `v` meets `e` or `rev e` (`0` if there is none).

articles.title: Sherman's Lemma 5
articles.statement:
If the surgery reverses the sign of loop weights, the loops that visit
both `e` and `rev e` have total weight zero (S. Sherman, *Combinatorial aspects of the Ising model
for ferromagnetism. I*, 1960).

articles.title: Term of the list series: product of weights over length
articles.statement: The term `(∏_{a ∈ l} wt a) / |l|` of the list series, set to `0` on the empty list.

articles.title: Reverse of a closed walk
articles.statement: The reverse of a closed walk: position `k` carries the reverse of the dart at position `-k`.

articles.title: Cyclic sequences visiting two given states
articles.statement: The cyclic sequences of length `n` that visit both `a` and `b`.

articles.title: Weight of a cyclic sequence
articles.statement:
The weight `∏ₖ Λ (v k) (v (k + 1))` of a cyclic sequence `v : Fin n → E`, indices taken modulo
`n`.

articles.title: Positions meeting the reverse of the first hit
articles.statement: The positions where `v` meets the reverse of its entry at `ons_l e rev v`.

articles.title: Last position meeting the reverse of the first hit
articles.statement:
The last position where `v` meets the reverse of its entry at `ons_l e rev v` (`0` if there is
none).

articles.title: Masked darts after pairwise elimination along a list
articles.statement: The set of masked darts after eliminating the darts of a list, pair by pair.

articles.title: Product of first-return factors along a dart elimination
articles.statement:
The product of the factors `1 - λ_e` along a list of darts, each first-return weight `λ_e`
computed with the previously eliminated darts masked.

articles.title: Masked twisted bucket: walks through a dart, not its reverse
articles.statement: As `ons_phaseBucketE`, for the twisted matrix with the darts of `forbidden` masked.

articles.title: Masked twisted bucket: walks avoiding a dart and its reverse
articles.statement: As `ons_phaseBucketN`, for the twisted matrix with the darts of `forbidden` masked.

articles.title: Masked reversible factor
articles.statement: The reversible factor with the rows and columns of `forbidden` set to zero.

articles.title: Matrix bucket: walks through one state avoiding another
articles.statement: The total weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` of `M` that visit `e` but not `r`.

articles.title: Matrix bucket: walks avoiding two given states
articles.statement: The total weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` of `M` that visit neither `e` nor `r`.

articles.title: Mirror position within a segment
articles.statement: The mirror image `l + m - k` of a position `k` in the segment `[l, m]` (truncated to `n - 1`).

articles.title: $1 - z \neq 0$ for $|z| < 1$
Number of sequences with a given orbit representative
articles.statement:
The number of sequences whose chosen orbit representative is `r`; for a representative `r` this
is the size of its rotation orbit, and `0` otherwise.

articles.title: Rotation-orbit equivalence on cyclic sequences
articles.statement:
The rotation-orbit equivalence relation on cyclic sequences: `v ∼ w` when `w` is obtained from
`v` by an iterated rotation.

articles.title: Exponential of minus half the series avoiding a dart and its reverse
articles.statement: The exponential of minus one half of the series of closed walks avoiding `e` and its reverse.

articles.title: Twisted bucket: walks through a dart, not its reverse
articles.statement:
The total twisted Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` visiting `e` but not its
reverse.

articles.title: Twisted bucket: walks avoiding a dart and its reverse
articles.statement:
The total twisted Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` visiting neither `e` nor its
reverse.

articles.title: Chosen representative of a rotation orbit
articles.statement: A chosen representative of the rotation orbit of `v`.

articles.title: Reversal of a segment of a cyclic sequence
articles.statement:
Reversal of the segment `[l, m]` of `v`: positions inside are mirrored and their entries
replaced by their reverses; positions outside are unchanged.

articles.title: Reversible turn matrix on a state space with directions
articles.statement: The matrix `q x y · turnW(dir y, dir x)` on an abstract state space with directions.

articles.title: Cyclic sequences rooted at an edge avoiding its reverse
articles.statement: The cyclic sequences of length `n` that start at `e` and never use `rev e`.

articles.title: Rooted closed walks as lists of first-return segments
articles.statement:
Rooted closed walks at `e` avoiding `r` are equivalent to lists of first-return segments
avoiding `r`, by splitting and gluing.

articles.title: Rooted term: walk weight over its number of first-return factors
articles.statement: The rooted term of a walk: its edge weight divided by its number of first-return factors at `e`.

articles.title: Rotation by $k$ as an equivalence of sequences
articles.statement: Rotation by `k` as an equivalence of `Fin n → E`, with inverse the rotation by `-k`.

articles.title: Rotation of a cyclic sequence by $k$ steps
articles.statement: Rotation of a cyclic sequence by `k` steps: `(ons_rotate k v) j = v (j + k)`.

articles.title: Sherman's convergence radius for the torus Kac-Ward matrix
articles.statement:
The radius `1 / (2 (number of darts)²)` below which Sherman's first-return series for the torus
Kac-Ward matrix converges with total weight below `1`.

articles.title: Walk-series square root of the twisted Kac-Ward determinant
articles.statement:
The walk-series square root of the twisted Kac-Ward determinant with boundary phases `a, b` at
activity `x`.

articles.title: State-weighted reversible turn matrix
articles.statement: The reversible turn matrix with additional row and column weights on states.

articles.title: Loop sum vanishes under a fixed-point-free sign-reversing involution
articles.statement:
A fixed-point-free involution of `S` that reverses the sign of the loop weight forces the loop
weights over `S` to sum to zero. See also `Finset.sum_involution`.

articles.title: Sherman's segment-reversal surgery
articles.statement:
Sherman's surgery: reverse the segment between `ons_l` and `ons_m` when `v` visits both `e` and
`rev e`; otherwise leave `v` unchanged.

articles.title: Product over a tuple equals the product over its list
articles.statement:
The product over a tuple equals the product over the list `List.ofFn p`; see also
`List.prod_ofFn` and `List.map_ofFn`.

articles.title: List of first-return segments avoiding a state
articles.statement: A list of first-return segments at `e`, none of which contains `r`.

articles.title: Rooted closed walk at a state avoiding another
articles.statement:
A rooted closed walk at `e` avoiding `r`: a list starting and ending at `e` that never contains
`r`.

articles.title: Number of visits of a sequence to a state
articles.statement: The number of positions `k` with `v k = e`.

articles.title: Log-coefficient polynomial over the cycles of a decomposition
articles.statement:
The polynomial `∑_C log-coefficient(C) x^{E(C)}` over the cycles `C` of a fixed decomposition of
an even subgraph.

articles.title: Projection of a decorated edge to the torus
articles.statement: The projection of a decorated edge to the torus, taking each dart to its starting site.

articles.title: Decorated edges as formal-series variables
articles.statement: Decorated edges, used as the variables of the formal series.

articles.title: One-edge decorated walk along an external edge
articles.statement: The one-edge decorated walk along the external edge from `d` to its reverse.

articles.title: Formal-logarithm term from closed walks of given length and exponent
articles.statement:
The term of the evaluated formal logarithm from closed walks of length `r + 1` with exponent
`m`, divided by `r + 1` and multiplied by `w^m`.

articles.title: Coefficient of the formal Kac-Ward logarithm
articles.statement:
The coefficient of `x^m` in the formal logarithm: minus one half of the sum over closed walks of
length `r + 1 ≤ deg m` with exponent `m` of their scalars divided by `r + 1`.

articles.title: Formal logarithm of the Kac-Ward root
articles.statement: The formal logarithm of the Kac-Ward root.

articles.title: Vanishing of repeated-edge coefficients of the formal Kac-Ward root
articles.statement:
On every `L × L` torus with `L > 2` and for every spin structure, the coefficient of the formal
Kac-Ward root at any exponent that uses some decorated edge at least twice is zero.

articles.title: Formal Kac-Ward root
articles.statement: The formal Kac-Ward root: the formal exponential of `ons_decFormalLog`.

articles.title: Second difference of a formal series in one variable
articles.statement:
The second difference of a formal series in the variable `edge`: the coefficient at `m` is
multiplied by `2^{m edge} - 2 + 0^{m edge}`.

articles.title: Monomial of a Kac-Ward transition
articles.statement: The monomial of the transition from `d₁` to `d₂`.

articles.title: Externality of a decorated edge
articles.statement: An edge of the decorated graph is external if it joins a dart to its reverse.

articles.title: Exponent of a closed Kac-Ward walk
articles.statement: The exponent of a closed walk: the sum of the exponents of its transitions.

articles.title: External part of a loop exponent
articles.statement: The external part of a loop exponent: one for the external edge at each dart of the loop.

articles.title: Internal part of a loop exponent
articles.statement: The internal part of a loop exponent: the internal edges on the paths between consecutive ports.

articles.title: Rotations of a loop and of its reversal
articles.statement: The `2n` rotations of a loop and of its reversal, indexed by `Fin n ⊕ Fin n`.

articles.title: Darts of a loop with their reverses
articles.statement: The darts of a loop together with their reverses.

articles.title: Scalar of a closed Kac-Ward walk
articles.statement: The scalar of a closed walk: the product of the scalars of its transitions.

articles.title: Masked closed-walk weight through a dart but not its reverse
articles.statement: As `ons_decPhaseBucketE`, with the darts of `forbidden` masked.

articles.title: Masked closed-walk weight avoiding a dart and its reverse
articles.statement: As `ons_decPhaseBucketN`, with the darts of `forbidden` masked.

articles.title: Column-scaled augmented Kac-Ward matrix
articles.statement: The augmented matrix with blocks `Λ₀`, `t U`, `V` and `0` (scaling on the column factor).

articles.title: Column weights of the column-scaled augmented matrix
articles.statement: Column weights of the column-scaled augmented matrix.

articles.title: Row weights of the column-scaled augmented matrix
articles.statement: Row weights of the column-scaled augmented matrix.

articles.title: Closed-walk weight through a dart but not its reverse
articles.statement:
The total decorated-weight Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` visiting `e` but
not its reverse.

articles.title: Closed-walk weight avoiding a dart and its reverse
articles.statement:
The total decorated-weight Kac-Ward weight of closed walks of length `n + 1` visiting neither
`e` nor its reverse.

articles.title: Kac-Ward loops with a given squarefree exponent and nonzero scalar
articles.statement:
The closed Kac-Ward walks of length `n` with exponent the squarefree exponent of `S` and nonzero
scalar.

articles.title: Exponent of a Kac-Ward transition
articles.statement:
The exponent of a transition: one for the external edge at `d₁` and one for each internal edge
on the path at the site of `d₂`.

articles.title: Scalar of a Kac-Ward transition
articles.statement:
The scalar of a transition: its boundary phase times its turn weight, or `0` if `d₂` does not
start at the head of `d₁`.

articles.title: Decorated even subgraphs containing a given external edge
articles.statement: Decorated even subgraphs that contain the external edge at `d`.

articles.title: Cycle removal identity for decorated even subgraphs
articles.statement:
The cycle removal identity: the Kac-Ward root with `d` and its reverse masked, times the total
first-return weight at `d`, equals the sum over decorated even subgraphs through `d` of the
first-return weight of the split-off cycle times the spin weight of the remainder.

articles.title: Chosen split of a decorated even subgraph at an external edge
articles.statement: A chosen split of a decorated even subgraph at the external edge of `d`.

articles.title: Split of a decorated even subgraph into a rooted cycle and remainder
articles.statement:
A split of a decorated even subgraph containing the external edge at `d` into a simple cycle
rooted at `d` (starting along that edge) and an even remainder disjoint from the cycle.

articles.title: Even subgraphs of the decorated torus graph
articles.statement: Even subgraphs of the decorated graph of the torus.

articles.title: External edges of a decorated edge set
articles.statement: The external edges of a decorated edge set.

articles.title: Formal Kac-Ward identity on the torus
articles.statement:
The formal Kac-Ward identity on the `L × L` torus: for every spin structure, the formal Kac-Ward
root equals the decorated spin polynomial.

articles.title: Decorated spin polynomial
articles.statement: The decorated spin polynomial `∑_D χ_{a,b}(hom D) ∏_{e ∈ D} x_e` over decorated even subgraphs.

articles.title: Spin weight of a decorated even subgraph
articles.statement:
The weight `χ_{a,b}(hom F) x^|F|` of the torus even subgraph `F` corresponding to a decorated
even subgraph.

articles.title: Edge-weighted spin weight of a decorated even subgraph
articles.statement:
The edge-weighted spin weight `χ_{a,b}(hom F) ∏_{e ∈ F} w_e` of the torus even subgraph `F`
corresponding to a decorated even subgraph.

articles.title: Degree-$n$ part of a power series evaluated at a point
articles.statement: The sum of the terms of total degree `n` of a series evaluated at `w`.

articles.title: Sum of absolute values of the degree-$n$ terms at a point
articles.statement: The sum of the absolute values of the terms of total degree `n` evaluated at `w`.

articles.title: Homogeneous degree-$n$ part of a power series as a polynomial
articles.statement: The homogeneous degree-`n` part of a series as a polynomial (finitely many variables).

articles.title: Squarefree exponent of a set of variables
articles.statement: The squarefree exponent `∑_{e ∈ S} single e 1` of a set of variables.

articles.title: Total degree of an exponent agrees with Mathlib's degree
articles.statement: `ons_finsuppTotalDegree` agrees with Mathlib's `Finsupp.degree`.

articles.title: Total degree of an exponent
articles.statement: The total degree `∑ m e` of an exponent; this is `Finsupp.degree`.

articles.title: Onsager's formula
articles.statement:
**Onsager's formula** for the zero-field square-lattice Ising model, in the form
`torus pressure → ons_pressure β` for `β ≥ 0` (L. Onsager, *Crystal statistics. I*, 1944). See
`main_free_energy` for the explicit integral.

articles.title: Squarefree exponent
articles.statement: An exponent is squarefree if every variable occurs with exponent at most `1`.

articles.title: Value of a monomial at weights
articles.statement: The value `∏_e w_e ^ {m e}` of the monomial with exponent `m` at weights `w`.

articles.title: Sum of absolute values of an evaluated power series
articles.statement: The sum `∑_m ‖coeff_m · w^m‖` of absolute values.

articles.title: Absolute summability of a power series evaluated at weights
articles.statement: Absolute summability of `∑_m coeff_m · w^m`.

articles.title: Evaluation of a multivariate power series at weights
articles.statement:
Evaluation of a multivariate formal power series at weights, as the sum
`∑_m coeff_m · weight^m`.

articles.title: Torus even subgraph of a decorated even subgraph
articles.statement:
The torus even subgraph corresponding to a decorated even subgraph under the decoration
bijection.

articles.title: Edge weights restricted to a set of edges
articles.statement: The edge weights restricted to `S`: equal to `weight` on `S` and `0` elsewhere.

articles.title: Decorated weights with one edge weight scaled by t
articles.statement: Decorated weights with the weight of `edge` multiplied by `t`.

articles.title: Second-difference factor for a monomial of degree k
articles.statement:
The factor `2^k - 2 + 0^k` by which a second difference multiplies a monomial of degree `k` in
one variable.

articles.title: Sector weight of a homology class as a polynomial
articles.statement: The sector weight of the homology class `h` as a real polynomial in `x`.

articles.title: Spin-character sums squared as twisted determinants at activity $x$
articles.statement:
For every spin structure `(a, b)`, the square of the spin-character sum equals the twisted
Kac-Ward determinant `det (1 - Λ_{ab})` at activity `x`.

articles.title: Sector determinant as a real polynomial
articles.statement: The sector determinant as a real polynomial in `x`.

articles.title: Sector determinant as a function of $x$
articles.statement:
The sector determinant as a function of `x`: the product over shifted momenta of
`(1 + x²)² - 2x(1 - x²)(cos k₁ + cos k₂)`.

articles.title: Four spin Kac-Ward identities on the torus at activity $x$
articles.statement:
The four spin Kac-Ward identities `spin_{ab}(x)² = det_{ab}(x)` on the `L × L` torus at activity
`x`.

articles.title: Signed sector polynomial with the $(1,1)$ sector negated
articles.statement: The signed sector sum `ons_spin00` as a polynomial.

articles.title: Signed sector polynomial with the $(0,1)$ sector negated
articles.statement: The signed sector sum `ons_spin01` as a polynomial.

articles.title: Signed sector polynomial with the $(1,0)$ sector negated
articles.statement: The signed sector sum `ons_spin10` as a polynomial.

articles.title: Signed sector polynomial with only the $(0,0)$ sector positive
articles.statement: The signed sector sum `ons_spin11` as a polynomial.

articles.title: Sherman's radius for $L > 2$, with value 1 otherwise
articles.statement: Sherman's radius for `L > 2`, and `1` otherwise.

articles.title: Even subgraphs of the L × L torus
articles.statement: Even subgraphs of the `L × L` torus.

articles.title: External edges used by a decorated walk
articles.statement: The external edges used by a walk in the decorated graph.

articles.title: Torus edges underlying a decorated walk
articles.statement: The torus edges underlying the external edges of a decorated walk.

articles.title: Edge coefficient identity on the $L \times L$ torus
articles.statement:
The edge coefficient identity on the `L × L` torus: for small weights, the part of the
edge-weighted character sum from even subgraphs through the edge of `e` equals minus the Kac-Ward
root with `e` and its reverse masked, times the total first-return weight at `e`.

articles.title: Edge-weighted root identity on the torus
articles.statement:
The edge-weighted root identity on the `L × L` torus: for every spin structure and every edge
weight bounded by `q` below Sherman's radius, the walk-series square root of the twisted
edge-weighted Kac-Ward determinant equals the edge-weighted character sum.

articles.title: Edge-weighted spin-character sum over even subgraphs
articles.statement:
The edge-weighted spin-character sum `∑_F χ_{a,b}(hom F) ∏_{e ∈ F} w_e` over even subgraphs of
the torus.

articles.title: Weighted character sum over even subgraphs containing an edge
articles.statement: The part of the edge-weighted character sum coming from even subgraphs that contain `edge`.

articles.title: Adjacency of the decorated torus graph
articles.statement: Adjacency of the decorated graph: a dart is joined to its reverse and to its internal neighbors.

articles.title: Internal-edge bits completing port bits at a site
articles.statement:
The internal-edge bits `(b₀, b₀ + b₁, b₀ + b₁ + b₂)` that complete port bits `b₀, …, b₃` at one
site to an even subgraph.

articles.title: Internal edge of the path at a site
articles.statement: The `i`-th internal edge `(s, i) - (s, i + 1)` of the path at a site.

articles.title: Parity condition of the decoration at one site
articles.statement:
Parity of the decorated subgraph at the four darts of one site, for port bits `b₀, …, b₃` and
internal-edge bits `y`.

articles.title: Internal edges between two ports at a site
articles.statement: The internal edges on the path between ports `a` and `b` at a site.

articles.title: Indices of internal edges between two ports
articles.statement: The indices of the internal edges on the path between ports `a` and `b` at one site.

articles.title: Dart list of a rooted decorated cycle
articles.statement: The first-return loop of a rooted decorated cycle without its final repeated dart.

articles.title: Closed dart walk of a rooted decorated cycle
articles.statement: The closed walk of darts of a rooted decorated cycle, indexed by `Fin` of its length.

articles.title: First-return loop of a rooted decorated cycle
articles.statement:
The first-return loop at `d` read off from a decorated cycle rooted at `d`: the root, the
remaining external darts in reverse order, and the root again.

articles.title: Test for a dart traversing an external edge
articles.statement:
Whether a dart of the decorated graph traverses an external edge (from a torus dart to its
reverse).

articles.title: Route points of a decorated edge after its start
articles.statement: The points of the route of a decorated edge after its starting point.

articles.title: Port-pattern bit of an unordered decorated edge
articles.statement: The bit of a decorated edge determined by a port pattern.

articles.title: Interior points of the route of a decorated edge
articles.statement: The three interior points of the route of the decorated edge from `d` to `e`, as micro points.

articles.title: Four finer-torus darts along the route of a decorated edge
articles.statement: The four darts of the finer torus along the route of the decorated edge from `d` to `e`.

articles.title: Step directions of the route of a decorated edge
articles.statement:
The four step directions of the route of the decorated edge from `d` to `e`: straight for an
external edge, an L-shaped turn for an internal edge.

articles.title: Five points of the route of a decorated edge
articles.statement: The five points of the route of the decorated edge from `d` to `e`.

articles.title: Four-step route of a decorated edge in the finer torus
articles.statement: The four-step route of the decorated edge from `d` to `e` in the finer torus.

articles.title: Finer 8L × 8L torus graph for the decorated graph
articles.statement: The `8L × 8L` torus graph in which the decorated graph is drawn.

articles.title: Offset of a dart inside its 8 × 8 cell
articles.statement:
The offset of a dart in direction `μ` inside its `8 × 8` cell: east `(6, 4)`, north `(4, 6)`,
west `(2, 4)`, south `(4, 2)`.

articles.title: Position of a dart in the 8L × 8L torus
articles.statement: The position `8 s + offset(μ)` of the dart `(s, μ)` in the `8L × 8L` torus.

articles.title: Image of a decorated walk in the finer torus
articles.statement:
The image of a decorated walk in the finer torus, obtained by concatenating the routes of its
edges.

articles.title: Expanded dart list of a decorated walk in the finer torus
articles.statement: The darts of the finer torus along the image of a decorated walk.

articles.title: Expanded loop of a decorated cycle in walking order
articles.statement: The expanded dart list of a decorated cycle as a cyclic sequence, in walking order.

articles.title: Expanded loop of a decorated cycle in Kac-Ward order
articles.statement:
The expanded dart list of a decorated cycle as a cyclic sequence in Kac-Ward order (reversed
indexing).

articles.title: First dart of the expanded dart list of a decorated cycle
articles.statement: The first dart of the expanded dart list of a decorated cycle.

articles.title: Darts of a Kac-Ward loop in walking order
articles.statement: The darts of a Kac-Ward loop in walking order (reversed indexing).

articles.title: Head-to-tail relation between darts
articles.statement: Dart `target` starts at the head of dart `source`.

articles.title: Decorated graph of the torus
articles.statement:
The decorated graph of the torus: vertices are darts, external edges join each dart to its
reverse, and internal edges form the path `(s, 0) - (s, 1) - (s, 2) - (s, 3)` at each site `s`.

articles.title: Cell offsets used by interior route points
articles.statement: The offsets inside a cell used by interior points of routes.

articles.title: Internal adjacency of the torus decoration
articles.statement:
Internal adjacency of the decoration: two darts at the same site whose directions are
consecutive in `0, 1, 2, 3`.
