articles.title: Internal neighbors of a dart in the decoration
articles.statement: The internal neighbors of a dart in the path at its site.

articles.title: Decorated weights with internal edges weighted by t
articles.statement: Decorated weights with external edges weighted by their torus edge and internal edges by `t`.

articles.title: Transition exponent sum along a dart chain
articles.statement: The sum of the transition exponents along a chain of darts starting at `start`.

articles.title: Last dart of a dart chain
articles.statement: The last dart of a chain starting at `start`.

articles.title: Closed decorated walk of a valid Kac-Ward loop
articles.statement: The closed decorated walk of a valid closed Kac-Ward walk, rooted at its first dart.

articles.title: Decorated edge whose route passes through an interior micro point
articles.statement: The decorated edge whose route passes through a given interior micro point.

articles.title: Micro point of the finer torus as a cell and an offset
articles.statement: A point of the `8L × 8L` torus given as a coarse cell and an offset in `Fin 8 × Fin 8`.

articles.title: Point of the finer torus represented by a micro point
articles.statement: The point of the finer torus represented by a micro point.

articles.title: Directions of augmented states
articles.statement: Directions of augmented states: the direction of a dart, and east or west for the two sides.

articles.title: Reversal on augmented states
articles.statement: Reversal on augmented states: reverse darts and swap the two sides.

articles.title: Augmented Kac-Ward matrix with two side states
articles.statement:
The augmented Kac-Ward matrix on darts and the two sides of `site`, with blocks `Λ₀`, `U`, `t V`
and `0`.

articles.title: Column weights of the balanced augmented matrix
articles.statement: Column weights of the balanced augmented matrix.

articles.title: Row weights of the balanced augmented matrix
articles.statement: Row weights of the balanced augmented matrix.

articles.title: Balanced augmented Kac-Ward matrix
articles.statement: The augmented matrix with blocks `Λ₀`, `(t λ) U`, `λ⁻¹ V` and `0`.

articles.title: Column weights of the augmented Kac-Ward matrix
articles.statement: Column weights of the augmented matrix: the external weight on darts and `1` on side states.

articles.title: Destination-side internal weight to a port
articles.statement:
The weight of the internal edges between the middle edge and the port of direction `μ`, on the
destination side.

articles.title: Representative direction of a side
articles.statement: The representative direction of a side: east for side `0`, west for side `1`.

articles.title: Reversal-invariant internal factor of the augmented matrix
articles.statement: The reversal-invariant internal factor of the augmented matrix.

articles.title: Row weights of the augmented Kac-Ward matrix
articles.statement:
Row weights of the augmented matrix: `1` on darts and `t` times the middle weight on side
states.

articles.title: Side of a direction at a site
articles.statement: The side of a direction at a site: `0` for east and north, `1` for west and south.

articles.title: Source-side internal weight from a port
articles.statement:
The weight of the internal edges between the port of direction `μ` and the middle edge, on the
source side.

articles.title: Gauge on the states of the augmented matrix
articles.statement:
The gauge on the states of the augmented matrix: the site gauge on darts, and the gauge of
`site` on the two side states.

articles.title: Column factor of the rank-two middle-edge term
articles.statement:
The column factor of the rank-two term: from a side of `site` to the darts leaving `site` on
that side.

articles.title: Row factor of the rank-two middle-edge term
articles.statement:
The row factor of the rank-two term: from the darts entering `site` to the side on which they
arrive.

articles.title: Port-pattern bit of the decorated edge between two darts
articles.statement: The bit of the decorated edge between `d` and `e` determined by a port pattern.

articles.title: Internal path between two ports at a site
articles.statement: The internal path from port `a` to port `b` at a site, as a path in the decorated graph.

articles.title: Internal walk between two ports at a site
articles.statement: A walk along the internal path from port `a` to port `b` at a site.

articles.title: Micro point at which a dart is placed
articles.statement: The micro point at which a dart is placed.

articles.title: Decorated weights induced by torus edge weights
articles.statement:
Decorated weights induced by torus edge weights: external edges get the weight of their torus
edge, internal edges get `1`.

articles.title: Decorated walk of a Kac-Ward transition
articles.statement:
The decorated walk of the Kac-Ward transition from `d₁` to `d₂`: the external edge at `d₁`
followed by the internal path to `d₂`.

articles.title: Decorated weight of a Kac-Ward transition
articles.statement:
The decorated weight of the Kac-Ward transition from `d₁` to `d₂`: the weight of the external
edge at `d₁` times the weights of the internal edges from the port of `d₁ + 2` to the port of `d₂`.

articles.title: Edge multiset of a decorated walk as an exponent
articles.statement: The multiset of edges of a decorated walk, as an exponent.

articles.title: External darts of a decorated walk in order
articles.statement: The torus darts at which a decorated walk traverses an external edge, in order.

articles.title: Decorated walk of a chain of darts
articles.statement:
The decorated walk obtained by concatenating the trails of the transitions along a chain of
darts.

articles.title: Internal-edge bits of a decorated edge set at a site
articles.statement: The three internal-edge bits of a decorated edge set at one site.

articles.title: Even decorated subgraph determined by a port pattern
articles.statement: The even subgraph of the decorated graph determined by a port pattern.

articles.title: Decorated character sum with weights on all edges
articles.statement:
The decorated character sum `∑_D χ_{a,b}(hom D) ∏_{e ∈ D} w_e` with a weight on every decorated
edge.

articles.title: Port bit of a dart in a decorated edge set
articles.statement:
The port bit of a dart in a decorated edge set: whether the external edge at the dart is
present.

articles.title: Equivalence between even decorated subgraphs and port patterns
articles.statement: Even subgraphs of the decorated graph are equivalent to port patterns.

articles.title: Equivalence between even subgraphs of the torus and its decoration
articles.statement: Even subgraphs of the torus are equivalent to even subgraphs of the decorated graph.

articles.title: Diagonal gauge conjugation of a matrix
articles.statement: Diagonal conjugation `gauge i * M i j * (gauge j)⁻¹`.

articles.title: Simple graph spanned by an edge set
articles.statement:
The simple graph on `V` whose edges are the non-loop elements of `F`; this is
`SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet F`.

articles.title: Equivalence between even torus subgraphs and port patterns
articles.statement: Even subgraphs of the torus are equivalent to port patterns.

articles.title: Port pattern of an even subgraph of the torus
articles.statement: The port pattern of an even subgraph of the torus.

articles.title: Torus walk of four lattice steps
articles.statement: The torus walk of four lattice steps in the given directions.

articles.title: Endpoint of four lattice steps
articles.statement: The endpoint of four lattice steps in the given directions.

articles.title: Micro directions along internal decorated edges at a site
articles.statement: The micro directions of the routes along a sequence of internal decorated edges at one site.

articles.title: Twisted Kac-Ward matrix with decorated transition weights
articles.statement: The twisted Kac-Ward matrix with decorated transition weights.

articles.title: Port bit of a dart for a torus edge set
articles.statement:
The bit of a dart in the port pattern of an edge set `F`: `1` if its underlying torus edge lies
in `F`.

articles.title: Internal-edge bits at a site from a port pattern
articles.statement: The internal-edge bits at a site determined by a port pattern.

articles.title: Torus edge underlying a dart
articles.statement: The torus edge underlying a dart.

articles.title: Adjacency of directions along the port line
articles.statement: Two directions are adjacent in the order `0, 1, 2, 3` of the internal path at a site.

articles.title: Torus edge set of a port pattern
articles.statement: The torus edge set of a port pattern.

articles.title: Port pattern of an even decorated subgraph
articles.statement: The port pattern of an even subgraph of the decorated graph.

articles.title: Port pattern on the darts of the torus
articles.statement:
A port pattern: one bit per dart, equal on a dart and its reverse, with an even number of ones
at each site. Port patterns encode even subgraphs of the torus.

articles.title: Seam sign of a dart
articles.statement:
The seam sign
`(-1)^{a · (signed vertical seam crossing) + b · (signed horizontal seam crossing)}` of a dart.

articles.title: Decorated weights twisted by seam signs
articles.statement: Decorated weights with every external edge multiplied by the seam sign of its dart.

articles.title: Spin boundary-phase gauge at a site
articles.statement: The gauge `u^{s₁} v^{s₂}` at site `s`, with `u, v` the spin boundary phases.

articles.title: Directions of the expanded dart list of a decorated walk
articles.statement: The directions of the expanded dart list of a decorated walk.

articles.title: Directions of the external darts of a decorated walk
articles.statement: The directions of the external darts of a decorated walk.

articles.title: Bonds inside the box
articles.statement: The bonds with both endpoints in `Λ_n` (used for the free boundary condition).

articles.title: Bonds touching the box
articles.statement: The bonds with at least one endpoint in `Λ_n` (used for plus and minus boundary conditions).

articles.title: Ordered nearest-neighbour pairs inside the box
articles.statement: Ordered nearest-neighbour pairs with both endpoints in `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Ordered nearest-neighbour pairs touching the box
articles.statement: Ordered nearest-neighbour pairs with at least one endpoint in `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Box $(-n, n)^d$ as a finite set of sites
articles.statement: The box `Λ_n = [-n, n]^d` as a finite set of sites.

articles.title: Increasing clopen events
articles.statement: The increasing clopen events, a π-system generating the Borel σ-algebra.

articles.title: Convexity of the set of DLR states
articles.statement:
The DLR states form a convex set: `a μ₁ + b μ₂` with `a + b = 1` is a DLR state if `μ₁`, `μ₂`
are.

articles.title: Existence of infinite-volume states
articles.statement:
Every sequence of probability measures on configurations has an infinite-volume state, by
Prokhorov compactness.

articles.title: Finite intersections of a family of sets
articles.statement:
The finite intersections of sets from `S` (together with `univ`), a π-system generating the
same σ-algebra.

articles.title: Free-boundary Ising measure in a box
articles.statement: The Ising measure in `Λ_n` with free boundary condition (internal bonds only).

articles.title: Infinite-volume free state as a subsequential weak limit
articles.statement: The free state: a weak subsequential limit of the free-boundary box measures.

articles.title: Box energy with a boundary condition
articles.statement: The box energy `-∑_{e ∈ B} σ_e - h ∑_{x ∈ Λ_n} σ_x` of the configuration `glue η τ`.

articles.title: Finite-volume Gibbs measure on configurations of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement:
The finite-volume Gibbs measure in `Λ_n` with boundary condition `η` and bond set `B`, as a
measure on configurations of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Finite-volume Gibbs probability with a boundary condition
articles.statement:
The finite-volume Gibbs probability of an inside configuration `τ` with boundary condition
`η`.

articles.title: Finite-volume Gibbs measure as a probability measure
articles.statement: The finite-volume Gibbs measure as a `ProbabilityMeasure`.

articles.title: Finite-volume Boltzmann weight with a boundary condition
articles.statement: The Boltzmann weight `exp (-β H)` of an inside configuration `τ` with boundary condition `η`.

articles.title: Finite-volume partition function with a boundary condition
articles.statement: The finite-volume partition function with boundary condition `η`.

articles.title: Consistency of the plus measures under the specification
articles.statement: The plus measures in `Λ_m` are invariant under the specification in every `Λ_n ⊆ Λ_m`.

articles.title: Weighted mixture of two measures
articles.statement: The mixture `a μ⁻ + b μ⁺` of two measures.

articles.title: Configuration glued from inside spins and a boundary condition
articles.statement:
The configuration equal to `τ` inside the box `Λ_n` and to the boundary condition `η`
outside.

articles.title: Uniqueness of the Gibbs state
articles.statement:
For `β, h ≥ 0`, if the plus and minus states agree then
every DLR state that is a probability measure equals the plus state.

S. Friedli and Y. Velenik, *Statistical Mechanics of Lattice Systems*, Cambridge University
Press (2017), Chapter 3.

articles.title: Infinite-volume state of a sequence of measures
articles.statement:
`μ` is an infinite-volume state of the sequence `ρ`: some subsequence of `ρ` converges weakly to
`μ`.

articles.title: DLR state of the Ising model on $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement:
The DLR condition: for every `n`, the conditional distribution of `μ` given the spins outside
the box `Λ_n` equals, for `μ`-almost every `η`, the finite-volume Gibbs measure `fvMeasure η n
(bondFinsetTouch d n) β h` with boundary condition `η`.

articles.title: Ising specification as a Markov kernel
articles.statement: The Ising specification in `Λ_n` as a Markov kernel on the full σ-algebra.

articles.title: Ising specification in a box
articles.statement:
The Ising specification in `Λ_n`: the kernel `η ↦ fvMeasure η n B β h`, measurable with
respect to the spins outside `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Chosen subsequential weak limit of a sequence of measures
articles.statement: A subsequential weak limit of `ρ`, chosen by `exists_infiniteVolumeState`.

articles.title: All-minus configuration
articles.statement: The all-minus configuration.

articles.title: Minus-boundary Ising measure in a box
articles.statement: The Ising measure in `Λ_n` with minus boundary condition.

articles.title: Infinite-volume minus state as a subsequential weak limit
articles.statement: The minus state: a weak subsequential limit of the minus-boundary box measures.

articles.title: $\sigma$-algebra of events determined outside a region
articles.statement: The σ-algebra of events determined by the spins outside `Λ`.

articles.title: Overwriting a configuration on an inner box
articles.statement: The configuration on `Λ_m` obtained from `σ` by overwriting its spins in `Λ_n` with `τ`.

articles.title: All-plus configuration
articles.statement: The all-plus configuration.

articles.title: Plus-boundary Ising measure in a box
articles.statement: The Ising measure in `Λ_n` with plus boundary condition.

articles.title: The plus state is a Gibbs (DLR) state
articles.statement:
For all `β, h`, the plus state of the Ising model
on `ℤ^d` satisfies the DLR condition.

H.-O. Georgii, *Gibbs Measures and Phase Transitions*, de Gruyter (1988), Chapter 4.

articles.title: Infinite-volume plus state as a subsequential weak limit
articles.statement:
The plus state: a weak subsequential limit of the plus-boundary box measures.
Full-sequence convergence is not claimed here: the library only provides this state as a
chosen subsequential limit (see `plusState_isInfiniteVolumeState`).

articles.title: Restriction of a configuration to an inner box
articles.statement: The restriction of a configuration on `Λ_m` to `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Specification applied to a bounded continuous function
articles.statement: The specification applied to a bounded continuous function, as a bounded continuous function.

articles.title: Specification applied to a function
articles.statement: The specification applied to `f`: `η ↦ ∫ f d(fvMeasure η n B β h)`.

articles.title: Stochastic domination on increasing clopen events
articles.statement: `μ ≼c ν`: `μ(A) ≤ ν(A)` for every increasing clopen event `A`.

articles.title: Involution swapping inner-box parts of configuration pairs
articles.statement:
The involution of pairs exchanging the `Λ_n` parts of a configuration on `Λ_m` and a
configuration on `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Stochastic domination implies clopen domination, upper measure finite
articles.statement:
ENNReal stochastic domination gives real-mass clopen domination when the upper measure is
finite.

articles.title: Measurable increasing events of the configuration space
articles.statement: The measurable increasing events of the configuration space.

articles.title: Edge boundary of a set of sites
articles.statement: The edge boundary `∂K`: the lattice edges that straddle `K`.

articles.title: Edge with exactly one endpoint in a set
articles.statement: An edge straddles `K` if exactly one of its endpoints lies in `K`.

articles.title: Hypercubic lattice with the edge boundary removed
articles.statement: The hypercubic lattice with the edges straddling `K` removed.

articles.title: Anchor row of $\ell$ sites in $\mathbb{Z}^2$
articles.statement: The anchor row `{(j, 0) : j < ℓ}` in `ℤ²`.

articles.title: Anchored closed-walk decoding of cluster contours in $\mathbb{Z}^2$
articles.statement:
In `ℤ²`, every connected cluster in `Λ_n` with contour length `ℓ` has its contour decoded from a
closed walk of length `ℓ` based in the anchor row.

articles.title: Bond configuration open on the edges inside a set
articles.statement: The bond configuration that is open exactly on the edges with both endpoints in `K`.

articles.title: Peierls count of connected clusters by contour length
articles.statement:
For every `ℓ`, at most `ℓ (2d)^ℓ` connected clusters through the origin in `Λ_n` have contour
length `ℓ`.

articles.title: Rectangle $(0, m) \times (0, n)$ of sites
articles.statement: The rectangle `[0, m] × [0, n]` of sites in `ℤ²`.

articles.title: Frame of faces around a rectangle
articles.statement: The frame of faces just outside the rectangle `[0, m] × [0, n]`, which supports its contour.

articles.title: Four faces meeting the origin
articles.statement: The four faces meeting the origin, which support the contour of `{0}`.

articles.title: Injective closed-walk encoding of clusters of contour length $\ell$
articles.statement:
The clusters with contour length `ℓ` admit an injective encoding by closed lattice walks of
length `ℓ` based at one of at most `ℓ` anchor sites.

articles.title: Connected clusters in a box with contour length $\ell$
articles.statement: The connected clusters in the box `Λ_n` whose contour has exactly `ℓ` bonds.

articles.title: Sites reachable from the origin after deleting edges
articles.statement:
The set of sites reachable from the origin in the hypercubic lattice after deleting the edges in
`F`.

articles.title: Cluster family: all subsets of the box
articles.statement: The finite sets of sites in `Λ_n` containing the origin.

articles.title: Peierls series bound on the cluster-family contour sum
articles.statement: The sum of `e^{-2β |∂K|}` over the cluster family is at most the Peierls series.

articles.title: Contour event of a set: opposite spins across every crossing bond
articles.statement:
Every bond of `B` crossing the boundary of `K` joins a minus spin inside to a plus spin
outside.

articles.title: Contour length of a set
articles.statement: The number of bonds of `B` crossing the boundary of `K`.

articles.title: Bond variable of a crossing bond
articles.statement: The bond variable of a crossing bond.

articles.title: Contour of a set: bonds crossing its boundary
articles.statement: The bonds of `B` crossing the boundary of `K` (the contour of `K`).

articles.title: Bond crossing the boundary of a set
articles.statement: The bond `e` has exactly one endpoint in `K`.

articles.title: Flipping spins in a set as an involutive equivalence
articles.statement: Flipping the spins in `K` as an involutive equivalence of inside configurations.

articles.title: Inside configuration with the spins in a set flipped
articles.statement: The inside configuration with the spins in `K` flipped.

articles.title: Configuration with the spins in a set flipped
articles.statement: The configuration with the spins in `K` flipped.

articles.title: Minus cluster of the origin as a finite set
articles.statement: The minus cluster of the origin in a plus-boundary box configuration, as a finset.

articles.title: Minus cluster of a site
articles.statement: The minus cluster of `o`: the sites joined to `o` by a path of minus sites.

articles.title: Nearest-neighbour graph on the minus sites
articles.statement: The nearest-neighbour graph on the minus sites.

articles.title: Set of minus sites
articles.statement: The set of minus sites.

articles.title: Probability of the contour event of a set
articles.statement: The probability of the contour event of `K` under the box measure.

articles.title: Connected clusters in the box containing the origin
articles.statement: The connected finite sets of sites in `Λ_n` containing the origin.

articles.title: Peierls series bound on the connected-cluster contour sum
articles.statement: The sum of `e^{-2β |∂K|}` over connected clusters is at most the Peierls series.

articles.title: Connected cluster through the origin in the nearest-neighbour graph
articles.statement: `K` is connected in the nearest-neighbour graph.

articles.title: Nearest-neighbour graph restricted to a set
articles.statement: The nearest-neighbour graph restricted to `K`.

articles.title: Two-site set $\{0, p\}$
articles.statement: The two-site set `{0, p}`.

articles.title: First $\ell$ sites of the first coordinate axis
articles.statement: The axis sites `(j, 0, …, 0)` with `j < ℓ`.

articles.title: Closed-walk decoding of each realised contour from an axis site
articles.statement:
Every realised contour of length `ℓ` is decoded from a closed walk of length `ℓ` based at an
axis site `(j, 0, …, 0)` with `j < ℓ`.

articles.title: Site $(j, 0, \ldots, 0)$ on the first coordinate axis
articles.statement: The site `(j, 0, …, 0)` on the first coordinate axis.

articles.title: Closed-walk decoding of each realised contour from an anchor pool
articles.statement:
Every realised contour of length `ℓ` is decoded from a closed walk of length `ℓ` based at a site
of a common pool of at most `ℓ` anchors.

articles.title: Connected face-boundary graphs at the axis for all connected clusters
articles.statement:
Every connected cluster in `Λ_n ⊆ ℤ²` with contour length `ℓ` is finite, has face-boundary graph
connected on `boundarySupport`, and meets an axis face `(j, 0)` with `j < ℓ`. The condition
refers to the face set `boundarySupport`, which is chosen by `Classical.choose`;
`TightAxisCircuitData` avoids this choice.

articles.title: Primal edges crossed by a closed dual walk
articles.statement: The set of primal edges crossed by a closed dual walk.

articles.title: Two faces flanking an unordered pair of sites
articles.statement: `flankFaces` on unordered pairs of sites.

articles.title: Two faces flanking a primal edge
articles.statement: The two faces of `ℤ²` flanking the primal edge `{p, q}`.

articles.title: Connected face-boundary graphs at the axis for all realised contours
articles.statement:
Every realised contour of length `ℓ` in `Λ_n ⊆ ℤ²` is the contour of a finite cluster whose
face-boundary graph is connected on `boundarySupport` and meets an axis face `(j, 0)` with `j <
ℓ`. The condition refers to the face set `boundarySupport`, which is chosen by
`Classical.choose`.

articles.title: Primal edge crossed by an unordered pair of faces
articles.statement: `symPrimal` on unordered pairs of faces.

articles.title: Primal edge crossed by a dual edge
articles.statement:
The primal edge of `ℤ²` crossed by the dual edge between the faces `f` and `g`, defined
symmetrically in `f` and `g`. See also `sharedPrimalEdge`, with which it agrees on adjacent
faces (`symPrimal_eq_shared`).

articles.title: Component of a face in the face-boundary graph
articles.statement:
The connected component of the face `f` in the face-boundary graph of `K`, as a graph on all
faces.

articles.title: Faces of a set reachable from a face in the face-boundary graph
articles.statement: The faces of `T` reachable from `f` in the face-boundary graph of `K`.

articles.title: Tight axis circuit data: contour edges in one axis-face component
articles.statement:
Every realised contour of length `ℓ` in `Λ_n ⊆ ℤ²` is the contour of a cluster whose
face-boundary graph has all its edges in the component of an axis face `(j, 0)` with `j < ℓ`.

articles.title: Finite face set containing the face-boundary support
articles.statement: A finite set of faces containing the support of the face-boundary graph of a finite set `K`.

articles.title: Degree of a vertex equals the number of edges containing it
articles.statement:
The degree of a vertex is the number of edges containing it. See also
`SimpleGraph.card_incidenceFinset_eq_degree`.

articles.title: Euler's theorem for a graph supported on a finite connected set
articles.statement:
Euler's theorem for a locally finite graph whose support lies in a finite set `T` on which the
induced graph is connected. See also `SimpleGraph.ConnectedSupport.exists_isEulerian` in
`MathlibExt`.

articles.title: Euler's theorem
articles.statement:
**Euler's theorem** (existence direction): a finite connected graph with all degrees even has a
closed trail through every edge, based at any vertex. See also
`SimpleGraph.Connected.exists_isEulerian` in `MathlibExt`, which does not prescribe the base
vertex.

articles.title: Eulerian circuit at any vertex of a finite connected even graph
articles.statement:
The closed trail of `exists_closed_eulerian` is an Eulerian circuit in Mathlib's sense, based
at any prescribed vertex. See also `SimpleGraph.Connected.exists_isEulerian`.

articles.title: Connectedness of the face-boundary graph on a face set
articles.statement: The face-boundary graph of `K` is connected on the finite set of faces `T`.

articles.title: Splicing a closed walk into another at a shared vertex
articles.statement: Splice a closed walk `c` at a vertex `w` of the closed walk `p` into `p`.

articles.title: Hole-free clusters with contour length $\ell$
articles.statement: The hole-free clusters in `Λ_n` through the origin with contour length `ℓ`.

articles.title: Hole-free clusters in the box through the origin
articles.statement: The hole-free clusters in `Λ_n` through the origin.

articles.title: Hole-free connected cluster through the origin
articles.statement: `K` is a connected cluster in `Λ_n` through the origin without holes.

articles.title: Winding hypothesis for outer contours on $\mathbb{Z}^2$
articles.statement:
Every plus-boundary configuration on `Λ_n` with the origin minus has a connected contour
event through the origin whose boundary meets the positive axis within the contour length.

articles.title: Peierls counting bound on realised contours of length $\ell$
articles.statement:
The Peierls counting bound: at most `ℓ (2d)^ℓ` contours of length `ℓ` are realised by connected
clusters in `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Contours of length $\ell$ realised by connected clusters in a box
articles.statement: The contours of length `ℓ` realised by connected clusters in the box `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Assignment of interiors to closed walks of $\mathbb{Z}^2$
articles.statement: An assignment of a set of sites (its interior) to every closed walk of `ℤ²`.

articles.title: Outer contour map: clusters as interiors of boundary circuits
articles.statement:
Every cluster through the origin is the interior of one of its closed boundary circuits, for
some interior assignment.

articles.title: Cycles of length less than $M$ based near the origin
articles.statement: The closed walks of `ℤ²` of length at most `M` based near the origin.

articles.title: Boltzmann weight of a closed walk in the circuit sum
articles.statement: The Boltzmann weight attached to a closed walk in the circuit sum.

articles.title: Twice the Peierls series
articles.statement: Twice the Peierls series.

articles.title: Closed-walk encoding of realised contours of length $\ell$
articles.statement:
Every realised contour of length `ℓ` in `Λ_n` is decoded from a closed lattice walk of length
`ℓ` based at one of at most `ℓ` anchor sites.

articles.title: Global spin flip of a configuration
articles.statement: The global spin flip `σ ↦ -σ` of an infinite-volume configuration.

articles.title: Spin flip inside the box as an involutive equivalence
articles.statement: The spin flip inside the box as an involutive equivalence.

articles.title: Spin flip inside the box
articles.statement: The spin flip of a configuration inside the box `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Finite-volume magnetization at the origin
articles.statement:
The magnetization `⟨σ_0⟩` at the origin in the finite-volume Ising measure on `Λ_n` with
boundary condition `η`, bond set `B`, inverse temperature `β` and field `h`.

articles.title: Origin of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: The origin of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Origin cluster family: finite site sets in the box through the origin
articles.statement: The finite sets of sites in `Λ_n` containing the origin.

articles.title: Peierls series bound on the origin-cluster contour sum
articles.statement: The sum of `e^{-2β |∂K|}` over the origin cluster family is at most the Peierls series.

articles.title: Site $j e_c$ on the $c$-th coordinate axis
articles.statement: The site `j e_c` on the `c`-th coordinate axis.

articles.title: Support of the face-boundary graph of a finite set
articles.statement: The support of the face-boundary graph of a finite set `K`, as a finset.

articles.title: Shift by $(-1, -1)$ as an equivalence of $\mathbb{Z}^2$
articles.statement: The shift by `(-1, -1)` as an equivalence of `ℤ²`.

articles.title: Shift isomorphism: lattice minus barrier edges to face region graph
articles.statement:
The lattice minus the barrier edges of `K` is isomorphic, by the shift by `(-1, -1)`, to the
face region graph of the face-boundary graph of `K`.

articles.title: Shift by $(-1, -1)$ identifying the double dual with $\mathbb{Z}^2$
articles.statement: The shift `x ↦ x - (1, 1)` identifying the dual of the dual lattice with `ℤ²`.

articles.title: Face-boundary graph of a finite set as a planar subgraph
articles.statement: The face-boundary graph of a finite set `K`, as a finite planar subgraph of `ℤ²`.

articles.title: Peierls series
articles.statement: The Peierls series `∑_ℓ ℓ (2d)^ℓ e^{-2βℓ}`.

articles.title: Peierls bound on the probability that the origin is minus
articles.statement:
Under the plus box measure on `Λ_n`, the origin is minus with probability at most
`peierlsBound d β`.

articles.title: Ratio $2d e^{-2\beta}$ of the Peierls series
articles.statement: The ratio `2d e^{-2β}` of the Peierls series.

articles.title: Probability that the origin spin is minus
articles.statement:
The probability that the origin spin is minus under the box measure with boundary condition
`η`.

articles.title: Configuration with only the origin minus
articles.statement: The configuration on `Λ_n` with only the origin minus.

articles.title: Origin-only minus configuration satisfies the filled-cluster data
articles.statement:
A nonvacuity check: the configuration with only the origin minus satisfies the data of
`OuterContourFill`.

articles.title: Filled-cluster winding hypothesis
articles.statement: The filled-cluster form of the winding hypothesis, with a face-connected boundary.

articles.title: Exterior component of the complement of a set
articles.statement: The component of the complement of `S` that contains the outside of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Plus and minus box measures on $\mathbb{Z}^2$ differ for large $\beta$
articles.statement:
Plus and minus box measures on `ℤ²` differ for all `β` beyond some `β₀`. See
`peierls_probOriginMinus_le_uniform` for the informative uniform bound; the inequality of
measures itself holds for every `β > 0`.

articles.title: Peierls bound
articles.statement:
**Peierls bound** on `ℤ²`, uniform in the box: there is `β₀` such that for `β ≥ β₀` the
probability that the origin is minus under the plus-boundary box measure on `Λ_n` is at most
`twoPeierlsBound 2 β`, which is less than `1 / 2` and independent of `n`.

articles.title: Filled minus cluster of the origin as a finite set
articles.statement: The filled minus cluster of the origin, as a finset.

articles.title: Set with its holes filled
articles.statement: The set `S` with its holes filled: the complement of its exterior component.

articles.title: Critical inverse temperature from spontaneous magnetization
articles.statement:
The critical inverse temperature `β_c(d) = inf {β ≥ 0 | m*(β) > 0}` (equal to `0` if the set is
empty, by the convention `sInf ∅ = 0`).

articles.title: FK critical point is less than one for $d \ge 2$, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
The FK critical point satisfies `p_c(d, q) < 1` for `d ≥ 2` and `q ≥ 1` (Grimmett, *The
Random-Cluster Model*, Theorem 5.5).

articles.title: Integrability of the spin at a site under finite measures
articles.statement: The spin at a site is integrable for every finite measure.

articles.title: Inf-based $\beta_c$ equals $-\tfrac{1}{2}\log(1 - p_c)$ for $d \ge 2$
articles.statement:
The public Ising critical inverse temperature `Ising.betaC d` in dimension `d ≥ 2` is
`-(1/2) log (1 - p_c(d, 2))`, the image of the FK critical point. This is the form
usable with `ising_sharp_phase_transition`, whose `β_c` is `Ising.betaC d`.

articles.title: Inf-based and sup-based Ising critical points agree for $d \ge 2$
articles.statement:
Bridge between the two critical-point definitions: the public
`Ising.betaC d = sInf {β ≥ 0 | m*(β) > 0}` equals the sup-based
`IsingFK.betaC (magnetization d) = sSup {β > 0 | m*(β) = 0}` in dimension `d ≥ 2`.
The `β = 0` case is not covered by the phase-transition statement (which only speaks
about `β > 0`), so it is settled separately: `φ_0({0}) = tanh 0 * … = 0 < 1`, hence
the plus-state two-point function at `β = 0` is summable, hence `m*(0) = 0`.

articles.title: Sup-based $\beta_c$ equals $-\tfrac{1}{2}\log(1 - p_c)$ for $d \ge 2$
articles.statement:
The sup-based critical inverse temperature `IsingFK.betaC (magnetization d)` in dimension
`d ≥ 2` is `-(1/2) log (1 - p_c(d, 2))`, the image of the FK critical point. This is the
supremum of the zero-magnetization inverse temperatures, not yet the public
`Ising.betaC d` (see `ising_betaC_eq_sup_betaC_of_two_le` for the bridge).

articles.title: Existence of the Ising phase transition
articles.statement:
**Existence of the Ising phase transition** in dimension `d ≥ 2`: there is `β_c > 0` such that
the spontaneous magnetization vanishes for `0 < β < β_c` and is positive for `β > β_c` (Peierls,
1936; Griffiths, Phys. Rev. 136 (1964); Duminil-Copin, *Lectures on the Ising and Potts models
on the hypercubic lattice*, 2017). The statement says nothing about `β = β_c`.

articles.title: Spontaneous magnetization of the Ising model
articles.statement:
The spontaneous magnetization `m*(β) = ⟨σ_0⟩⁺_β`: the expected spin at the origin under the
zero-field plus state.

articles.title: Measurability of the spin at a site
articles.statement: The spin at a site is a measurable function of the configuration.

articles.title: Inverse temperatures with positive spontaneous magnetization
articles.statement: The set of inverse temperatures `β ≥ 0` at which the spontaneous magnetization is positive.

articles.title: Peierls' theorem
articles.statement:
The two-dimensional Ising model has positive spontaneous magnetization at
some inverse temperature (Peierls, *On Ising's model of ferromagnetism*, 1936; Griffiths, Phys.
Rev. 136 (1964)).

articles.title: Spin at a site as a bounded continuous function
articles.statement: The spin at `x` as a bounded continuous real function on the configuration space.

articles.title: Approximation in measure by events measurable outside every box
articles.statement:
For every box `Λ_k` and `ε > 0`, `s` is `ε`-approximated in `μ`-measure by an event
measurable outside `Λ_k`.

articles.title: Cylinder events of the Ising configuration space
articles.statement: The cylinder events: events depending on the spins in some box.

articles.title: σ-algebra generated by the spins in a finite set
articles.statement: The σ-algebra generated by the spins in the finite set `F`.

articles.title: Nonvacuity of the a.s.-tail theorem via the all-plus Dirac mass
articles.statement:
The hypotheses of `aetc_haeTail` are satisfiable: the Dirac mass at the all-plus
configuration.

articles.title: All-plus Dirac mass gives the all-plus event probability one
articles.statement:
A nonvacuity check: the Dirac mass at the all-plus configuration gives the all-plus event
probability one.

articles.title: Site with its nearest neighbours
articles.statement: The site `x` and its nearest neighbours.

articles.title: Bonds touching a set
articles.statement: The bonds with at least one endpoint in `S`.

articles.title: Set with its nearest neighbours
articles.statement: The sites of `S` together with their nearest neighbours.

articles.title: Energy on a set with a boundary condition
articles.statement: The energy `-∑_{e touching S} σ_e - h ∑_{x ∈ S} σ_x` of `gvGlue η S τ`.

articles.title: Configuration glued from a set and a boundary condition
articles.statement: The configuration equal to `τ` on `S` and to `η` off `S`.

articles.title: Finite-volume Gibbs measure on a finite set
articles.statement: The finite-volume Gibbs measure on the finite set `S` with boundary condition `η`.

articles.title: Overwriting a configuration on an inner set
articles.statement: The configuration on `Sout` obtained by overwriting its spins in `Sin` with `τ`.

articles.title: Finite-volume Gibbs measure with plus boundary condition
articles.statement: The finite-volume Gibbs measure on `S` with plus boundary condition.

articles.title: Gibbs probability on a set with a boundary condition
articles.statement: The Gibbs probability of `τ` on `S` with boundary condition `η`.

articles.title: Restriction of a configuration to an inner set
articles.statement: The restriction of a configuration on `Sout` to `Sin`.

articles.title: Involution swapping inner-set parts of configuration pairs
articles.statement:
The involution exchanging the `Sin` parts of a configuration on `Sout` and a configuration on
`Sin`.

articles.title: Unit vector of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: The unit vector `e_i` of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Boltzmann weight on a set with a boundary condition
articles.statement: The Boltzmann weight of the configuration `τ` on `S` with boundary condition `η`.

articles.title: Partition function on a set with a boundary condition
articles.statement: The partition function on `S` with boundary condition `η`.

articles.title: Boundary bond fraction of a box
articles.statement: The number of bonds touching but not inside `Λ_n`, divided by the number of sites of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Boundary influence bound for the minus box measures
articles.statement:
Shift differences of cylinder-function integrals against the minus box measures are
`O(boundary fraction)`.

articles.title: Boundary influence bound for the plus box measures
articles.statement:
Shift differences of cylinder-function integrals against the plus box measures are
`O(boundary fraction)`.

articles.title: Shift vector $R e_{i_0}$
articles.statement: The vector `R e_{i₀}` of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Box sites as a set and as a finite set
articles.statement: The sites of the box `Λ_n` as a set and as a finset.

articles.title: Ergodicity of the plus state
articles.statement:
For `d ≥ 1` and `β, h ≥ 0`, the plus state is ergodic under
lattice translations.

H.-O. Georgii, *Gibbs Measures and Phase Transitions*, de Gruyter (1988), Chapter 14.

articles.title: Translation invariance of the plus state
articles.statement:
For `β, h ≥ 0`, the plus state of the Ising
model on `ℤ^d` is invariant under all lattice translations.

S. Friedli and Y. Velenik, *Statistical Mechanics of Lattice Systems*, Cambridge University
Press (2017), Chapter 3.

articles.title: Translation as an equivalence onto a translate
articles.statement: Translation by `g` as an equivalence between `S` and its translate.

articles.title: Extreme point of the DLR states
articles.statement:
`μ` is an extreme point of the DLR states: a proper convex decomposition into DLR probability
measures is trivial.

articles.title: Tail event for lattice spin configurations
articles.statement: A tail event: measurable with respect to the spins outside `Λ_n`, for every `n`.

articles.title: Extremality of the plus state
articles.statement:
For `d ≥ 1` and `β, h ≥ 0`, the plus state is an extreme
point of the translation-invariant probability measures.

H.-O. Georgii, *Gibbs Measures and Phase Transitions*, de Gruyter (1988), Chapter 14.

articles.title: Off-centre domination of all-plus events
articles.statement:
For every finite `T` there is `c` such that plus measures on boxes of sizes `m + c` and `m`
compare the all-plus events on `T` and `g⁻¹ T` in both directions.

articles.title: Asymptotic shift homogeneity of all-plus events in plus boxes
articles.statement:
Along `φ`, the plus box measures give the all-plus events on `T` and on `g⁻¹ T`
asymptotically equal probabilities.

articles.title: Continuous functions with decaying shifted integrals
articles.statement:
The continuous functions whose shifted integrals against the plus box measures decay along
`φ`.

articles.title: All-plus monomial as a bounded continuous function
articles.statement: The monomial `ω ↦ ∏_{x ∈ T} 1_{ω_x = +}` as a bounded continuous function.

articles.title: All-plus monomial as a continuous function
articles.statement: The monomial `ω ↦ ∏_{x ∈ T} 1_{ω_x = +}` as a continuous function.

articles.title: Shift homogeneity of all-plus events in the plus state
articles.statement:
The plus state gives the all-plus events on `T` and on `g⁻¹ T` the same probability, for
every finite `T`.

articles.title: Decay of shifted integrals for minus box measures
articles.statement:
Along `φ`, integrals of bounded continuous functions against the minus box measures and their
shifts by `g` become equal.

articles.title: Shifted minus-boundary box measure
articles.statement: The minus-boundary box measure on `Λ_n` pushed forward by the shift `g`.

articles.title: Decay of shifted integrals for plus box measures
articles.statement:
Along `φ`, integrals of bounded continuous functions against the plus box measures and their
shifts by `g` become equal.

articles.title: Shifted plus-boundary box measure
articles.statement: The plus-boundary box measure on `Λ_n` pushed forward by the shift `g`.

articles.title: Plus-spin indicator at a site as a bounded continuous function
articles.statement: The coordinate `ω ↦ 1_{ω_x = +}` as a bounded continuous function.

articles.title: Plus-spin indicator at a site as a continuous function
articles.statement: The coordinate `ω ↦ 1_{ω_x = +}` as a continuous function.

articles.title: Subalgebra of cylinder functions
articles.statement: The subalgebra generated by the spin coordinates (cylinder functions).

articles.title: Cylinder functions as bounded continuous functions
articles.statement: The cylinder functions as bounded continuous functions.

articles.title: Difference between an integral and its shifted version
articles.statement: The difference `∫ f dμ_n - ∫ f ∘ shift_g dμ_n`.

articles.title: Decay of shifted cylinder integrals for minus box measures
articles.statement: Shifted integrals of cylinder functions against the minus box measures decay along `φ`.

articles.title: Decay of shifted cylinder integrals for plus box measures
articles.statement: Shifted integrals of cylinder functions against the plus box measures decay along `φ`.

articles.title: Surface count of a box
articles.statement: The surface count `2d (2n + 1)^{d - 1}` of the box `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Edge-volume count of a box
articles.statement: The edge-volume count `d (2n + 1)^d` of the box `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Pointwise limits of convex maps are convex with one-sided derivatives
articles.statement:
A pointwise limit `g` of convex functions on `ℝ` is convex; its one-sided derivatives exist,
are
monotone, are one-sided limits of slopes, and agree off a countable set; slopes of the
approximants converge to slopes of `g`.

articles.title: Pointwise convergence of box centered free energies
articles.statement: The centered free energies of the boxes `Λ_n` converge pointwise to `G`, and `G(0) = 0`.

articles.title: Centered free energy of a graph
articles.statement:
The centered free energy `F_G(t) - F_G(0)`, with `F_G = ivp2_ambientTiltLogZ G q`.
In the FK range `q > 0`, the ambient non-edge offset cancels in this difference.

articles.title: Wired centered free energy
articles.statement:
The wired centered free energy, obtained by subtracting
`wpd_wiredAmbientTiltLogZ G bdry q 0` from its value at `t`. In the FK range `q > 0`,
the ambient non-edge offset cancels.

articles.title: Adding edges within a vertex set drops components by at most its size
articles.statement:
Adding edges with both endpoints in `{v | p v}` lowers the number of connected components by at
most `|{v | p v}|`. See also `card_connectedComponent_le_sup_fromEdgeSet` (`EdgeMarginal`) for
the
bound by the number of added edges.

articles.title: Convex function has equal one-sided derivatives off a countable set
articles.statement: A convex function on `ℝ` has equal left and right derivatives off a countable set.

articles.title: Set where coupled measures differ is countable under a convex pressure
articles.statement:
The set of parameters at which `μ p` and `ν p` differ on some increasing event is countable,
under the hypotheses of `fk_uniqueness_of_pressure_convex`.

articles.title: Free edge densities on a box as left derivatives
articles.statement:
The free `q = 2` density of every edge of `Λ_N` at `p = logistic(t)` is the left derivative of
`g`
at `t`.

articles.title: Wired edge densities on a box as right derivatives
articles.statement:
The wired `q = 2` density of every edge of `Λ_N` at `p = logistic(t)` is the right derivative
of
`g` at `t`.

articles.title: Wired edge densities on a box bounded by right derivatives
articles.statement:
The wired `q = 2` density of every edge of `Λ_N` at `p = logistic(t)` is at most the right
derivative of `g` at `t`.

articles.title: Coupled measures agree off a countable set, given a convex pressure
articles.statement:
If `μ p` and `ν p` are monotonically coupled, the edge density of `ν p` at `e` is the right
derivative of a convex `g`, and all edge marginals agree wherever that density is continuous in
`p`, then `μ p` and `ν p` agree on every increasing event for `p` off a countable set.

articles.title: Box-edge marginal uniqueness off a countable set under tilt data
articles.statement:
Under `FKSecantData`, at `q = 2` there is a countable set `S` of parameters off which every
measure `φ` whose box-edge marginal lies between the free and wired ones has the same marginal
as both.

articles.title: Edge-marginal uniqueness off a countable set from convex free energy
articles.statement:
Under `fsc_FreeEnergyData`, at `q = 2` there is a countable set `S` of parameters off which
every measure `φ` whose box-edge marginal lies between the free and wired ones has the same
marginal as both.

articles.title: Finite-volume tilt data for a box edge at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
Finite-volume tilt data for the box edge `eb` at `q = 2`: volumes `V n → ∞` and surface
terms `S n = o(V n)` such that, for all `p' < p` in `(0, 1)` and `ε > 0`,
`ε ≤ 2 ^ (S n) λ ^ ((θ^w(p') - θ^f(p) - 2ε) V n) / ε` with `λ = tiltFactor p p'`, where `θ^w` and
`θ^f` are the wired and free infinite-volume densities of the edge.

articles.title: Collapse of average edge densities to the free density
articles.statement:
The average edge densities of the graphs `Gn n` converge to the free infinite-volume `q = 2`
density of every edge of `Λ_N`, at every `t`.

articles.title: Average edge density of the $q = 2$ random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The average edge density `|E|^{-1} E_{φ_{G,p,2}}[#open edges]` at `p = logistic(t)`.

articles.title: Infinite-volume edge densities as one-sided derivatives
articles.statement:
The wired and free `q = 2` infinite-volume densities of every edge of `Λ_N` at `p =
logistic(t)`
are the right and left derivatives of `g` at `t`.

articles.title: Softplus is convex with both one-sided derivatives logistic
articles.statement:
Softplus is a convex function whose one-sided derivatives are both `fsc_logistic`, so the
derivative conditions in `fsc_FreeEnergyData` can hold for some convex function.

articles.title: Convex free-energy hypothesis for a box edge at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
The convex free-energy hypothesis for the box edge `eb` at `q = 2`: some convex `g` has
right derivative `t ↦ θ^w(fsc_logistic t)` and left derivative `t ↦ θ^f(fsc_logistic t)`, the wired
and free infinite-volume densities of the edge.

articles.title: Logistic function equals the sigmoid
articles.statement: The logistic map is Mathlib's `Real.sigmoid`.

articles.title: Logistic function $e^t/(1+e^t)$
articles.statement:
The logistic map `t ↦ eᵗ / (1 + eᵗ)`, equal to Mathlib's `Real.sigmoid`
(`fsc_logistic_eq_sigmoid`).

articles.title: Logit function $\log(p/(1-p))$
articles.statement: The logit `p ↦ log (p / (1 - p))`, inverse to `fsc_logistic` on `(0, 1)`.

articles.title: Convex free energy gives wired density at $p'$ at most free at $p > p'$
articles.statement:
Under `fsc_FreeEnergyData`, the wired edge density at `p'` is at most the free edge density
at `p` whenever `p' < p`.

articles.title: Softplus function $\log(1+e^t)$
articles.statement: The softplus function `t ↦ log (1 + eᵗ)`.

articles.title: Tilt data give wired density at $p'$ at most free density at $p > p'$
articles.statement:
Under `FKSecantData`, the wired edge density at `p'` is at most the free edge density at
`p` whenever `p' < p`.

articles.title: Convexity of the ambient tilted log normalizer
articles.statement: The finite-volume ambient tilted log normalizer is convex in `t`.

articles.title: Ambient tilted log normalizer of a finite graph
articles.statement:
The ambient logit normalizer `|E|⁻¹ log (fkZ G p q) + log (1 + eᵗ)`,
with `p = fsc_logistic t`. For `|E| > 0`, the added term removes the Bernoulli denominator,
not the unused-coordinate factor in `fkZ`. At zero edges this definition uses totalized
real division and equals `log (1 + eᵗ)`; no per-edge physical interpretation is intended.

articles.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for weighted exponential sums
articles.statement: Cauchy–Schwarz for the exponential sums: `S₁² ≤ S₂ S₀`.

articles.title: Pointwise limits of convex functions are convex
articles.statement: A pointwise limit of convex functions on `ℝ` along a nontrivial filter is convex.

articles.title: Convexity of log-sum-exp with nonnegative nonzero weights
articles.statement: A cumulant generating function is convex.

articles.title: Log-sum-exp cumulant generating function
articles.statement:
The log-sum-exp function `K(t) = log ∑_i w_i e^{a_i t}`, the cumulant generating function of
`a` under the weights `w`.

articles.title: Limits of ambient tilted log normalizers are convex
articles.statement:
Every pointwise limit of finite-volume ambient tilted log normalizers along a nontrivial filter
 is convex.

articles.title: First moment exponential sum
articles.statement: The first moment sum `S₁(t) = ∑_i w_i a_i e^{a_i t}`, the derivative of `S₀`.

articles.title: Second moment exponential sum
articles.statement: The second moment sum `S₂(t) = ∑_i w_i a_i² e^{a_i t}`, the derivative of `S₁`.

articles.title: Weighted exponential sum
articles.statement: The exponential sum `S₀(t) = ∑_i w_i e^{a_i t}`.

articles.title: Continuity in $p$ of the Bernoulli edge weight
articles.statement: The Bernoulli edge weight of a fixed configuration is continuous in `p`.

articles.title: Monotonicity in $p$ of free $q = 2$ edge marginals on a finite graph
articles.statement: The edge marginal of the free `q = 2` FK measure on a finite graph is monotone in `p`.

articles.title: Continuity in $t$ of free $q = 2$ edge marginals on a finite graph
articles.statement: The edge marginal of the free `q = 2` FK measure on a finite graph is continuous in `t`.

articles.title: Left-continuity of the free $q = 2$ edge density in $t$
articles.statement: The free infinite-volume `q = 2` edge density is left-continuous in `t`.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ edge density is monotone in $t$
articles.statement: The free infinite-volume `q = 2` edge density is monotone in `t`.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ edge density is monotone in $p$ on $(0, 1)$
articles.statement: The free infinite-volume `q = 2` edge density is monotone in `p ∈ (0, 1)`.

articles.title: Continuity of the logistic map
articles.statement: The logistic map `t ↦ e^t / (1 + e^t)` is continuous. It equals Mathlib's `Real.sigmoid`.

articles.title: Continuity in $t$ of wired $q = 2$ edge marginals on a finite graph
articles.statement: The edge marginal of the wired `q = 2` FK measure on a finite graph is continuous in `t`.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ edge density is monotone in $t$
articles.statement: The wired infinite-volume `q = 2` edge density is monotone in `t`.

articles.title: Right-continuity of the wired $q = 2$ edge density in $t$
articles.statement: The wired infinite-volume `q = 2` edge density is right-continuous in `t`.

articles.title: Derivative marginals of a convex pressure agree off a countable set
articles.statement:
If two families of edge marginals are the left and right derivatives of a convex `g`, they
differ only on a countable set of parameters.

articles.title: Left derivative of a convex function is at most the right one
articles.statement: `g'₋(x) ≤ g'₊(x)`; Mathlib's `ConvexOn.leftDeriv_le_rightDeriv_of_mem_interior` on `univ`.

articles.title: Left derivative of the pressure
articles.statement: The left derivative `g'₋(x) = derivWithin g (Iio x) x`.

articles.title: Right derivative of the pressure
articles.statement:
The right derivative `g'₊(x) = derivWithin g (Ioi x) x`, the form used by Mathlib's
`ConvexOn.monotoneOn_rightDeriv`.

articles.title: Tilted finite-volume bounds for all $\varepsilon > 0$ force $b \le a$
articles.statement:
If for every `ε > 0` the bound `ε ≤ q ^ (S n) λ ^ ((b - a - 2ε) V n) / ε` holds for all
`n`, with `V n → ∞` and `S n = o(V n)`, then `b ≤ a`.

articles.title: Volume-growth lemma for tilted finite-volume bounds
articles.statement:
If `ε ≤ q ^ (S n) λ ^ (m V n) / ε` for all `n`, with `q ≥ 1`, `0 < λ < 1`, `V n → ∞` and
`S n / V n → 0`, then `m ≤ 0`.

articles.title: Ambient tilted log normalizer ignores the decidability instance
articles.statement:
The per-edge ambient tilted log normalizer does not depend on the decidability instance of the
  adjacency
relation.

articles.title: Non-bulk edge fraction bound from a boundary bound on their count
articles.statement:
If the non-bulk edges of `Λ_n` number at most `C` times the boundary of `Λ_n`, their fraction
is at most `C` times the boundary-to-edge ratio.

articles.title: Limits of tilted log normalizers on a fixed box are attained
articles.statement:
A limit of per-edge ambient tilted log normalizers of graphs on the fixed box `Λ_N` is attained
  by one of the
graphs.

articles.title: A limit shared with growing boxes is one fixed-box graph's value
articles.statement:
If graphs on the fixed box `Λ_N` and the growing boxes `Λ_n` have the same limiting per-edge
ambient tilted log normalizer `g t`, then `g t` is the ambient tilted log normalizer of a single
  graph on `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Tilted log normalizers on a fixed box take finitely many values
articles.statement:
The per-edge ambient tilted log normalizers of a sequence of graphs on the fixed box `Λ_N` take
  finitely many
values.

articles.title: Free-wired log-normalizer gap $\le |\partial|\log q/|E|$ for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the free and wired per-edge ambient tilted log normalizers differ by at most `|∂|
 log q / |E|`.

articles.title: Average wired density collapse at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
Average wired density collapse: for every edge `e'` of `Λ_N` and every `t`, the average wired
edge density of `Λ_n` converges to the wired infinite-volume density of `e'`.

articles.title: Average wired edge density as the mean of edge marginals
articles.statement: The average wired edge density is the mean of the wired edge marginals.

articles.title: Average wired edge density
articles.statement: The average wired edge density `|E|⁻¹ E^w[|ω|]` at `p = e^t / (1 + e^t)`.

articles.title: Convexity of the wired tilted log normalizer
articles.statement: The wired ambient tilted log normalizer is convex in `t`.

articles.title: Wired tilted log normalizer as a cumulant generating function
articles.statement:
The wired ambient tilted log normalizer is `|E|⁻¹` times the cumulant generating function of the
  number of open
edges under the weight `q^{k^w}`.

articles.title: Wired tilted log normalizer has derivative the mean open fraction
articles.statement:
The derivative in `t` of the wired ambient tilted log normalizer is `|E|⁻¹` times the expected
  number of open
edges under the wired FK measure.

articles.title: Wired per-edge ambient tilted log normalizer
articles.statement:
The wired per-edge ambient tilted log normalizer `|E|⁻¹ log Z^w(p, q) + log(1 + e^t)` at `p =
 e^t / (1 + e^t)`.

articles.title: Tilted mean of open edges equals the wired FK expectation
articles.statement: The tilted mean of the number of open edges is its wired FK expectation.

articles.title: Expected wired open-edge count is the sum of edge marginals
articles.statement: The expected number of open edges is the sum of the edge marginals.

articles.title: Expectation under the wired FK measure
articles.statement: The expectation of an observable under the wired FK measure.

articles.title: Wired and free FK weights within a factor $q^{|\partial|}$, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the wired FK weight is at most the free one, and the free one is at most
`q^{|∂|}` times the wired one.

articles.title: Sandwich $Z^w \le Z \le q^{|\partial|} Z^w$ for $q \ge 1$
Wired partition function at logistic $p$ as a tilted sum
articles.statement:
The wired partition function at `p = e^t / (1 + e^t)` as a tilted sum over configurations
divided by `(1 + e^t)^{|E|}`.

articles.title: First-order transition from $\theta^0 = 0$ and $\theta^1 > 0$
articles.statement: Introduction rule for `IsFirstOrderTransition`.

articles.title: Free percolation probability is at most one
$\theta^0 \ne \theta^1$ at a first-order transition
articles.statement: At a first-order transition, `θ⁰(p, q) ≠ θ¹(p, q)`.

articles.title: Nonnegativity of the free percolation probability
Free percolation probability
articles.statement:
The free percolation probability `θ⁰(p, q)`: the free infinite-volume measure of the event that
the origin lies in an infinite open cluster.

articles.title: Free and wired measures differ at a first-order transition
articles.statement: At a first-order transition, the free and wired infinite-volume measures differ.

articles.title: First-order transition of the random-cluster model
articles.statement:
A first-order transition at `(p, q)`: the free measure does not percolate, `θ⁰(p, q) = 0`, while
the wired one does, `θ¹(p, q) > 0`.

articles.title: Free and wired measures differ at $\sqrt{q}/(1+\sqrt{q})$ for $q > 4$ if first order
articles.statement:
`order_transition_q_large` at the self-dual point `p_sd(q) = √q / (1 + √q)` of `ℤ²`, with
`θ⁰(p_sd, q) = 0` and `θ¹(p_sd, q) > 0` assumed.

articles.title: Free and wired measures differ at self-dual $p$ for $q > 4$ if first order
articles.statement:
At a point `p ∈ (0, 1)` given as the self-dual point on `ℤ²`, the hypotheses `θ⁰ = 0`
and `θ¹ > 0` give a first-order transition with distinct free and wired measures. The
first-order property for `q > 4` (Duminil-Copin et al., 2021) is assumed, not proved;
`4 < q` is only used to get `q > 0`.

articles.title: Wired percolation above the random-cluster critical point
articles.statement: Above the critical point the wired measure percolates: `θ¹(p, q) > 0` for `p > p_c(q, d)`.

articles.title: Free percolation above $p_c$ from monotonicity and countable agreement
articles.statement:
For `p > p_c(q, d)`, the free measure percolates, `θ⁰(p, q) > 0`, assuming monotonicity of the
free measures in `p` on `(p_c, p)` (`hmono`) and `θ⁰ = θ¹` off a countable set (`hagree`).

articles.title: Free percolation from domination and free–wired agreement at $p'$
articles.statement:
If `p_c < p'`, the free measure at `p'` is dominated by the free measure at `p`, and `θ⁰(p', q)
= θ¹(p', q)`, then `θ⁰(p, q) > 0`.

articles.title: The percolation event is increasing
articles.statement: The percolation event is increasing.

articles.title: Measurability of the percolation event
articles.statement: The percolation event is measurable.

articles.title: No percolation for $p \le p_c$ at $q = 2$, given $\theta^1(p_c, 2) = 0$
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, if `θ¹(p_c, 2) = 0`, then `θ¹(p, 2) = 0` for
every `p ≤ p_c(2, d)`.

articles.title: No percolation below the critical point at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, there is no percolation below the critical point: `θ¹(p, 2) = 0` for `p < p_c(2,
d)`.

articles.title: Wired box-boundary connection probability is monotone in $p$ at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, the wired infinite-volume probability that the origin is connected to the boundary
of the box of radius `n` is monotone in `p`.

articles.title: Monotonicity of $\theta^1(p, 2)$ in $p$
articles.statement: For `q = 2`, the wired percolation probability `θ¹(p, 2)` is monotone in `p`.

articles.title: Box edge with a lattice-edge image is a box-graph edge
articles.statement: A box edge whose image is a lattice edge is an edge of the box graph.

articles.title: Open self-avoiding walk in a box gives $m$ distinct open box edges
articles.statement:
An open self-avoiding walk of `m` steps that lies in the box gives `m` distinct box edges that
are all open.

articles.title: Extended box configuration keeps box edge states
articles.statement: Extending a box configuration to `ℤ^d` keeps the state of box edges.

articles.title: Event of an open self-avoiding walk of $m$ steps
articles.statement: The event that some self-avoiding walk of `m` steps from the origin is open.

articles.title: Padding a finite lattice word to an infinite word
articles.statement: Extend a word of `m` lattice steps to an infinite word by a fixed padding step.

articles.title: Positive random-cluster critical point for $d \ge 2$, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: `fkPc_pos` for `d ≥ 2`.

articles.title: Positivity of the random-cluster critical point
articles.statement:
For `d ≥ 1` and `q ≥ 1`,
`0 < p_c(q, d)`; in fact `p_c(q, d) ≥ 1 / (4d)`.

Reference: G. Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, Springer (2006), Section 5.1.

articles.title: Bernoulli probability that edges $F$ are all open is $p^{|F|}$
articles.statement:
Under Bernoulli percolation on a finite graph, a set `F` of edges is open with probability
`p^|F|`.

articles.title: Subcritical set is bounded above by one
articles.statement: The set of `p` with `θ¹(p, q) = 0` is bounded above by `1`.

articles.title: No wired percolation for $2dp < 1$ and $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: For `q ≥ 1` and `2dp < 1`, there is no percolation in the wired measure: `θ¹(p, q) = 0`.

articles.title: Wired percolation bound $\theta^1(p, q) \le (2dp)^m$ for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: For `q ≥ 1`, the wired percolation probability satisfies `θ¹(p, q) ≤ (2dp)^m` for every `m`.

articles.title: Event of some open self-avoiding walk is clopen
articles.statement: The open-walk event is clopen.

articles.title: Single-edge open event is clopen
articles.statement: The event that a given edge is open is clopen.

articles.title: Event that a given walk is open is clopen
articles.statement: The event that a given walk is open is clopen.

articles.title: Event of some open self-avoiding walk is increasing
articles.statement: The open-walk event is increasing.

articles.title: Event that a given walk is open is increasing
articles.statement: The event that a given walk is open is increasing.

articles.title: Subcritical parameters are at most the critical point
articles.statement: Every subcritical `p` is at most `p_c(q, d)`.

articles.title: Wired cluster count is antitone
articles.statement: The wired cluster count `k¹(ω)` is antitone in `ω`.

articles.title: Monotonicity of the open subgraph
articles.statement: The open subgraph is monotone in the configuration.

articles.title: Bernoulli bound $p^m$ for a fixed self-avoiding walk in the box
articles.statement:
Under Bernoulli percolation on the box, a fixed self-avoiding walk of `m` steps is open with
probability at most `p^m`.

articles.title: Percolation gives open self-avoiding walks of every length
articles.statement: Percolation from the origin implies an open self-avoiding walk of every length `m`.

articles.title: Open edges of an extended box configuration are box edges
articles.statement: An edge that is open in an extended box configuration is a box edge.

articles.title: Boolean-configuration sum of a coordinatewise product factorizes
articles.statement:
Summing a product of single-coordinate factors over all Boolean configurations: coordinates
outside `s` contribute a factor `2` each.

articles.title: Wired box bound $(2dp)^m$ on the open-walk event for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: For `q ≥ 1`, the wired box measure of the open-walk event is at most `(2dp)^m`.

articles.title: Wired box measure as a finite sum over box configurations
articles.statement: The wired box measure of an event, as a finite sum over box configurations.

articles.title: Holley cross inequality for wired and $q = 1$ laws, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
Holley cross inequality between the ambient wired probability and the ambient `q = 1`
law, for `q ≥ 1`. The latter is Bernoulli-`p` only on the graph-edge marginal.

articles.title: Wired law at most the $q = 1$ law on increasing events, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the ambient wired law is dominated by `fkProb G p 1` on increasing events.
The latter is Bernoulli-`p` on graph edges and uniform on loops and nonedges; the comparison
with ordinary Bernoulli percolation therefore applies to graph-edge events.

articles.title: Holley cross inequality for wired and Bernoulli weights, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
Holley cross inequality between the wired random-cluster weight and the Bernoulli product
weight, for `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Monotonicity of the wired graph
articles.statement: The wired graph (open edges plus the boundary clique) is monotone in the configuration.

articles.title: Beffara–Duminil-Copin theorem, conditional form
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, if the wired random-cluster
measure on `ℤ²` does not percolate for `p < √q / (1 + √q)` (`hNoPercBelow`) and percolates for
`p > √q / (1 + √q)` (`hPercAbove`), then `p_c(q) = √q / (1 + √q)`.

The two hypotheses are the content of the Beffara–Duminil-Copin theorem; this statement only identifies the supremum defining `p_c(q)` once they hold. They are true for
every `q ≥ 1`, so the statement is not vacuous.
(V. Beffara and H. Duminil-Copin, *The self-dual point of the two-dimensional random-cluster
model is critical for q ≥ 1*, Probab. Theory Related Fields 153, 2012.)

articles.title: $p_c(q)$ equals the self-dual point if percolation starts there, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
If `θ(r, q) = 0` for `r < p_sd(q)` and `θ(r, q) > 0` for `r > p_sd(q)`, then
`p_c(q) = p_sd(q)`.

articles.title: Critical parameter $p_c(q)$ of the random-cluster model
articles.statement:
The critical parameter `p_c(q) = sup {p ∈ (0, 1) : θ(p, q) = 0}` of the random-cluster model on
`ℤ^d` (equal to `0` when the set is empty, e.g. for `q ≤ 0`).

articles.title: Non-percolating parameters of the wired random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The parameters `p ∈ (0, 1)` at which the wired measure does not percolate (`θ(p, q) = 0`).

articles.title: Wired random-cluster percolation probability $\theta(p, q)$
articles.statement:
The percolation probability `θ(p, q) = φ^1_{p,q}(0 ↔ ∞)` of the wired infinite-volume
random-cluster measure on `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Closed-circuit event of a dual circuit
articles.statement: The event that every primal edge crossed by the dual circuit `c` is closed.

articles.title: Non-percolation means the origin's cluster is finite
articles.statement: No percolation from the origin means the cluster of the origin is finite.

articles.title: Finite cluster in $\mathbb{Z}^2$ gives a closed lattice circuit
articles.statement:
A finite open cluster of `o` in `ℤ²` is surrounded by a lattice cycle whose crossed primal edges
are all closed.

articles.title: Finite cluster in $\mathbb{Z}^2$: closed circuit, separated point, odd crossings
articles.statement:
The closed circuit of `exists_closed_latticeCircuit_of_finite_cluster`, together with a point
that the cluster boundary separates from `o` and an odd crossing number for every walk to it.

articles.title: Finite subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^2$ miss far points on each row
articles.statement: A finite set of `ℤ²` misses some point `(N, c)` with `N ≥ a₀` on every horizontal line.

articles.title: Peierls series is below 1 on an interval $(p_0, 1)$
articles.statement: The Peierls series is below `1` on an interval `(p₀, 1]`.

articles.title: Finite cluster in $\mathbb{Z}^2$ has a reachable point outside it
articles.statement: A finite cluster of `o` has a lattice-reachable point outside it.

articles.title: Finite-cluster event is covered by closed-circuit events
articles.statement: The event that the cluster of `o` is finite is covered by the closed-circuit events.

articles.title: Peierls bound hypothesis for the wired measure on $\mathbb{Z}^2$
articles.statement:
The Peierls bound for the wired random-cluster measure on `ℤ²` at `(p, q)`:
`1 - θ¹(p, q) ≤ Σ_ℓ ℓ 4^ℓ (1 - p)^ℓ`.

articles.title: $p_c(q) < 1$ on $\mathbb{Z}^2$ for $q \ge 1$ under a Peierls bound
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the random-cluster critical point on `ℤ²` satisfies `p_c(q) < 1`, assuming the
Peierls bound `FkNonPercolationBound` for all `p` in some interval `(p₀, 1)`.

articles.title: $0 < p_c(q) < 1$ on $\mathbb{Z}^2$ for $q \ge 1$ under a Peierls bound
articles.statement: For `q ≥ 1`, `0 < p_c(q) < 1` on `ℤ²`, assuming the Peierls bound as in `fkPc_lt_one`.

articles.title: Defining formula for the Peierls ratio
articles.statement: Unfolding `fkPcRatio`.

articles.title: Peierls ratio $2d(1-p)$ tends to $0$ as $p \to 1$
Ratio $2d(1-p)$ of the Peierls series
articles.statement: The ratio `2d (1 - p)` of the Peierls series.

articles.title: Peierls summand as $\ell x^\ell$ with $x = 2d(1-p)$
articles.statement: The Peierls summand in terms of `fkPcRatio`.

articles.title: Closed form $x/(1-x)^2$ of the Peierls series for $|x| < 1$
articles.statement: Closed form `x / (1 - x)²` of the Peierls series for `|x| < 1`, where `x = 2d (1 - p)`.

articles.title: Nonnegativity of the Peierls series for $p \le 1$
articles.statement: The Peierls series is nonnegative for `p ≤ 1`.

articles.title: Peierls series tends to $0$ as $p \to 1$
articles.statement: The Peierls series tends to `0` as `p → 1`.

articles.title: Peierls series for $d = 2$ equals the Bernoulli Peierls series
articles.statement:
The Peierls series for `d = 2` is the Bernoulli Peierls series
`StatMech.Percolation.pcUpperBound`.

articles.title: Peierls series $\sum_\ell \ell\,(2d)^\ell (1-p)^\ell$
articles.statement: The Peierls series `Σ_ℓ ℓ (2d)^ℓ (1 - p)^ℓ` bounding the probability of a finite cluster.

articles.title: Nonempty subcritical set on $\mathbb{Z}^2$ for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: For `q ≥ 1` the subcritical set on `ℤ²` is nonempty (it contains `1/8`).

articles.title: Percolation from a Peierls bound with series below 1
articles.statement: The Peierls bound with a series below `1` gives percolation: `0 < θ¹(p, q)`.

articles.title: Horizontal lattice walk in $\mathbb{Z}^2$
articles.statement: The horizontal lattice walk of `k` steps from `(a, c)` to `(a + k, c)` in `ℤ²`.

articles.title: Positive percolation probability rules out subcriticality
articles.statement: A parameter with positive percolation probability is not subcritical.

articles.title: Planar dual parameter $p^{\ast}$
articles.statement:
The planar dual parameter `p* = (1 - p) q / ((1 - p) q + p)`, characterized by
`p* p / ((1 - p*)(1 - p)) = q`.

articles.title: Self-dual point $p_{sd}(q) = \sqrt q/(1 + \sqrt q)$
articles.statement: The self-dual point `p_sd(q) = √q / (1 + √q)`.

articles.title: Vertex coloring induced by a coloring of open clusters
articles.statement: The coloring of the vertices obtained from a coloring `τ` of the open clusters of `ω`.

articles.title: Compatibility of a coloring with a bond configuration
articles.statement:
A coloring `σ` is compatible with the bond configuration `ω` if every open edge of `G` joins
vertices of the same color. See also `FK.ConstOnOpen` (`compatible_iff_constOnOpen`).

articles.title: Edges with differently colored endpoints
articles.statement: The edges of `G` whose endpoints have different colors.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal joint probability
articles.statement: The joint Edwards–Sokal probability of the coloring `σ` and the bond configuration `ω`.

articles.title: Monochromatic edge indicator
articles.statement: Whether an edge is monochromatic under the coloring `σ`.

articles.title: Finite-volume plus-boundary magnetization at the origin
articles.statement:
The magnetization `⟨σ_0⟩` at the origin under the plus-boundary Ising measure on the box `Λ_n`
at inverse temperature `β` and zero field.

articles.title: Random-cluster connection probability
articles.statement: The random-cluster connection probability `φ_{G,p,q}(x ↔ y)`.

articles.title: Open connection between two vertices
articles.statement: `x` and `y` are joined by a path of open edges of `ω` in `G` (`x ↔ y`).

articles.title: Correspondence for cluster-constant colorings equal at two vertices
articles.statement:
Colorings constant on open clusters with `σ x = σ y` correspond to colorings of the clusters
that agree on the clusters of `x` and `y`.

articles.title: Functions equal at two points as functions omitting one point
articles.statement: For `a ≠ b`, functions `C → Fin q` with `f a = f b` correspond to functions on `C \ {b}`.

articles.title: Ising two-point function equals the $q = 2$ connection probability
articles.statement:
The Ising two-point function equals the random-cluster connection probability with `q = 2`:
`⟨σ_x σ_y⟩ = φ_{p,2}(x ↔ y)` (Edwards–Sokal 1988; Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, 2006,
Theorem 1.16).

articles.title: Ising two-point function from the Edwards–Sokal coupling
articles.statement:
The Ising two-point function `⟨σ_x σ_y⟩` at bond parameter `p`, computed as the
Edwards–Sokal spin marginal.

articles.title: Ising spin value of a two-state color
articles.statement: The Ising spin value of a two-state color: `0 ↦ -1`, `1 ↦ 1`.

articles.title: Wired probability that the origin reaches the box boundary
articles.statement:
The probability `φ^w_n(0 ↔ ∂Λ_n)` that the origin is connected to the boundary of the box graph
of `Λ_n` under the wired FK measure with `q = 2`.

articles.title: Origin as a vertex of the box graph
articles.statement: The origin as a vertex of the box graph.

articles.title: Origin lies in every box
articles.statement:
The origin lies in every box. Same statement as `Ising.origin_mem_box`, which this module does
not import.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal correlation identity in $(q-1)/q$ form
articles.statement: The Edwards–Sokal correlation identity with the prefactor written as `(q - 1)/q`.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal correlation identity
articles.statement:
For the `q`-state Potts model on a finite graph with
`p = 1 - e^{-βJ} ∈ (0, 1)`,
`μ_{β,J,q}(σ_x = σ_y) - 1/q = (1 - 1/q) φ_{p,q}(x ↔ y)`.
The hypothesis `hp1` holds for every real `βJ` and `hq` follows from `[NeZero q]`; the only
restriction is `hp`, i.e. `βJ > 0` (ferromagnetic).
(Edwards–Sokal, Phys. Rev. D 38, 1988; Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, 2006, Theorem
1.16.)

articles.title: Potts two-point agreement at least $1/q$ for $q \ge 2$, $\beta J > 0$
articles.statement: For `q ≥ 2` and `βJ > 0`, two Potts spins agree with probability at least `1/q`.

articles.title: Potts two-point agreement probability
articles.statement: The Potts two-point agreement probability `μ_{G,β,J,q}(σ_x = σ_y)`.

articles.title: Coloring fixed to a color on the boundary
articles.statement: The coloring `σ` equals `b` on every boundary vertex.

articles.title: Colorings constant on wired clusters as cluster colorings
articles.statement: Colorings constant on the clusters of `wiredSub` correspond to colorings of those clusters.

articles.title: Coloring constant on the wired graph
articles.statement: The coloring `σ` is constant along the edges of `wiredSub`.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal weight with fixed boundary color
articles.statement: The Edwards–Sokal weight restricted to colorings with boundary color `b`.

articles.title: Spin marginal of the wired Edwards–Sokal measure
articles.statement: The spin marginal of the wired Edwards–Sokal measure.

articles.title: Bond marginal of the wired Edwards–Sokal measure
articles.statement: The bond marginal of the wired Edwards–Sokal measure.

articles.title: Total wired Edwards–Sokal weight
articles.statement: The total wired Edwards–Sokal weight.

articles.title: Functions pinned at a point as functions on its complement
articles.statement:
Functions to `Fin q` taking the value `b` at `c₀` correspond to functions on the complement of
`c₀`. See also `Equiv.piSplitAt`.

articles.title: Potts Gibbs probability with fixed boundary color
articles.statement: The Gibbs probability of the Potts model with boundary color `b`.

articles.title: Potts weight with fixed boundary color
articles.statement: The Potts weight restricted to colorings with boundary color `b`.

articles.title: Potts partition function with fixed boundary color
articles.statement: The partition function of the Potts model with boundary color `b`.

articles.title: Open-edge graph with a boundary clique
articles.statement: The graph of open edges of `ω` together with a clique on the boundary vertices.

articles.title: There are $q^{k(\omega)}$ colorings constant on the open clusters
articles.statement:
There are `q ^ k(ω)` colorings constant on the open clusters, where `k(ω)` is the number of
clusters.

articles.title: Cluster-constant colorings as colorings of clusters
articles.statement:
Colorings constant on open clusters correspond to colorings of the connected components of the
open subgraph.

articles.title: Spin configuration constant on open clusters
articles.statement: `σ` is constant on every open edge of `ω`, i.e. on every open cluster.
