articles.title: Edwards–Sokal spin marginal is the Potts measure
articles.statement:
The spin marginal of the Edwards–Sokal measure is the `q`-state Potts measure at inverse
temperature `β` and coupling `J`.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal bond marginal is the random-cluster measure
articles.statement:
The bond marginal of the Edwards–Sokal measure is the random-cluster measure with parameters
`(1 - e^{-βJ}, q)`.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal factor of an arbitrary coordinate and state
articles.statement:
The Edwards–Sokal factor of an edge `e` written for an arbitrary pair `(e, b)` with `b` the
state
of `e`; edges outside `G` get factor `1`.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal edge factor
articles.statement:
The Edwards–Sokal factor of an edge `e`: `1 - p` if `e` is closed in `ω`, and `p` times the
indicator that `σ` agrees at the endpoints if `e` is open.

articles.title: Normalizing constant relating the bond sum to the Potts weight
articles.statement: The normalizing constant `e^{-βJ |E(G)|}` relating the bond marginal to the Potts weight.

articles.title: Spin marginal of the Edwards–Sokal measure
articles.statement: The spin marginal of the normalized Edwards–Sokal measure.

articles.title: Bond marginal of the Edwards–Sokal measure
articles.statement: The bond marginal of the normalized Edwards–Sokal measure.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal bond sum is a multiple of the Potts weight
articles.statement:
Bond marginal of the Edwards–Sokal weight: with `p = 1 - e^{-βJ}`, summing over bond
configurations gives `e^{-βJ |E|}` times the Potts weight of `σ`.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal weight summed over spins is the random-cluster weight
articles.statement:
Spin marginal of the Edwards–Sokal weight: summing over spins gives the random-cluster weight
`p^{o(ω)} (1 - p)^{c(ω)} q^{k(ω)}`.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal joint weight
articles.statement:
The Edwards–Sokal joint weight of a spin configuration `σ` and a bond configuration `ω`: the
product of `esEdgeFactor` over the edges of `G`.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal partition function
articles.statement: The Edwards–Sokal partition function: the total joint weight.

articles.title: Ising inverse temperature of an FK edge parameter
articles.statement:
The Ising inverse temperature `-(1/2) log (1 - p)` corresponding to the FK edge parameter `p`.
See also `pToBeta` for general `q` (`pToBeta_two_eq_betaOfP`).

articles.title: FK edge parameter of an Ising inverse temperature
articles.statement:
The FK edge parameter `p = 1 - e^{-2β}` of the Ising model at inverse temperature `β`. See also
`betaToP` for general `q` (`betaToP_two_eq_pOfBeta`).

articles.title: Ising configuration of a two-state Potts coloring
articles.statement: The Ising configuration of a two-state Potts coloring, via `Fin 2 ≃ Bool`.

articles.title: Two-state color of a Boolean spin
articles.statement: The two-state color of a Boolean spin: `true ↦ 0`, `false ↦ 1`.

articles.title: Ising bond variable of a two-state coloring
articles.statement:
The Ising bond `σ_x σ_y` of a two-state coloring, with color `0` as spin `+1`. See also
`Ising.bond` for Boolean configurations.

articles.title: Plus-boundary Ising one-point function on a graph
articles.statement: The one-point function `⟨σ_x⟩⁺` of the Ising model with `+` boundary condition on a graph.

articles.title: Ising weight of a coloring with plus boundary
articles.statement:
The Ising weight `exp (β ∑_e σ_x σ_y)` of a two-state coloring with boundary color `0`, and `0`
otherwise.

articles.title: Plus-boundary Ising partition function on a graph
articles.statement: The partition function of the Ising model with `+` boundary condition on a graph.

articles.title: Box configuration as a coloring of the next larger box
articles.statement:
A configuration in the box `Λ_n` as a two-state coloring of `Λ_{n+1}`, with color `0` (spin `+`)
outside `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Restriction of a box coloring to the inner box
articles.statement: The configuration in `Λ_n` obtained by restricting a two-state coloring of `Λ_{n+1}`.

articles.title: Boolean spin of a two-state color
articles.statement: The Boolean spin of a two-state color: `0 ↦ true`.

articles.title: Box configurations as box-graph colorings with boundary color $0$
articles.statement:
Configurations in `Λ_n` correspond to two-state colorings of `Λ_{n+1}` with boundary color
`0`.

articles.title: Critical inverse temperature of a magnetization curve
articles.statement:
The critical inverse temperature `sup {β > 0 : m*(β) = 0}` of a spontaneous-magnetization curve
`m*`. See also `Ising.betaC`, the infimum of the inverse temperatures with positive
magnetization.

articles.title: FK edge-parameter map of the Potts model at $q = 2$ is the Ising map
articles.statement: At `q = 2` the general parametrization `betaToP` is `pOfBeta`.

articles.title: FK edge parameter of a Potts inverse temperature
articles.statement:
The FK edge parameter `1 - e^{-qβ/(q-1)}` of the `q`-state Potts model at inverse temperature
`β`.

articles.title: Critical inverse temperature of the $d$-dimensional Ising model
articles.statement:
The critical inverse temperature of the `d`-dimensional Ising model, `sup {β > 0 : m*(β) =
0}`.

articles.title: Inverse-temperature map of the Potts model at $q = 2$ is the Ising map
articles.statement: At `q = 2` the general parametrization `pToBeta` is `betaOfP`.

articles.title: Potts inverse temperature of an FK edge parameter
articles.statement:
The Potts inverse temperature `-((q - 1)/q) log (1 - p)` corresponding to the FK edge parameter
`p`.

articles.title: Agreement count of a spin configuration
articles.statement: The agreement count: the number of edges of `G` whose endpoints carry the same spin.

articles.title: Monochromatic-edge indicator
articles.statement: The indicator of a monochromatic edge: `𝟙[σ x = σ y]` on the unordered pair `s(x, y)`.

articles.title: Potts Gibbs measure as a probability mass function
articles.statement: The Potts Gibbs measure on `V → Fin q` as a probability mass function.

articles.title: Potts probability of a spin configuration
articles.statement: The Potts probability of the spin configuration `σ`.

articles.title: Potts Boltzmann weight
articles.statement: The Potts Boltzmann weight `exp (β J · agreement G σ)`.

articles.title: Potts partition function
articles.statement: The Potts partition function `Z = ∑_σ exp (β J · agreement G σ)`.

articles.title: Open connection of a vertex to the boundary
articles.statement: The vertex `x` is joined by an open path of `ω` to a boundary vertex.

articles.title: Edwards–Sokal one-point identity
articles.statement:
With `+` boundary condition, the Ising magnetization at
`x` equals the probability that `x` is connected to the boundary in the wired FK measure with `q
= 2` (Edwards and Sokal, Phys. Rev. D 38 (1988); Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, Theorem
1.16).

articles.title: Wired Edwards–Sokal one-point function
articles.statement:
The one-point function `⟨σ_x⟩` of the wired Edwards–Sokal measure with boundary color `b` and `q
= 2`.

articles.title: Wired colorings as cluster colorings with a pinned boundary cluster
articles.statement:
Colorings constant on wired clusters with boundary color `b` correspond to colorings of the
clusters of `wiredSub` with the boundary cluster colored `b`.

articles.title: Wired random-cluster probability of connecting to the boundary
articles.statement:
The probability `φ^w(x ↔ ∂)` that `x` is connected to the boundary under the wired
random-cluster measure with `q = 2`.

articles.title: Boundary-graph comparison $\varphi^{C'}(A) \le q^N \varphi^C(A)$
articles.statement:
If the cluster counts with boundary graphs `C ≤ C'` differ by at most `N`, then
`φ^C(A) ≤ q^N φ^{C'}(A)` for nonnegative event indicators.

articles.title: Event mass under the random-cluster measure with a boundary graph
articles.statement: The mass `φ^C_{G,p,q}(A)` of an event under the random-cluster measure with boundary graph `C`.

articles.title: Boundary-supported wirings lie below the boundary clique
articles.statement: A wiring whose edges join boundary vertices lies below the boundary clique.

articles.title: Empty wiring gives the free random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The empty wiring gives the free random-cluster measure.

articles.title: Boundary clique gives the wired random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The boundary clique gives the wired random-cluster measure.

articles.title: Holley's condition for probabilities with nested wirings, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: Holley's condition for the probabilities with nested wirings `C ≤ C'` and `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Sandwich between the free and all-wired boundary conditions
articles.statement:
The free lower bound together with the bound by the boundary condition `⊤` (all vertices
wired).

articles.title: Free–wired sandwich for boundary graphs inside the boundary clique
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` and `C` inside the boundary clique, `φ^0(A) ≤ φ^C(A) ≤ φ^1(A)` for every increasing
event `A`.

articles.title: Disintegration of a boundary-wired measure over conditioning fibres
articles.statement:
Disintegration: `φ_C(ω)` is the mass of the fibre of `ω` times the conditional probability of
`ω` in that fibre.

articles.title: Random-cluster comparison of boundary conditions for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
Comparison of boundary conditions for the random-cluster measure: for `q ≥ 1` and wirings `C ≤
C'`, `φ_C(A) ≤ φ_C'(A)` for every increasing event `A`. This follows from Holley's inequality
(Holley, 1974); see Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model* (2006), Chapter 4.

articles.title: Boundary-graph FK measure increases in $p$ for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the random-cluster measure with boundary graph `C` is increasing in `p` on
increasing events.

articles.title: FKG inequality for the random-cluster measure, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
FKG inequality for the random-cluster measure (Fortuin, Kasteleyn and Ginibre, 1971): for `q ≥
1` and any boundary wiring `C`, increasing functions are positively correlated under `φ_C`. See
Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model* (2006), Chapter 3.

articles.title: Random-cluster probability with a boundary wiring
articles.statement: The random-cluster probability with boundary wiring `C`, `bcWeight / bcZ`.

articles.title: Holley's condition for weights with nested wirings, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: Holley's condition for the weights with nested wirings `C ≤ C'` and `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Random-cluster weight with a boundary wiring
articles.statement:
The unnormalized random-cluster weight with boundary wiring `C`: `edgeProduct G p ω · q ^
numClustersBC G C ω`.

articles.title: Partition function with a boundary wiring
articles.statement: The partition function with boundary wiring `C`.

articles.title: Supermodularity of the number of connected components
articles.statement:
The number of connected components of simple graphs on a finite vertex set is supermodular:
`#comp(G₁) + #comp(G₂) ≤ #comp(G₁ ⊔ G₂) + #comp(G₁ ⊓ G₂)`.

articles.title: Number of open edges of a configuration
articles.statement: The number of open edges of `G` in `ω`. Same as `openCount` in `Tilt`.

articles.title: Holley's condition for nested-wiring conditional measures, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: Holley's condition for the conditional measures with nested wirings `C ≤ C'` and `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Conditional measures increase with the wiring for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` and `C ≤ C'`, the conditional measure with wiring `C` is dominated by the one with
wiring `C'` on increasing events.

articles.title: Conditional random-cluster measure with a boundary wiring
articles.statement:
The random-cluster measure with wiring `C` conditioned on agreeing with `ψ` off the edge set
`F`.

articles.title: Edges closed in one configuration and open in another
articles.statement: The edges of `G` closed in `b` and open in `c`.

articles.title: Edge density lies between $p/(p+q(1-p))$ and $p$ for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: For `q ≥ 1`, every edge of `G` is open with probability between `p / (p + q(1 - p))` and `p`.

articles.title: Edge marginal of a mass function
articles.statement: The probability `μ(ω(e) = 1)` that the coordinate `e` is open under the mass function `μ`.

articles.title: Probability that an edge is open under the random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The probability `φ_{G,p,q}(e open)` that the edge `e` is open.

articles.title: Monotone couplings with equal edge marginals agree on up-sets
articles.statement:
Two monotonically coupled measures with the same edge marginals give the same mass to every
increasing event.

articles.title: Mass of an event under a mass function
articles.statement: The mass `μ(A)` of an event under the mass function `μ`.

articles.title: Comparison inequalities
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`,
`P_{p/(p + q(1 - p))} ≼ φ_{p,q} ≼ P_p`, with every law extended uniformly to loops
and nonedges. On graph-edge marginals, this gives the usual FK/Bernoulli comparison
(Fortuin 1972; Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, 2006, Theorem 3.21).

articles.title: Random-cluster measure increases stochastically in $p$ when $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: For `q ≥ 1` the random-cluster measure is stochastically increasing in `p`.

articles.title: Holley's cross inequality for FK measures, $p_1 \le p_2$, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: Holley's cross inequality for two random-cluster measures with `p₁ ≤ p₂` and the same `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: FKG lattice condition for the random-cluster measure
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` and `p ∈ (0, 1)`, the random-cluster measure satisfies the FKG lattice condition
`φ(a) φ(b) ≤ φ(a ⊔ b) φ(a ⊓ b)`.

articles.title: Boundary wirings lie between free and wired when $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` and a wiring `C` supported on the boundary, free ≤ `φ_C` ≤ wired on every increasing
event.

articles.title: Free–wired domination on a finite graph for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` the free random-cluster measure gives every increasing event at most the probability
the wired measure gives it.

articles.title: FKG inequality for increasing random-cluster events
articles.statement: The FKG inequality for increasing events: `φ(A) φ(B) ≤ φ(A ∩ B)` for `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: FKG inequality for the random-cluster model
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, increasing functions are positively
correlated under `φ_{G,p,q}`: `φ(f) φ(g) ≤ φ(f g)`.
(Fortuin–Kasteleyn–Ginibre, Comm. Math. Phys. 22, 1971; Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*,
2006,
Theorem 3.8.)

articles.title: Monotonicity of the random-cluster measure in `p`
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` and `p₁ ≤ p₂`,
`φ_{p₁,q}(A) ≤ φ_{p₂,q}(A)` for every increasing event `A`
(Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, 2006, Theorem 3.21).

articles.title: Free box measure dominated by the wired one for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` the free box measure is stochastically dominated by the wired box measure on `ℤ^d`:
`φ⁰_n ≼ φ¹_n`.

articles.title: Holley's condition for free and wired probabilities when $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: Holley's condition for the free and wired probabilities when `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Holley's condition for free and wired weights when $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
Holley's condition for the free and wired weights when `q ≥ 1`. See also `bcWeight_cross`, which
contains this as the case of boundary wirings `⊥ ≤ clique`.

articles.title: Partition function of a conditioning fibre
articles.statement:
The partition function of the fibre of `ψ` off `F`: the sum of `bcWeight` over configurations
agreeing with `ψ` off `F`.

articles.title: Monotone coupling of two mass functions
articles.statement:
`P` is a monotone coupling of the mass functions `μ` and `ν`: a nonnegative mass function on
pairs
with marginals `μ` and `ν`, supported on pairs `(ω, ω')` with `ω ≤ ω'`.

articles.title: Kernel of the Laplacian of the open subgraph
articles.statement: The kernel of the Laplacian of the open subgraph of `ω`, a subspace of `V → ℝ`.

articles.title: Mixed supermodularity of cluster counts for nested wirings
articles.statement:
Mixed supermodularity of cluster counts for nested wirings `C ≤ C'`: `k_C(a) + k_C'(b) ≤ k_C(a ⊓
b) + k_C'(a ⊔ b)`.

articles.title: Mixed supermodularity of free and wired cluster counts
articles.statement:
Mixed supermodularity of cluster counts: `k(a) + k¹(b) ≤ k(a ⊓ b) + k¹(a ⊔ b)`, where `k¹`
counts clusters with the boundary wired.

articles.title: Cluster count plus open-edge count is monotone
articles.statement:
For `b ≤ c`, `k(b) + o(b) ≤ k(c) + o(c)`: opening an edge lowers the cluster count by at most
one.

articles.title: Number of clusters under a boundary wiring
articles.statement:
The number of clusters of `ω` under the boundary wiring `C`: connected components of the open
subgraph of `ω` joined with `C`.

articles.title: Number of open clusters equals the dimension of the Laplacian kernel
articles.statement:
The number of open clusters equals the dimension of the kernel of the Laplacian of the open
subgraph.

articles.title: Supermodularity of the random-cluster cluster count
articles.statement: The cluster count of the random-cluster model is supermodular in the configuration.

articles.title: Reduced density $p/(p + q(1-p))$
articles.statement: The reduced density `p / (p + q(1 - p))`: the Bernoulli parameter dominated by `φ_{p,q}`.

articles.title: Wired measure conditionally dominated by larger wirings, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: Conditional version of `wiredFkProb_inner_dominated`.

articles.title: Wirings with the boundary clique dominate the wired measure, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` the wired measure is dominated by `φ_C'` for any wiring `C'` containing the boundary
clique.

articles.title: Assumed doubling, boundedness and oscillation data along $K_j$
articles.statement:
The doubling bound along `K_j`, a uniform bound on the ambient per-edge values
`agl_ambientNegLogZ / agl_E` at those scales, and vanishing oscillation of `ivp2_ambientTiltLogZ`
between `Λ_n` and `Λ_{K_{b(n)}}`. These are assumptions, not a box-convergence result.

articles.title: Additive doubling bound along the scales $K_j$
articles.statement:
Doubling bound along the scales `K_j`: `u(K_{j+1}) ≤ 2^d u(K_j) + I_j (-log(1 - p))` with
`|2^d E(K_j) - E(K_{j+1})| ≤ I_j` and `∑_j I_j / E(K_{j+1}) < ∞`.

articles.title: Negative log ambient normalizer of a box
articles.statement: The negative log ambient normalizer of `Λ_n`; the same as `bxt_ambientNegLogZ`.

articles.title: Number of edges of a box
articles.statement: The number of edges of `Λ_n`; the same as `bxt_E`.

articles.title: Graph transported to the sum of a subset and its complement
articles.statement: `K₀` transported to `{P} ⊕ {¬P}`.

articles.title: Number of edges between a vertex subset and its complement
articles.statement: The number of edges of `K₀` joining `{P}` to `{¬P}`.

articles.title: Isomorphism between a graph and its transported copy
articles.statement: `K₀` is isomorphic to its transport `agl_glueGraph`.

articles.title: Scales $K_j = 2^{j+1} - 1$
articles.statement: The scales `K_j = 2^{j+1} - 1`, with `K_0 = 1` and `K_{j+1} = 2 K_j + 1`.

articles.title: Isomorphism of a box with its translated copy in the predicate part
articles.statement: A translated copy of `Λ_m` inside `{P}` induces a graph isomorphic to `Λ_m`.

articles.title: Graph induced on the vertices satisfying a predicate
articles.statement: The graph induced by `K₀` on `{x | P x}`.

articles.title: Isomorphism of a box with its translated copy in the complement part
articles.statement: A translated copy of `Λ_m` inside `{¬P}` induces a graph isomorphic to `Λ_m`.

articles.title: Graph induced on the vertices failing a predicate
articles.statement: The graph induced by `K₀` on `{x | ¬ P x}`.

articles.title: Vertex set as a disjoint sum of a subset and its complement
articles.statement: The identification `{P} ⊕ {¬P} ≃ U`.

articles.title: Isomorphism of translated induced lattice graphs
articles.statement: Translating vertex embeddings by `v` gives isomorphic induced lattice graphs.

articles.title: Fekete's lemma with a sublinear correction
articles.statement:
Fekete's lemma with an `o(n)` correction: if `u n + c n` is subadditive and bounded below after
dividing by `n`, and `c n / n → 0`, then `u n / n` converges. See also Mathlib's
`Subadditive.tendsto_lim`.

articles.title: $\Lambda_n$ has $d \cdot 2n(2n+1)^{d-1}$ edges
articles.statement: The box `Λ_n` has `d · 2n (2n + 1)^{d-1}` edges.

articles.title: Dyadic convergence data for the ambient tilted log normalizer
articles.statement:
The ambient tilted log normalizer of `Λ_{2^j}` is increasing in `j` up to summable defects and
  bounded
above, and
the ambient tilted log normalizer of `Λ_n` differs from that of the dyadic box below it by a
  vanishing
oscillation.

articles.title: Negative log ambient normalizer of the box $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: The negative log ambient normalizer `-log (fkZ Λ_n (logistic t) 2)` of the box `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Edge count of the box $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: The number of edges of the box `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Doubling bound at the dyadic scales $2^j$
articles.statement:
Doubling bound at the dyadic scales: `u(2^{j+1}) ≤ 2^d u(2^j) + I_j (-log(1 - p))` with
`|2^d E(2^j) - E(2^{j+1})| ≤ I_j` and `∑_j I_j / E(2^{j+1}) < ∞`.

articles.title: $\Lambda_n$ has $4n(2n+1)^{d-1}$ ordered pairs in each direction
articles.statement: There are `2 · 2n (2n + 1)^{d-1}` ordered pairs in each direction.

articles.title: $2n(2n+1)^{d-1}$ sites of $\Lambda_n$ stay inside after a unit shift
articles.statement: For `b = ±1`, `2n (2n + 1)^{d-1}` sites of `Λ_n` stay in `Λ_n` after the shift.

articles.title: Ordered pairs in different directions are disjoint
articles.statement: Pairs in different directions are disjoint.

articles.title: Pairs in direction $i$ are the forward and backward shifts
articles.statement: The pairs in direction `i` are the forward and the backward shifts.

articles.title: Ordered nearest-neighbour pairs of $\Lambda_n$ in direction $i$
articles.statement: The ordered nearest-neighbor pairs of `Λ_n` that differ in coordinate `i`.

articles.title: $\Lambda_n$ has $4dn(2n+1)^{d-1}$ ordered nearest-neighbour pairs
articles.statement: The box `Λ_n` has `d · 2 · 2n (2n + 1)^{d-1}` ordered nearest-neighbor pairs.

articles.title: Ordered neighbour pairs of $\Lambda_n$ as a union over directions
articles.statement: The ordered nearest-neighbor pairs of `Λ_n` are the union over directions.

articles.title: Graph glued from two graphs along an interface
articles.statement:
`K` contains `G ⊕ H` and adds no edges inside `V` or inside `W`; all extra edges join `V` to
`W`.

articles.title: Interface edges of a graph on a disjoint union
articles.statement: The interface edges of `K`: edges not in the disjoint union `G ⊕ H`.

articles.title: Box free-energy doubling bound along $K_j$ holds for $d, q \ge 1$
articles.statement: The doubling bound holds for all `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Doubling-bound property of the box free energy along $K_j$
articles.statement:
A doubling bound along the dyadic sides `agl_K j` with nonnegative errors `I j` whose
per-edge values are summable.

articles.title: Doubling bound for the box free energy when $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
Doubling bound: the free energy of the box of side `2(2K + 1) + 1` is at most `2^d` times that
of side `2K + 1` plus `-log (1 - p)` times the number of boundary edges.

articles.title: Van Hove subadditivity of the box free energy for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
Van Hove subadditivity: packing `T^d` copies of the side-`(2m + 1)` box into the
side-`(2n + 1)` box, the free energy is at most `T^d fkc_u m` plus `-log (1 - p)` per remaining
edge.

articles.title: Per-edge free energy converges along $K_j$ for $d, q \ge 1$
articles.statement: The per-edge free energy converges along the dyadic sides `agl_K j`.

articles.title: Edge-normalized box free energy of the random-cluster model
articles.statement:
The edge-normalized free energy of the random-cluster model on the box of side `2n + 1` in
dimension `d`, in the logit parameter `s`: `log Z^E / |E| + log (1 + eˢ)` with
`Z^E = ecz_fkZEdge (boxGraph d n) (fsc_logistic s) q`.

articles.title: Per-edge box free energy
articles.statement: The per-edge box free energy `fkc_u / |E|`.

articles.title: Random-cluster weight is at most $q^{|V|}$ for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` every random-cluster weight is at most `q ^ |V|`. The case `q = 2` is
`ecz_fkWeight_le`.

articles.title: Edge partition function is at most $2^{|E|} q^{|V|}$ for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` the edge partition function is at most `2 ^ |E| q ^ |V|`. The case `q = 2` is
`ecz_fkZEdge_le`.

articles.title: Limit of the van Hove upper bound for a fixed box side
articles.statement: The limit of the van Hove upper bound for a fixed side `2m + 1`.

articles.title: Van Hove limit
articles.statement:
**Van Hove limit** of the random-cluster free energy: for `d ≥ 1` and `q ≥ 1`, the per-edge
free energy on the box `[-n, n]^d` converges. See D. Ruelle, *Statistical Mechanics: Rigorous
Results* (1969), and G. Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model* (2006), Chapter 4.

articles.title: Convergence of the per-edge box free energy
articles.statement: The per-edge box free energy `fkc_f d s q n` converges as `n → ∞`.

articles.title: Uniform upper bound on the box free energy for $d, n, q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `d, n ≥ 1` and `q ≥ 1` the box free energy is at most `log 2 + 2 log q + log (1 + eˢ)`.
The case `q = 2` is `ecz_edgeFE_le_const`.

articles.title: Box free energy $-\log Z^E$ of the random-cluster model
articles.statement:
The box free energy `-log Z^E` of the random-cluster model on `[-n, n]^d` at edge parameter
`fsc_logistic s`, over configurations closed off the box edges.

articles.title: Hypotheses of the normalized Fekete lemma are satisfiable
articles.statement: The hypotheses of `fkl_tendsto_div_of_subadditive` hold together for `u = 0`, `e n = n`.

articles.title: Fekete's lemma with a general normalization
articles.statement:
Fekete's lemma normalized by `e n` instead of `n`: if `u` is subadditive with `u n / n`
bounded below and `e n / n → c ≠ 0`, then `u n / e n → lim / c`. Built on Mathlib's
`Subadditive.tendsto_lim`.

articles.title: Connected components of a disjoint union of graphs
articles.statement: The connected components of `G ⊕g H` are those of `G` and those of `H`.

articles.title: Components of a disjoint union sent to components of the summands
articles.statement: The map sending a component of `G ⊕g H` to the corresponding component of `G` or `H`.

articles.title: Gluing edge configurations on a disjoint union
articles.statement:
Gluing edge configurations: `σ` on edges inside `V`, `τ` on edges inside `W`, and closed on
pairs joining `V` to `W`.

articles.title: Isomorphism invariance of the ambient FK normalizer
articles.statement: The ambient FK normalizer is invariant under graph isomorphism.

articles.title: Ambient FK normalizer is supermultiplicative under disjoint union
articles.statement:
The ambient FK normalizer is supermultiplicative under disjoint union:
`Z_G Z_H ≤ Z_{G ⊕g H}`. Each `Z` sums over all `Sym2` configurations.

articles.title: Edgeless graphs satisfy the juxtaposition hypothesis
articles.statement: Edgeless graphs on `Fin n` satisfy the juxtaposition hypothesis `G_{m+n} ≅ G_m ⊕g G_n`.

articles.title: Graph isomorphism restricted to open subgraphs
articles.statement:
A graph isomorphism `G ≃g H` restricts to an isomorphism of open subgraphs, with the
configuration on `G` pulled back from `H`.

articles.title: Subadditivity of $-\log Z$ along a juxtaposition sequence
articles.statement: Along a sequence with `G_{m+n} ≅ G_m ⊕g G_n`, the sequence `-log Z_{G_n}` is subadditive.

articles.title: Inclusion of summand components into a disjoint union
articles.statement: The inclusion of the components of `G` and of `H` into those of `G ⊕g H`.

articles.title: Bijection of unordered pairs induced by a bijection
articles.statement: The equivalence `Sym2 V ≃ Sym2 W` induced by `V ≃ W`.

articles.title: Forward and backward shift pairs are disjoint
articles.statement: Forward and backward pairs in one direction are disjoint.

articles.title: Box Fekete data from a uniform bound and an oscillation bound
articles.statement:
The box Fekete data for the free `q = 2` FK model from a uniform bound on `u / |E|` along
doubling boxes and an oscillation bound between general and doubling boxes.

articles.title: Additive doubling bound for $-\log Z$ of the free $q = 2$ FK model
articles.statement:
The additive doubling bound for `u = -log Z` of the free `q = 2` FK model along the doubling
boxes `K_j = 2^{j+1} - 1`, in every dimension `d ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Negative log of the ambient FK normalizer
articles.statement: The negative log ambient normalizer `-log (fkZ G p q)`, including unused coordinates.

articles.title: Block of a tag: graph induced on its vertices
articles.statement: The block of tag `τ`: the graph induced on the vertices with tag `τ`.

articles.title: The hyperplane block has at most $2d|J|$ edges
articles.statement: The hyperplane block has at most `2d |J|` edges.

articles.title: Orthant blocks have the FK partition function of $\Lambda_K$
articles.statement: Each orthant block of `Λ_{2K+1}` has the FK partition function of `Λ_K`.

articles.title: Vertex degrees in a box are at most $2d$
articles.statement:
Every vertex of a box has degree at most `2d`. See also
`MathlibExt...PlanarTopology.degree_le` for `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Doubling inequality for $-\log Z$ of the free $q = 2$ FK model
articles.statement:
The doubling inequality `u(2K + 1) ≤ 2^d u(K) + I_K · (-log (1 - p))` for `u = -log Z` of the
free `q = 2` FK model, with `I_K = (2^d + 2) · 2d |J|`.

articles.title: Coordinate description of the sites with a given orthant tag
articles.statement:
A site has tag `s` iff each coordinate lies in `[1, 2K + 1]` or `[-(2K + 1), -1]` according to
`s`.

articles.title: Orthant tag of a site of $\Lambda_{2K+1}$
articles.statement:
The orthant tag of a site of `Λ_{2K+1}`: `none` on a coordinate hyperplane, otherwise its sign
pattern.

articles.title: Isomorphism of an iterated induced graph with a single one
articles.statement:
An iterated induced graph is isomorphic to the graph induced by any injection with the same
range as the composite.

articles.title: Isomorphism of induced graphs from injections with equal range
articles.statement: Graphs induced on `K₀` by two injections with the same range are isomorphic.

articles.title: Bound on the edge gap $|E(\Lambda_{2K+1})| - 2^d |E(\Lambda_K)|$
articles.statement: The edge-number gap `|E(Λ_{2K+1})| - 2^d |E(Λ_K)|` is at most `d (d + 2)(4K + 3)^{d-1}`.

articles.title: $\Lambda_{2K+1}$ has at least $2^d$ times as many edges as $\Lambda_K$
articles.statement: The `2^d` orthant copies of `Λ_K` have at most as many edges as `Λ_{2K+1}`.

articles.title: Lower bound $n(2n+1)^{d-1}$ on the number of edges of $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: The box `Λ_n` has at least `n (2n + 1)^{d-1}` edges.

articles.title: Iterated and single induced graphs share the FK partition function
articles.statement:
An iterated induced graph has the FK partition function of the graph induced by any injection
with the same range.

articles.title: Induced graphs with equal range have equal FK partition functions
articles.statement: Graphs induced by two injections with the same range have the same FK partition function.

articles.title: FK partition function of a graph with no vertices is one
articles.statement: The FK partition function of a graph with no vertices is `1`.

articles.title: FK partition function at least the all-closed weight for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the FK partition function is at least the weight `(1 - p)^{|E|}` of the all-
closed configuration.

articles.title: Interface edges of a split are at most the straddling edges
articles.statement:
The interface of the left/right split by `P` has at most as many edges as there are edges
straddling `P`.

articles.title: The hyperplane set has at most $d(4K+3)^{d-1}$ sites
articles.statement: The hyperplane set has at most `d (4K + 3)^{d-1}` sites.

articles.title: Hyperplane set lies in the union of the coordinate slabs
articles.statement: The hyperplane set is the union of the coordinate slabs.

articles.title: Hyperplane set of $\Lambda_{2K+1}$
articles.statement: The hyperplane set: sites of `Λ_{2K+1}` with some coordinate equal to `0`.

articles.title: A coordinate slab has at most $(4K+3)^{d-1}$ sites
articles.statement: Each coordinate slab has at most `(4K + 3)^{d-1}` sites.

articles.title: Coordinate slab of $\Lambda_{2K+1}$
articles.statement: The sites of `Λ_{2K+1}` with coordinate `i` equal to `0`.

articles.title: Left part of a tag split has the block partition function
articles.statement:
The left part of the restriction to `insert τ S`, split by tag `τ`, has the partition function
of the block of `τ`.

articles.title: $|x| \le n$ iff $-n \le x \le n$ for an integer $x$
articles.statement: `|x| ≤ n` for an integer, written with `natAbs`.

articles.title: Bound $-\log Z \le |E|\,(-\log(1-p))$ for $q \ge 1$
Peeling bound for $-\log Z$ of a tagged graph
articles.statement:
Peeling: `-log Z` of the restriction to `S` is at most the sum over `τ ∈ S` of `-log Z` of the
blocks plus `I · (-log (1 - p))`, with `I` at most the number of edges straddling the tags in
`S`.

articles.title: Translation of $\Lambda_K$ onto an orthant block of $\Lambda_{2K+1}$
articles.statement: The translation of `Λ_K` onto the sites of `Λ_{2K+1}` with tag `s`.

articles.title: Restriction does not increase straddling edges of a tag
articles.statement: Restricting to `insert τ S` does not increase the number of edges straddling tag `τ`.

articles.title: The all-tag restriction has the partition function of $\Lambda_{2K+1}$
articles.statement: The restriction to all tags has the partition function of `Λ_{2K+1}`.

articles.title: Graph induced on vertices with tags in $S$
articles.statement: The graph induced on the vertices whose tag lies in `S`.

articles.title: Isomorphism from the all-tag restriction to $\Lambda_{2K+1}$
articles.statement: The restriction of `Λ_{2K+1}` to all tags is `Λ_{2K+1}`.

articles.title: Right part of a tag split has the restricted partition function
articles.statement:
The right part of the restriction to `insert τ S`, split by tag `τ`, has the partition
function of the restriction to `S`.

articles.title: At most $2d|J|$ edges straddle an orthant tag
articles.statement: At most `2d |J|` edges straddle a tag.

articles.title: Set of edges straddling a predicate
articles.statement: The edges of `K₀` that straddle `P`.

articles.title: An edge between differently tagged sites meets a coordinate hyperplane
articles.statement: An edge between sites of different tags has an endpoint on a coordinate hyperplane.

articles.title: An edge leaving an orthant ends on a coordinate hyperplane
articles.statement: An edge leaving an orthant has an endpoint on a coordinate hyperplane.

articles.title: Straddling of a predicate by an edge
articles.statement: An edge straddles `P` if exactly one endpoint satisfies `P`.

articles.title: Edges straddling a tag are incident to the hyperplane set
articles.statement: The edges straddling a tag are incident to the hyperplane set.

articles.title: Summability of doubling corrections relative to edge counts
articles.statement:
Corrections of order `K_j^{d-1}` divided by `|E(Λ_{K_{j+1}})|` are summable along `K_j =
2^{j+1} - 1`.

articles.title: Untagged sites are exactly those on a coordinate hyperplane
articles.statement: A site has tag `none` iff it lies on a coordinate hyperplane.

articles.title: Translation vector onto an orthant of $\Lambda_{2K+1}$
articles.statement:
The translation vector `(±(K + 1))_i` that moves `Λ_K` onto the orthant with sign pattern
`s`.

articles.title: A site is adjacent to its unit shift in one coordinate
articles.statement: A site is adjacent to its shift by `±1` in one coordinate.

articles.title: Sites of $\Lambda_n$ whose shift in coordinate $i$ stays in the box
articles.statement: The sites of `Λ_n` whose shift by `b` in coordinate `i` stays in `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Injectivity of the shift map
articles.statement: The shift map is injective.

articles.title: Unit shifts of sites staying in the box are pairs in direction $i$
articles.statement: For `b = ±1`, the shift of a site that stays in the box gives a pair in direction `i`.

articles.title: Shift map $x \mapsto (x, x + b e_i)$
articles.statement: The ordered pair `(x, x + b e_i)`.

articles.title: Wired box measure dominates the induced-wiring measure for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the measure on `Λ_n` with the induced wiring is dominated by the wired measure on
`Λ_n`.

articles.title: Domain Markov property for the wired measure on nested boxes
articles.statement:
Domain Markov property: the wired measure on `Λ_(n+1)`, conditioned on the outer configuration
`ψ`, is the random-cluster measure on `Λ_n` with the induced wiring.

articles.title: Edge product of a glued configuration factorizes
articles.statement:
The edge product of a glued configuration factorizes into the inner edge product and
`psiEdgeFactor`.

articles.title: Component decomposition of the wired glued graph
articles.statement:
Components of the glued graph are components of `innerGraph` plus the outer components avoiding
`Λ_n`.

articles.title: Component map into the wired glued graph
articles.statement:
The map from components of `innerGraph` and outer components avoiding `Λ_n` to components of the
glued graph.

articles.title: Glued and inner graphs have the same connections on the box
articles.statement: Two vertices of `Λ_n` are connected in the glued graph iff they are connected in `innerGraph`.

articles.title: Wired open graph of a glued configuration
articles.statement: The wired open graph of the glued configuration on `Λ_(n+1)`.

articles.title: Induced wiring lies below the inner boundary clique
articles.statement: The induced wiring lies below the clique on `∂Λ_n`.

articles.title: Wiring induced on a box through the outer graph
articles.statement: The wiring induced on `Λ_n` by `ψ`: distinct vertices of `Λ_n` connected in the outer graph.

articles.title: Inner open graph with the induced wiring
articles.statement: The open graph of `ω` on `Λ_n` with the induced wiring added.

articles.title: Inner open edges viewed in the larger box
articles.statement: The open edges of `ω`, viewed as edges of `Λ_(n+1)`.

articles.title: Outer component avoiding the inner box
articles.statement: `OutsideOnly` as a predicate on components of the outer graph.

articles.title: Wired cluster count of a glued configuration splits additively
articles.statement:
The wired cluster count of a glued configuration is the induced cluster count of `ω` plus
`outsideShift d n ψ`.

articles.title: Outer open graph plus the outer boundary clique
articles.statement: The outer graph: open outer edges of `ψ` together with the clique on `∂Λ_(n+1)`.

articles.title: Outer components avoiding the inner box
articles.statement: The components of the outer graph that avoid `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Outer vertex whose outer component avoids the inner box
articles.statement: A vertex of `Λ_(n+1)` whose outer component contains no vertex of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Open edges of an outer configuration outside the inner box
articles.statement: The open edges of `ψ` on `Λ_(n+1)` that are not edges of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Number of outer components avoiding the inner box
articles.statement: The number of outer components avoiding `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Outer Bernoulli edge factor of an outer configuration
articles.statement: The Bernoulli edge product over the edges of `Λ_(n+1)` outside `Λ_n`, evaluated at `ψ`.

articles.title: Gluing a box configuration into an outer configuration
articles.statement:
Glue a configuration `ω` on `Λ_n` into an outer configuration `ψ` on `Λ_(n+1)`: edges of `Λ_n`
follow `ω`, the others follow `ψ`.

articles.title: Outer weight factor of an outer configuration
articles.statement: The factor depending only on `ψ`: `psiEdgeFactor · q ^ outsideShift`.

articles.title: Wired glued open graph is the union of inner and outer graphs
articles.statement:
The wired open graph of the glued configuration is the union of the inner open edges and the
outer graph.

articles.title: Event that the box origin connects to the box boundary
articles.statement:
The event that the origin of the box `Λ_n` is connected to the boundary `∂Λ_n` by open edges of
`Λ_n`.

articles.title: Box-boundary profile tends to $\theta(p,2)$ if wired probabilities do
articles.statement:
If the wired `q = 2` probabilities of `{0 ↔ ∂Λ_n}` converge to `θ(p, 2)`, then so does the
Ising
box-boundary connection profile.

articles.title: Event that a box edge is open
articles.statement: The event that the box edge `eb` of `Λ_N` is open.

articles.title: Number of open edges in a finite edge set
articles.statement: The number of open edges of `ω` in the finite set `E`, as a real number.

articles.title: Adjacency matching of the inner embedding
articles.statement: The map `ι` matches adjacency: `x ~ y` in `G_in` iff `ι x ~ ι y` in `G_out`.

articles.title: Glued configuration agrees with the outer one off the inner edge set
articles.statement: A glued configuration agrees with the outer configuration off the inner edges.

articles.title: Law of total probability over outside configurations
articles.statement:
Law of total probability for the outer wired measure over the configuration off the inner
edges. See also `bcProb_fibre_decompose` in `FKDisjointBoxDomainMarkov` for a general
conditioned edge set.

articles.title: Factorization of the wired FK weight of a glued configuration
articles.statement:
The wired FK weight of a glued configuration is the induced-wiring FK weight of the inner
configuration times the outer factor.

articles.title: Inner vertex with an outside-graph edge lies on the inner boundary
articles.statement: An inner vertex joined to a non-inner vertex in the outside graph lies on the inner boundary.

articles.title: Conditional outer wired probability at most the inner wired one, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
Conditioned on `ψ`, the restricted outer wired probability of an increasing event is at most
its wired probability on `G_in`, if the induced wiring is coarser than the clique on `∂_in`.

articles.title: Domination by the inner wired measure under a coarser induced wiring
articles.statement:
If the induced wiring is coarser than the clique on `∂_in`, the induced-wiring measure is
dominated by the wired measure on `G_in` (for `q ≥ 1`).

articles.title: Conditional outer measure is the induced-wiring FK measure
articles.statement:
Conditioned on `ψ` off the inner edges, the outer wired measure of a glued configuration is
the induced-wiring FK measure of the inner configuration.

articles.title: Conditional outer probability as an induced-wiring probability
articles.statement:
The conditional outer probability of an event is the induced-wiring probability of its
pullback under gluing.

articles.title: Conditioning fibre is the set of gluings
articles.statement:
The configurations agreeing with `ψ` off the inner edges are exactly the gluings of `ψ` with
inner configurations.

articles.title: Factorization of the edge weight of a glued configuration
articles.statement:
The edge weight of a glued configuration factors into the inner edge weight and the outer edge
weight.

articles.title: Projection fibres are conditioning fibres
articles.statement: The fibre of the projection over a projected configuration is its conditioning fibre.

articles.title: Free inner measure is dominated by the conditional outer measure
articles.statement:
The free FK measure on `G_in` is dominated by the restricted conditional outer measure (for `q
≥ 1`).

articles.title: Free inner measure is dominated by every induced-wiring measure
articles.statement: The free FK measure on `G_in` is dominated by every induced-wiring measure (for `q ≥ 1`).

articles.title: Cluster bijection for a glued configuration
articles.statement:
The clusters of the glued configuration are in bijection with the inner clusters plus the
outside-only clusters.

articles.title: Injectivity of the cluster map
articles.statement: The cluster map is injective.

articles.title: Cluster map sends the inner cluster of $x$ to that of $\iota x$
articles.statement: The cluster map sends the inner cluster of `x` to the full cluster of `ι x`.

articles.title: Cluster map sends an outside-only cluster of $v$ to that of $v$
articles.statement: The cluster map sends an outside-only cluster of `v` to the full cluster of `v`.

articles.title: Surjectivity of the cluster map
articles.statement: The cluster map is surjective.

articles.title: Cluster map into the clusters of a glued configuration
articles.statement:
The map from inner clusters and outside-only clusters to the clusters of the glued
configuration.

articles.title: Full-graph edges at non-inner vertices are outside-graph edges
articles.statement: A full cluster graph edge at a non-inner vertex is an outside graph edge.

articles.title: Inner cluster reachability gives full-graph reachability of images
articles.statement:
Reachability in the inner cluster graph gives reachability of the images in the full cluster
graph.

articles.title: Full-graph and inner cluster reachability agree on embedded vertices
articles.statement:
Images of inner vertices are joined in the full cluster graph iff the vertices are joined in
the inner cluster graph.

articles.title: Cluster graph of a glued configuration
articles.statement: The cluster graph of the glued configuration on `G_out` with the wired boundary clique.

articles.title: Factorization of the conditioned outer partition function
articles.statement:
The partition function of the outer measure conditioned on `ψ` is the induced-wiring partition
function times the outer factor.

articles.title: Induced-wiring adjacency: distinct and joined in the outside graph
articles.statement: Adjacency in the induced wiring.

articles.title: Wiring induced on the inner graph
articles.statement:
The wiring induced on `G_in` by `ψ`: distinct inner vertices are adjacent when their images
are joined in the outside graph.

articles.title: Finite set of inner edges
articles.statement: The finite set of inner edges of `G_out`.

articles.title: Edges of the inner graph map onto the inner edges of the outer graph
articles.statement: The image of the edges of `G_in` is the set of inner edges of `G_out`.

articles.title: Injectivity of the edge map
articles.statement: The edge map `Sym2.map ι` is injective when `ι` is.

articles.title: Edge map sends $\{x, y\}$ to $\{\iota x, \iota y\}$
articles.statement: The image of the edge `{x, y}` is `{ι x, ι y}`.

articles.title: Image of an inner-graph edge in the outer graph
articles.statement: The image in `G_out` of an edge of `G_in` under `ι`.

articles.title: Full-graph reachability of images gives inner cluster reachability
articles.statement:
Reachability of images in the full cluster graph gives reachability in the inner cluster
graph.

articles.title: Outside reachability gives inner cluster reachability
articles.statement:
Inner vertices whose images are joined in the outside graph are joined in the inner cluster
graph.

articles.title: Inner cluster graph with the induced wiring
articles.statement: The inner cluster graph: open edges of `ω` together with the induced wiring.

articles.title: Endpoints of inner image edges are inner vertices
articles.statement: Both endpoints of an inner image edge are inner vertices.

articles.title: Inner image graph on embedded vertices is the open subgraph
articles.statement: The inner image graph on images of `ι` is the open subgraph of `ω`.

articles.title: Image of the inner open subgraph in the outer graph
articles.statement: The image in `G_out` of the open subgraph of an inner configuration `ω`.

articles.title: Restriction pulls back all-open events to their images
articles.statement:
The pullback of "all edges of `t` are open" under restriction is "all edges of `ι(t)` are
open".

articles.title: Restricting a glued configuration recovers the inner one
articles.statement: Restricting a glued configuration recovers the inner configuration.

articles.title: Restriction of an outer configuration to inner edges
articles.statement: The restriction of a configuration on `G_out` to the edges of `G_in`, read through `ι`.

articles.title: Inner vertex of the outer graph
articles.statement: A vertex of `G_out` is inner if it lies in the image of `ι`.

articles.title: Cluster of a vertex is outside-only iff the vertex is
articles.statement: The cluster of `v` is outside-only iff `v` is.

articles.title: Outside-only property of an outside cluster
articles.statement: The outside-only property of a cluster of the outside graph.

articles.title: Lattice inclusion matches induced adjacency
articles.statement:
The inclusion of a vertex set of `ℤ^d` into a larger one matches the induced hypercubic
adjacency.

articles.title: Lattice induced wirings are coarser than the inner boundary clique
articles.statement:
For sub-boxes of `ℤ^d` avoiding the outer boundary, every induced wiring is coarser than the
clique on the inner boundary.

articles.title: Inner wired domination for vertex sets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement:
For a vertex set of `ℤ^d` inside a larger one and avoiding its wired boundary, the restricted
outer wired FK measure is dominated by the inner wired FK measure on increasing events (for `q
≥ 1`).

articles.title: Outer wired all-open probability at most the inner wired one
articles.statement:
For a vertex set of `ℤ^d` inside a larger one and avoiding its wired boundary, the outer wired
probability that all edges of `ι(t)` are open is at most the inner wired probability that all
edges of `t` are open (for `q ≥ 1`).

articles.title: Inner edge set is the range of the edge map
articles.statement: Membership in the inner edge set is membership in the image of the edge map.

articles.title: Glued cluster count is induced-wiring count plus outside-only clusters
articles.statement:
The wired cluster count of a glued configuration is the induced-wiring cluster count of the
inner configuration plus the number of outside-only clusters.

articles.title: Projected configuration is closed on inner edges
articles.statement: The projection closes inner edges.

articles.title: Projection keeps non-inner edges
articles.statement: The projection keeps non-inner edges.

articles.title: Idempotence of the inner-edge projection
articles.statement: The projection is idempotent.

articles.title: Projection closing every inner edge
articles.statement: The projection of a configuration on `G_out` that closes every inner edge.

articles.title: Outside-graph adjacency: open non-inner edge or boundary pair
articles.statement: Adjacency in the outside graph.

articles.title: Outside graph is a subgraph of the full cluster graph
articles.statement: The outside graph is a subgraph of the full cluster graph.

articles.title: Full-graph reachability from an outside-only vertex stays outside
articles.statement:
From an outside-only vertex, reachability in the full cluster graph stays in the outside
graph.

articles.title: Outside graph with the wired boundary clique
articles.statement:
The outside graph: `ψ`-open non-inner edges together with the clique on the wired boundary
`∂_out`.

articles.title: Outside-only clusters
articles.statement: The outside clusters that contain no inner vertex.

articles.title: Outside-only property is constant on outside clusters
articles.statement: Being outside-only is constant on outside clusters.

articles.title: Outside-only vertices are not inner
articles.statement: An outside-only vertex is not inner.

articles.title: Outside-only vertex
articles.statement: A vertex is outside-only if its outside cluster contains no inner vertex.

articles.title: Graph of open non-inner edges
articles.statement: The graph of `ψ`-open edges of `G_out` that are not inner edges.

articles.title: Number of outside-only clusters
articles.statement: The number of outside-only clusters of `ψ`.

articles.title: Positivity of the outer edge weight
articles.statement: The outer edge weight is positive for `p ∈ (0, 1)`.

articles.title: Outer Bernoulli edge weight of a configuration
articles.statement: The Bernoulli edge weight of `ψ` on the non-inner edges of `G_out`.

articles.title: Glued configuration on inner edges ignores the outer configuration
articles.statement: On inner edges the glued configuration does not depend on the outer configuration.

articles.title: Glued configuration equals the outer one at each non-inner edge
articles.statement: The glued configuration takes the outer value off the inner edges.

articles.title: Glued value on $\{\iota x, \iota y\}$ is the inner value on $\{x, y\}$
articles.statement: The glued configuration on `{ι x, ι y}` is the inner value on `{x, y}`.

articles.title: Glued configuration takes the inner value on inner edges
articles.statement: The glued configuration takes the inner value on inner edges.

articles.title: Agreeing configuration is the gluing of its own restriction
articles.statement:
A configuration that agrees with `ψ` off the inner edges is the gluing of `ψ` with its own
restriction.

articles.title: Gluing of inner and outer configurations
articles.statement:
The configuration on `G_out` that equals the inner configuration `ω` on inner edges and the
outer configuration `ψ` elsewhere.

articles.title: Positivity of the outer factor
articles.statement: The outer factor is positive for `p ∈ (0, 1)` and `q > 0`.

articles.title: Outer factor of the FK weight of a glued configuration
articles.statement:
The factor `ψ` contributes to the FK weight of a glued configuration: its outer edge weight
times `q` to the number of outside-only clusters.

articles.title: Full cluster graph as the union of inner image and outside graphs
articles.statement: The full cluster graph is the union of the inner image graph and the outside graph.

articles.title: Outer wired fibre masses sum to one
articles.statement: The outer wired masses of the fibres over projected configurations sum to one.

articles.title: Inner wired domination of the restricted outer wired measure
articles.statement:
Domination of the restricted outer wired measure by the inner wired measure on increasing
events, when every induced wiring is coarser than the clique on `∂_in` (for `q ≥ 1`).

articles.title: Vertex boundary of a box
articles.statement: The vertex boundary of the box: sites of `Λ_n` that are not in `Λ_(n-1)`.

articles.title: Nearest-neighbour graph on a box
articles.statement: The nearest-neighbour graph on the box `Λ_n`, induced from the hypercubic lattice.

articles.title: Vertices of the box $(-n, n)^d$
articles.statement: The vertices of the box `Λ_n = [-n, n]^d ⊆ ℤ^d`, as a subtype.

articles.title: Inclusion of box edges into $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: The inclusion of edges of the box into edges of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Extension of a box configuration by closed edges
articles.statement: Extend a configuration on the box to `ℤ^d` by declaring every edge outside the box closed.

articles.title: Free random-cluster measure on a box
articles.statement:
The free random-cluster measure `φ⁰_n` on the box `Λ_n`, pushed to the configuration space of
`ℤ^d` by `extendEdge`.

articles.title: Free infinite-volume measure is a subsequential weak limit
articles.statement:
`freeInfiniteVolume` is the weak limit of `freeFiniteMeasure` along some strictly increasing
sequence of box sizes.

articles.title: Free infinite-volume random-cluster measure
articles.statement:
A free infinite-volume random-cluster measure on `ℤ^d`: a weak limit of a subsequence of
`freeFiniteMeasure d n`, chosen by Prokhorov compactness.

articles.title: Wired random-cluster measure on a box
articles.statement:
The wired random-cluster measure `φ¹_n` on the box `Λ_n` (boundary vertices wired), pushed to
the configuration space of `ℤ^d` by `extendEdge`.

articles.title: Wired random-cluster measure as a probability mass function
articles.statement: The wired random-cluster measure on a finite graph, as a probability mass function.

articles.title: Wired random-cluster probability of a configuration
articles.statement: The wired random-cluster probability of a configuration, `wiredFkWeight / wiredFkZ`.

articles.title: Wired random-cluster weight
articles.statement:
The unnormalized wired random-cluster weight `edgeProduct G p ω · q ^ k¹(ω)`, where `k¹` counts
clusters after wiring all boundary vertices together.

articles.title: Wired random-cluster partition function
articles.statement: The wired partition function: the sum of `wiredFkWeight` over all configurations.

articles.title: Wired infinite-volume measure is a subsequential weak limit
articles.statement:
`wiredInfiniteVolume` is the weak limit of `wiredFiniteMeasure` along some strictly increasing
sequence of box sizes.

articles.title: Wired infinite-volume random-cluster measure
articles.statement:
A wired infinite-volume random-cluster measure on `ℤ^d`: a weak limit of a subsequence of
`wiredFiniteMeasure d n`, chosen by Prokhorov compactness.

articles.title: FKG inequality for free $q = 2$ box measures on smaller-box events
articles.statement:
FKG inequality for the free box measure `φ⁰_m` (`q = 2`) on two increasing cylinder events of a
smaller box `Λ_N`, `N ≤ m`.

articles.title: FKG inequality for the wired $q = 2$ infinite-volume measure
articles.statement:
FKG inequality for the wired infinite-volume measure at `q = 2` on increasing cylinder events of
a box.

articles.title: FKG inequality for the free $q = 2$ infinite-volume measure
articles.statement:
FKG inequality for the free infinite-volume measure at `q = 2` on increasing cylinder events of
a box.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ measure dominates the free one on increasing cylinders
articles.statement:
At `q = 2` the free infinite-volume measure gives every increasing cylinder event at most the
probability the wired one gives it.

articles.title: FKG inequality for wired $q = 2$ box measures on smaller-box events
articles.statement:
FKG inequality for the wired box measure `φ¹_m` (`q = 2`) on two increasing cylinder events of a
smaller box `Λ_N`, `N ≤ m`.

articles.title: FKG lattice condition for the wired measure when $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: The wired random-cluster measure satisfies the FKG lattice condition when `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: FKG inequality for the wired measure when $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
FKG inequality for the wired random-cluster measure on a finite graph: increasing events are
positively correlated when `q ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Convergence and ordering at $q = 2$ in subsequence form
articles.statement: Subsequence form of `mvl_infiniteVolume_extremal` (with the identity subsequence).

articles.title: Convergence and ordering of free and wired limits at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
At `q = 2`, for an increasing cylinder event `S`, `φ⁰_m(S) → φ⁰(S)`, `φ¹_m(S) → φ¹(S)`, and
`φ⁰(S) ≤ φ¹(S)`.

articles.title: Translation covariance of free box masses
articles.statement: The free mass of `t` in `Λ_m` equals the free mass of `t + v` in `v + Λ_m`.

articles.title: Translation covariance of wired box masses
articles.statement: The wired mass of `t` in `Λ_m` equals the wired mass of `t + v` in `v + Λ_m`.

articles.title: Wired box measure of an all-open event equals its box mass
articles.statement: The wired box measure on `Λ_m`, pushed to `ℤ^d`, gives `A_t` the box mass of `t`.

articles.title: Wired all-open probabilities converge to the infinite-volume value
articles.statement:
Restatement of `cdc_wired_multiOpenEvent_tendsto`: the wired box probabilities of `A_t`
converge to the wired infinite-volume probability.

articles.title: Free box measure of an all-open event equals its box mass
articles.statement: The free box measure on `Λ_m`, pushed to `ℤ^d`, gives `A_t` the box mass of `t`.

articles.title: Free all-open probabilities converge to the infinite-volume value
articles.statement:
Restatement of `cdc_free_multiOpenEvent_tendsto`: the free box probabilities of `A_t`
converge to the free infinite-volume probability.

articles.title: Free translation invariance from free placements of every shift
articles.statement:
The free infinite-volume `q = 2` measure is translation invariant if every shift has a free
placement. See also `bdp_freeIV_isTranslationInvariant`, which proves invariance without
hypotheses.

articles.title: Equal free probabilities from eventually equal translated masses
articles.statement:
If the free mass of `t + v` in `v + Λ_m` eventually equals the free mass of `t'` in `Λ_m`,
the free infinite-volume measure gives `A_t` and `A_{t'}` the same probability.

articles.title: Free placement for a shift via eventually equal box masses
articles.statement: A free placement for the shift `g`, defined as `med_wiredPlacement` with free masses.

articles.title: Event that all edges of a finite set are open
articles.statement:
The event `A_t` that every edge of the finite set `t` is open. On box configurations it is
`cdc_boxMultiOpenEvent` (`med_boxMultiOpenEvent_eq`).

articles.title: Mass of the all-open event under a weight function
articles.statement:
The mass `∑_ω 1_{A_t}(ω) μ(ω)` of the event that every edge of `t` is open, for a weight
function `μ` on a finite configuration space; it is `eventMassProb μ A_t`
(`med_multiMassProb_eq_eventMassProb`).

articles.title: Difference of wired all-open masses of an edge set and its translate
articles.statement:
The difference between the wired mass of `t` in `Λ_m` and the wired mass of `t + v` in
`v + Λ_m`; it vanishes by translation covariance.

articles.title: Wired translation invariance from wired placements of every shift
articles.statement:
The wired infinite-volume `q = 2` measure is translation invariant if every shift has a wired
placement. See also `flc_wiredIV_isTranslationInvariant`, which proves invariance without
hypotheses.

articles.title: Equal wired probabilities from eventually equal translated masses
articles.statement:
If the wired mass of `t + v` in `v + Λ_m` eventually equals the wired mass of `t'` in `Λ_m`,
the wired infinite-volume measure gives `A_t` and `A_{t'}` the same probability.

articles.title: Wired placement for a shift via eventually equal box masses
articles.statement:
A wired placement for the shift `g`: every finite edge set `s` and its shift `g⁻¹ s` are
images of box edge sets `t`, `t'` of a common box `Λ_N` such that the wired mass of `t + g` in
`g + Λ_m` eventually equals the wired mass of `t'` in `Λ_m`. See also `lmc_wiredPlacement`.

articles.title: Closed annulus plus inner-boundary wiring gives wired $\Lambda_n$ law
articles.statement:
With all annulus edges closed and a wiring made of the inner-boundary clique and an annulus
wiring `D`, the conditional measure on `Λ_(n+1)` equals the wired measure on `Λ_n`, on any event
pulled back by `crossExt`.

articles.title: Closed-annulus wired bound on origin-to-$\partial\Lambda_n$, $q = 2$
articles.statement:
At `q = 2`, the wired measure on `Λ_(n+1)` conditioned on all annulus edges closed gives `{0 ↔
∂Λ_n}` at most `φ¹_n(0 ↔ ∂Λ_n)`.

articles.title: Origin-to-$\partial\Lambda_n$ event as an event on $\Lambda_{n+1}$
articles.statement: The event on `Λ_(n+1)` that the origin is connected to `∂Λ_n` by open edges of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Common subsequence with free and wired weak limits
articles.statement: Free and wired box measures have weak limits along a common strictly increasing subsequence.

articles.title: Ordered free and wired subsequential limits exist for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1` there are a subsequence and weak limits `φ0` (free) and `φ1` (wired) along it with
`φ0(A) ≤ φ1(A)` for all clopen increasing `A`.

articles.title: Free limit at most wired limit along a common subsequence, $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
If free and wired box measures converge weakly to `ν₀` and `ν₁` along a common subsequence and
`q ≥ 1`, then `ν₀(A) ≤ ν₁(A)` for every clopen increasing event `A`.

articles.title: Wired crossing probabilities converge to the percolation probability
articles.statement:
The crossing probabilities of the wired infinite-volume measure converge to the percolation
probability `fkTheta`.

articles.title: Wired probability that the origin connects to the outside of a box
articles.statement:
The probability, under the chosen wired infinite-volume measure, that the origin is connected to
the complement of `Λ_(n-1)`.

articles.title: Crossing events intersect to the percolation event
articles.statement:
The crossing events intersect to the percolation event. See also
`Percolation.percolationEvent_eq_iInter` (`Sharpness`), the same fact indexed from `n + 1`.

articles.title: Conditional free probabilities depend only on the outer configuration
articles.statement: Configurations agreeing off `F` give the same conditional random-cluster probabilities.

articles.title: Domain Markov property
articles.statement:
Conditionally on the configuration `ψ` outside `Λ_n`, the free
random-cluster measure on `Λ_(n+1)` restricted to `Λ_n` is the random-cluster measure on `Λ_n` with
the wiring induced by `ψ`.

articles.title: Conditional free measure as an induced-wiring measure
articles.statement:
The conditional free measure of an event of `Λ_n` equals its probability under the
induced-wiring measure.

articles.title: Free $q=2$ box masses of increasing cylinders tend to infinite volume
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, the free box measures of an increasing cylinder event converge, along the whole
sequence of boxes, to its free infinite-volume measure.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ box measures are bounded by the limit value
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, every free box measure of a `Λ_N` cylinder event with `N ≤ m` is at most
`fkFreeLimitValue`.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ box measures of increasing cylinders converge
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, the free box measures of an increasing `Λ_N` cylinder event converge to
`fkFreeLimitValue`.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ infinite-volume mass of increasing cylinders as a box limit
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, the free infinite-volume measure of an increasing cylinder event equals
`fkFreeLimitValue`.

articles.title: One-step growth of free $q = 2$ measures of increasing cylinders
articles.statement:
For `q = 2` and `N ≤ m`, the free `Λ_m` measure of an increasing `Λ_N` cylinder event is at most
its free `Λ_(m+1)` measure.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ box measures of increasing cylinders are monotone
articles.statement: For `q = 2`, the free box measures of an increasing `Λ_N` cylinder event increase with the box.

articles.title: Limit of free $q = 2$ box measures of a cylinder event
articles.statement:
The limit `sup_k φ⁰_{Λ_(N+k)}(S)` of the free `q = 2` box measures of a `Λ_N` cylinder event
`S`.

articles.title: Fibre-mass factorization of random-cluster probabilities
articles.statement: A random-cluster probability is its fibre mass times its conditional probability.

articles.title: Conditional free measure dominates the smaller free box for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, conditionally on any outer configuration, the free measure on `Λ_(n+1)` gives an
increasing event of `Λ_n` at least its free `Λ_n` probability.

articles.title: Free measure is dominated by induced-wiring measures for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the free measure on `Λ_n` gives an increasing event at most its probability under
any induced wiring.

articles.title: Random-cluster weight of a glued configuration factorizes
articles.statement:
The random-cluster weight of a glued configuration factors as the outer factor times the weight
of `ω` with the induced wiring.

articles.title: Free box measure of a cylinder event as a finite sum
articles.statement: The free `Λ_m` measure of a `Λ_m` cylinder event, as a finite sum.

articles.title: Free box measures are at most one
articles.statement: Free box measures are at most `1`.

articles.title: Increasing box events gain free $q = 2$ probability in the next box
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, the free `Λ_n` probability of an increasing `Λ_n` event is at most its free
`Λ_(n+1)` measure.

articles.title: Next-box free measure of a cylinder event as a finite sum
articles.statement: The free `Λ_(n+1)` measure of a `Λ_n` cylinder event, as a finite sum.

articles.title: Decomposition of the free measure over the outer configuration
articles.statement: Decomposition of the free measure on `Λ_(n+1)` over the configuration outside `Λ_n`.

articles.title: One-step box monotonicity of free measures for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the free measure on `Λ_(n+1)` gives an increasing event of `Λ_n` at least its free
`Λ_n` probability.

articles.title: Cluster decomposition of the glued configuration
articles.statement:
Clusters of the glued configuration correspond to clusters of `innerGraphFree` plus outer
clusters avoiding `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Injectivity of the free cluster map
articles.statement: The cluster map is injective.

articles.title: Cluster map on inner clusters
articles.statement: The cluster map on an inner cluster.

articles.title: Cluster map on avoiding outer clusters
articles.statement: The cluster map on an outer cluster avoiding `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Surjectivity of the free cluster map
articles.statement: The cluster map is surjective.

articles.title: Cluster map into the glued configuration
articles.statement:
The map from clusters of `innerGraphFree` and outer clusters avoiding `Λ_n` to clusters of the
glued configuration.

articles.title: Glued open edges at outer vertices are outer edges
articles.statement: An edge of the glued open graph at a vertex outside `Λ_n` is an outer open edge.

articles.title: Inner-graph connections are glued-graph connections
articles.statement: Connections in `innerGraphFree` are connections in the glued open graph.

articles.title: Open graph of a glued configuration
articles.statement: The open graph on `Λ_(n+1)` of `ω` on `Λ_n` glued into `ψ`.

articles.title: Conditional partition function in terms of the induced wiring
articles.statement:
The conditional partition function given the outer configuration, in terms of the induced-wiring
partition function.

articles.title: Adjacency criterion for the free induced wiring
articles.statement: Unfolding adjacency in the induced wiring.

articles.title: Wiring induced on a box by outer open edges
articles.statement:
The boundary wiring on `Λ_n` induced by an outer configuration `ψ` on `Λ_(n+1)`: two distinct
vertices of `Λ_n` are wired when `ψ` connects them by open edges outside `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Glued connections between inner vertices are inner-graph connections
articles.statement:
Connections in the glued open graph between vertices of `Λ_n` are connections in
`innerGraphFree`.

articles.title: Outer open connections give connections in the inner graph
articles.statement: Vertices of `Λ_n` connected by outer open edges are connected in `innerGraphFree`.

articles.title: Inner open graph with the free induced wiring
articles.statement: The open graph of `ω` on `Λ_n` together with the wiring induced by `ψ`.

articles.title: An outer cluster avoids the inner box iff its representative does
articles.statement: An outer cluster avoids `Λ_n` exactly when its representative vertex does.

articles.title: Outer open cluster avoiding the inner box
articles.statement: An outer open cluster that contains no vertex of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Cluster count of a glued configuration splits additively
articles.statement:
The cluster count of a glued configuration is the cluster count of `ω` with the induced wiring
plus the number of outer clusters avoiding `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Outer open clusters avoiding the inner box
articles.statement: The outer open clusters that contain no vertex of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Avoiding the inner box is constant on outer open clusters
articles.statement: Avoiding `Λ_n` is constant on outer open clusters.

articles.title: A vertex whose outer cluster avoids the inner box lies outside it
articles.statement: A vertex whose outer cluster avoids `Λ_n` is not in `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Outer vertex whose outer open cluster avoids the inner box
articles.statement: A vertex of `Λ_(n+1)` whose outer open cluster contains no vertex of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Outer open graph lies in the glued open graph
articles.statement: The outer open graph is contained in the glued open graph.

articles.title: Glued connections from an avoiding vertex are outer connections
articles.statement: From a vertex whose outer cluster avoids `Λ_n`, glued connections are outer connections.

articles.title: Number of outer open clusters avoiding the inner box
articles.statement: The number of outer open clusters avoiding `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Glued open graph is the union of inner and outer open edges
articles.statement:
The open graph of a glued configuration is the union of the open edges of `Λ_n` and the outer
open edges.

articles.title: Positivity of the outer weight factor
articles.statement: The outer weight factor is positive.

articles.title: Outer factor of the weight of a glued configuration
articles.statement:
The factor of the random-cluster weight of a glued configuration contributed by the outer
configuration.

articles.title: Fibre masses of the free measure sum to one
articles.statement: The masses of the conditioning fibres of the free measure on `Λ_(n+1)` sum to `1`.

articles.title: Secant bound gives free–wired density agreement off a countable set
articles.statement:
Under the secant comparison `wired(p') ≤ free(p)` for `p' < p`, the free and wired densities
of a box edge agree for all `p ∈ (0, 1)` outside a countable set, namely the discontinuities of
the monotone wired density.

articles.title: Off-centre carrier vanishes by translation covariance
articles.statement:
The off-centre carrier vanishes for every `k`, by translation covariance of the wired box
measures.

articles.title: Off-centre carrier tends to zero
articles.statement: The off-centre carrier tends to zero, for every `p`.

articles.title: Free density is at most each translated wired marginal
articles.statement: The free `q = 2` density of `e` is at most the wired marginal of `e + v` in `v + Λ_{N+k}`.

articles.title: Translated wired marginals converge to the wired density
articles.statement:
The wired marginals of the translated edge `e + v` in `v + Λ_{N+k}` converge to the wired
`q = 2` density of `e`.

articles.title: Equal wired densities from equal translated marginals
articles.statement:
If for every `k` the wired marginal of `e' + v` in `v + Λ_{N+k}` equals the wired marginal of
`e` in `Λ_{N+k}`, then `e` and `e'` have the same wired density.

articles.title: Number of annulus vertices between consecutive boxes
articles.statement: The number of vertices of the annulus `Λ_{n+1} \ Λ_n`.

articles.title: Inclusion of the annulus wiring into the extra-wired graph
articles.statement: The inclusion of the annulus wiring into `crossWiredGraphAdd`.

articles.title: Restriction of a wiring to the annulus vertices
articles.statement: The restriction of `D` to the annulus vertices.

articles.title: Vertices of the annulus between consecutive boxes
articles.statement: The vertices of the annulus `Λ_{n+1} \ Λ_n`.

articles.title: Box as an induced subgraph of the next box
articles.statement: `Λ_n` as an induced subgraph of `Λ_{n+1}`.

articles.title: Inclusion of box vertices into the next box
articles.statement: The inclusion of the vertices of `Λ_n` into `Λ_{n+1}`. The case `m = n + 1` of `boxVertInclLE`.

articles.title: Domain Markov property for the wired box measure
articles.statement:
Conditioned on every edge outside `Λ_n` being
closed, the random-cluster measure on `Λ_{n+1}` with the boundary of `Λ_n` wired is the wired
random-cluster measure on `Λ_n` (Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, 2006, Lemma 4.13).

articles.title: Map from inner and annulus-wiring components to extra-wired ones
articles.statement:
Components of `crossWiredGraphAdd` from wired components of `ω` in `Λ_n` and components of the
annulus wiring.

articles.title: Extra-wired components as inner plus annulus-wiring components
articles.statement:
Components of `crossWiredGraphAdd` are the wired components of `ω` in `Λ_n` plus the components
of
the annulus wiring.

articles.title: Map from inner wired components and annulus vertices to components
articles.statement: Components of `crossWiredGraph` from wired components of `ω` in `Λ_n` and annulus vertices.

articles.title: Extended-graph components as inner components plus annulus vertices
articles.statement:
Components of `crossWiredGraph` are the wired components of `ω` in `Λ_n` plus one singleton per
annulus vertex.

articles.title: Extension of a configuration closing the annulus edges
articles.statement:
The extension of a configuration of `Λ_n` to `Λ_{n+1}` that closes every edge not coming from
`Λ_n`.

articles.title: Annulus constant counting the components of an extra wiring
articles.statement: The constant `(1 - p)^{#annulus edges} q^{#components of the annulus wiring}`.

articles.title: Annulus constant linking the extended and wired inner weights
articles.statement:
The constant `(1 - p)^{#annulus edges} q^{#annulus vertices}` relating the extended weight to
the
wired weight on `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Extended wired graph with an extra wiring added
articles.statement: `crossWiredGraph` with the extra wiring `D` added.

articles.title: Extended open graph with the inner box boundary wired
articles.statement: The open subgraph of `crossExt ω` in `Λ_{n+1}` with the boundary of `Λ_n` wired.

articles.title: Vertex on the boundary of the inner box
articles.statement: A vertex of `Λ_{n+1}` on the vertex boundary of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Edges of the next box coming from the inner box
articles.statement: The edges of `Λ_{n+1}` coming from `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Inclusion of box edges into the next box
articles.statement: The inclusion of edges (unordered pairs) of `Λ_n` into `Λ_{n+1}`.

articles.title: Configurations closed off the inner edges as inner-box configurations
articles.statement: Configurations of `Λ_{n+1}` closed off the inner edges correspond to configurations of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Restriction of a next-box configuration to the inner edges
articles.statement: The restriction of a configuration of `Λ_{n+1}` to the edges of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Open graph of a box configuration with the box boundary wired
articles.statement: The open subgraph of `ω` in `Λ_n` with the boundary of `Λ_n` wired.

articles.title: Inclusion of the wired inner graph into the extra-wired graph
articles.statement: The inclusion of the wired open graph of `Λ_n` into `crossWiredGraphAdd`.

articles.title: Inclusion of the wired inner graph into the extended wired graph
articles.statement: The inclusion of the wired open graph of `Λ_n` into `crossWiredGraph`.

articles.title: Wiring with every edge inside the annulus
articles.statement: Every edge of `D` joins vertices of the annulus `Λ_{n+1} \ Λ_n`.

articles.title: Vertex of the next box lying in the inner box
articles.statement: A vertex of `Λ_{n+1}` lies in `Λ_n`.
