articles.title: Number of next-box edges not coming from the inner box
articles.statement: The number of edges of `Λ_{n+1}` not coming from `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Wired infinite-volume measure as limit on increasing cylinder events
articles.statement:
Existence of the wired infinite-volume random-cluster measure as the limit of wired box
measures, on increasing cylinder events at `q = 2`: `φ¹_m(S) → φ¹(S)` as `m → ∞`. The general
statement (all `q ≥ 1`, weak convergence) is in Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model* (2006), Chapter
4.

articles.title: Wired box probabilities of increasing cylinder events converge
articles.statement:
At `q = 2` the wired box probabilities of an increasing cylinder event converge to
`fkWiredLimitValue`.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ increasing-event probabilities do not grow with the box
articles.statement:
At `q = 2`, enlarging the wired box from `Λ_m` to `Λ_(m+1)` does not increase the probability of
an increasing cylinder event of `Λ_N`, `N ≤ m`.

articles.title: Infimum of wired box probabilities of a box event
articles.statement: The infimum over `k` of `φ¹_(N+k)(S)` for an event `S` of the box `Λ_N`, at `q = 2`.

articles.title: Wired infinite-volume probability equals the infimum over boxes
articles.statement:
At `q = 2` the chosen wired infinite-volume measure gives an increasing cylinder event the value
`fkWiredLimitValue`.

articles.title: Box-boundary connection probability tends to percolation probability
articles.statement:
For any finite measure, the probability that the origin is connected to the boundary of the box
of radius `n` inside the box tends to the percolation probability.

articles.title: Event that the open cluster of a site is infinite
articles.statement: The event `{x ↔ ∞}` that the open cluster of `x` is infinite.

articles.title: A connection to outside the box passes through the box boundary
articles.statement: A connection from the origin to a site outside the box passes through the box boundary.

articles.title: Crossing probabilities converge to the percolation probability
articles.statement:
For any finite measure, the probability that the origin is connected to the complement of the
box of radius `n - 1` tends to the percolation probability.

articles.title: Joint percolation at most connectivity given no two infinite clusters
articles.statement: With at most one infinite cluster almost surely, `μ(x ↔ ∞, y ↔ ∞) ≤ μ(x ↔ y)`.

articles.title: Two-point connectivity of a bond measure on $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: The two-point connectivity `μ(x ↔ y)` of a measure on bond configurations of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Uniform decay of two-point connectivity without percolation
articles.statement:
Without percolation, the two-point connectivity from the origin tends to zero uniformly: for
every `ε > 0` there is `n` with `μ(0 ↔ x) < ε` for all `x` outside the box of radius `n`.

articles.title: Two-point lower bound from FKG, invariance, uniqueness and percolation
articles.statement:
If `μ` satisfies the FKG inequality for the events `{x ↔ ∞}` (`hPA`), is translation
invariant on them (`hTI`), has at most one infinite cluster almost surely (`huniq`), and
percolates (`htheta`), then `μ(0 ↔ x) ≥ θ²` for every `x`.

articles.title: Disconnected sites in infinite clusters give two infinite clusters
articles.statement:
If `x` and `y` both lie in infinite clusters, either they are connected or there are at least
two infinite clusters.

articles.title: Event that two sites are joined by open edges inside a box
articles.statement: The event that `x` and `y` are joined by open edges inside the box `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Restriction of a configuration of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ to a box
articles.statement: Restriction of a configuration of `ℤ^d` to the edges of the box `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Free box measure of a box connection event is the two-point function
articles.statement: The free box measure of the connection event in `Λ_n` is the finite-volume two-point function.

articles.title: Convergence to the free two-point function under stochastic increase
articles.statement:
If the free box measures increase stochastically in `n`, then `φ⁰_n(x ↔ y in Λ_N)` converges to
`freeIvTwoPoint`.

articles.title: Free infinite-volume two-point function in a box
articles.statement:
The free infinite-volume two-point function in `Λ_N`: the supremum over `n` of `φ⁰_n(x ↔ y in
Λ_N)`.

articles.title: Cylinder events of a box are clopen
articles.statement: Cylinder events of the box `Λ_N` are clopen.

articles.title: Box restriction pulls increasing events back to increasing events
articles.statement: The preimage of an increasing event under box restriction is increasing.

articles.title: Masses of clopen increasing events converge along decreasing measures
articles.statement:
Along a stochastically decreasing sequence of measures, the mass of a clopen increasing event
converges to its infimum.

articles.title: Infimum of the masses of an event along a measure sequence
articles.statement: The infimum over `n` of the masses `μ n A` of an event `A`.

articles.title: Supremum of the masses of an event along a measure sequence
articles.statement: The supremum over `n` of the masses `μ n A` of an event `A`.

articles.title: Cylinder events of a box are measurable
articles.statement: Cylinder events of the box `Λ_N` are measurable.

articles.title: Wired random-cluster probabilities are positive
articles.statement: Every configuration has positive wired random-cluster probability.

articles.title: Convergence to the wired two-point function under stochastic decrease
articles.statement:
If the wired box measures decrease stochastically in `n`, then `φ¹_n(x ↔ y in Λ_N)` converges to
`wiredIvTwoPoint`.

articles.title: Wired infinite-volume two-point function in a box
articles.statement:
The wired infinite-volume two-point function in `Λ_N`: the infimum over `n` of `φ¹_n(x ↔ y in
Λ_N)`.

articles.title: Outer projection agrees with the configuration off $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: The projection agrees with the configuration off the edges of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ percolation probability as the limit of $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_n$ in $\Lambda_n$
Boundary connection of $\Lambda_n$ is a $\Lambda_m$ cylinder event
articles.statement: The event `0 ↔ ∂Λ_n` is a `Λ_m` cylinder event for every `m ≥ n`.

articles.title: Boundary connection inside $\Lambda_n$ reaches outside $\Lambda_{n-1}$
articles.statement: A connection from the origin to `∂Λ_n` inside `Λ_n` reaches the complement of `Λ_(n-1)`.

articles.title: Events $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_n$ decrease in $n \ge 1$
articles.statement: The events `0 ↔ ∂Λ_n` decrease in `n ≥ 1`.

articles.title: One-step decrease of the events $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: The events `0 ↔ ∂Λ_n` decrease in `n`.

articles.title: Open path from the origin out of $\Lambda_n$ gives $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_n$ inside $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: A connection from the origin to a site outside `Λ_n` gives a connection to `∂Λ_n` inside `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Ising FK box-boundary connection profile tends to $\theta^1(p, 2)$
articles.statement: The box-boundary connection profile of the Ising FK representation converges to `θ¹(p, 2)`.

articles.title: Inner vertices next to the annulus lie on $\partial\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: A vertex of `Λ_n` adjacent to a vertex of `Λ_(n+1) \ Λ_n` lies on `∂Λ_n`.

articles.title: Open lattice edges between box vertices are open box edges
articles.statement: An open edge of `ℤ^d` between box vertices is an open edge of the box.

articles.title: Restriction to $\Lambda_n$ factors through $\Lambda_m$
articles.statement: Restricting to `Λ_m` and then to `Λ_n` is restricting to `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Monotonicity of restriction between boxes
articles.statement: Restriction between boxes is monotone.

articles.title: Restriction of a configuration from $\Lambda_m$ to $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: Restrict a configuration on `Λ_m` to `Λ_n` for `n ≤ m`.

articles.title: Box inclusion maps the origin to the origin
articles.statement: The inclusion `Λ_n → Λ_(n+1)` maps the origin to the origin.

articles.title: Inclusion of $\Lambda_n$ into $\Lambda_m$ for $n \le m$
articles.statement: The inclusion `Λ_n → Λ_m` for `n ≤ m`.

articles.title: Configurations agreeing off $F$ have equal conditional probabilities
articles.statement: Configurations agreeing off `F` give the same conditional random-cluster probabilities.

articles.title: Conditional wired decrease on inner increasing events for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, conditionally on any outer configuration, the wired measure on `Λ_(n+1)` gives an
increasing event of `Λ_n` at most its wired `Λ_n` probability.

articles.title: Configurations agreeing off $F$ have the same conditioning fibre
articles.statement: Configurations agreeing off `F` have the same conditioning fibre.

articles.title: Boundary-connection event of $\Lambda_n$ as an event on $\Lambda_m$
articles.statement: The event `0 ↔ ∂Λ_n` inside `Λ_n`, as an event on `Λ_m` for `n ≤ m`.

articles.title: Paths to $\partial\Lambda_{n+1}$ pass through $\partial\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: A connection from the origin to `∂Λ_(n+1)` inside `Λ_(n+1)` passes through `∂Λ_n`.

articles.title: Open connections in a box are open connections in $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: An open connection inside the box is an open connection in `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Leaving $\Lambda_n$ implies connecting to $\partial\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: Reaching the complement of `Λ_n` implies `0 ↔ ∂Λ_n`.

articles.title: Edge inclusion into $\mathbb{Z}^d$ factors through $\Lambda_m$
articles.statement: Including an edge into `Λ_m` and then into `ℤ^d` is including it into `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Configurations with a given outer part form its conditioning fibre
articles.statement: The configurations with outer part `ψ` form the conditioning fibre of `ψ`.

articles.title: Inclusion of edges of $\Lambda_n$ into edges of $\Lambda_m$
articles.statement: The inclusion of edges of `Λ_n` into edges of `Λ_m` for `n ≤ m`.

articles.title: Boundary-connection event of $\Lambda_n$ on $\Lambda_m$ is increasing
articles.statement: The event `connToBdryEventLE` is increasing.

articles.title: Origin-to-boundary connection is an increasing event
articles.statement: The event that the origin is connected to the box boundary is increasing.

articles.title: Cylinder form of the $\Lambda_n$ boundary connection is measurable
articles.statement: The cylinder form of `0 ↔ ∂Λ_n` is measurable.

articles.title: Open edges of $\Lambda_n$ are open edges of $\Lambda_{n+1}$
articles.statement: An open edge of `Λ_n` is an open edge of `Λ_(n+1)`.

articles.title: Open edges of a box are open edges of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: An open edge of the box is an open edge of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Outer projection closes the edges of $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: The projection closes edges of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Outer projection keeps the edges outside $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: The projection keeps edges outside `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Outer projection is idempotent
articles.statement: The projection is idempotent.

articles.title: Outer part of a configuration on $\Lambda_{n+1}$
articles.statement:
Project a configuration on `Λ_(n+1)` to its outer part: edges of `Λ_n` closed, the others
unchanged.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ probability of $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_k$ in $\Lambda_{k+j}$ is nonincreasing in $j$
articles.statement: For `q = 2`, `j ↦ φ¹_{Λ_(k+j)}(0 ↔ ∂Λ_k)` is antitone.

articles.title: Masses of the conditioning fibres sum to one
articles.statement: The masses of the conditioning fibres over all outer configurations sum to `1`.

articles.title: Antitone bounded-below sequences converge to any subsequential limit
articles.statement: A bounded-below antitone real sequence converges to the limit of any of its subsequences.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ probability of $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_n$ in $\Lambda_{n+k+1}$ at most in $\Lambda_{n+k}$
Wired $q = 2$ probability of $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_n$ in $\Lambda_n$ is nonincreasing in $n$
Infinite-volume limit of the wired $q = 2$ probability of $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_k$
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, `φ¹_{Λ_(k+j)}(0 ↔ ∂Λ_k)` converges as `j → ∞` to the wired infinite-volume
probability of `0 ↔ ∂Λ_k`.

articles.title: Wired $\Lambda_m$ measure of a $\Lambda_m$ cylinder event as a sum
articles.statement: The wired `Λ_m` measure of a `Λ_m` cylinder event, as a finite sum.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ probability of $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_n$ in $\Lambda_{m+1}$ at most in $\Lambda_m$, $m \ge n$
Wired $q = 2$ probability of $0 \leftrightarrow \partial\Lambda_n$ in $\Lambda_{n+1}$ at most in $\Lambda_n$
Wired box measures decrease on increasing cylinder events at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, the wired `Λ_(n+1)` measure of an increasing `Λ_n` cylinder event is at most its
wired `Λ_n` probability.

articles.title: Wired $\Lambda_{n+1}$ measure of a $\Lambda_n$ cylinder event as a sum
articles.statement: The wired `Λ_(n+1)` measure of a `Λ_n` cylinder event, as a finite sum.

articles.title: Wired infinite-volume boundary connection tends to $\theta^1(p, q)$
articles.statement: Under the wired infinite-volume measure, `P(0 ↔ ∂Λ_n) → θ¹(p, q)`.

articles.title: Wired $\Lambda_{n+1}$ measure decomposed over outer configurations
articles.statement: Decomposition of the wired measure on `Λ_(n+1)` over the configuration outside `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Wired box measures decrease on inner increasing events for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `q ≥ 1`, the wired measure on `Λ_(n+1)` gives an increasing event of `Λ_n` at most its wired
`Λ_n` probability.

articles.title: Agreement with a monotone map at continuity points fails countably
articles.statement:
If `a` agrees with a monotone `b` at every continuity point of `b`, then `{p | a p ≠ b p}` is
countable.

articles.title: Countably many parameters admit a separating increasing event
articles.statement:
Under the hypotheses of `phi0_eq_phi1_off_countable`, the set of `p` for which some increasing
event separates `μ p` and `ν p` is countable.

articles.title: Wired–free gap in the $q = 2$ density of a box edge
articles.statement:
The gap `φ^1_{p,2}(eb open) - φ^0_{p,2}(eb open)` between the wired and free infinite-volume
densities of the edge `eb` of `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Boxes satisfy the additive doubling bound for $d \ge 1$
articles.statement: For `d ≥ 1`, `ecz_u` satisfies the doubling bound along the scales `K_j = 2^{j+1} - 1`.

articles.title: Additive doubling bound for the edge partition function
articles.statement: The doubling bound `agl_AdditiveDoublingBound` with `-log fkZ` replaced by `ecz_u`.

articles.title: Vanishing block oscillation of the edge free energy
articles.statement: The edge free energy of `Λ_n` differs from that of `Λ_{K_{b(n)}}` by a vanishing oscillation.

articles.title: Van Hove tiling bound for the edge partition function
articles.statement:
Van Hove bound: `ecz_u d t n` is at most `T^d · ecz_u d t m` plus the cost of the leftover
strip
and of the interfaces between cells, where `T = ⌊(2n + 1)/(2m + 1)⌋`.

articles.title: Graph isomorphism between a sub-box and a tiling cell
articles.statement: Each tiling cell induces a graph isomorphic to `Λ_m`.

articles.title: Translation between a sub-box and a tiling cell
articles.statement: The vertices of `Λ_m` correspond to the vertices of the cell `c` by translation.

articles.title: Coordinate index of the tiling cell containing a site
articles.statement: The index along coordinate `i` of the tiling cell containing `x`.

articles.title: Center of a cell in the tiling of a box by sub-boxes
articles.statement: The center of the cell indexed by `c` in the tiling of `Λ_n` by translates of `Λ_m`.

articles.title: Configurations closed off the edges of a graph
articles.statement: Configurations closed on every coordinate that is not an edge of `G`.

articles.title: Per-edge free energy of a box in the tilt variable
articles.statement: The per-edge free energy of `Λ_n` in the tilt variable, computed from `ecz_fkZEdge`.

articles.title: Per-edge negative log edge partition function of a box
articles.statement: The per-edge free energy `ecz_u d s n / |E(Λ_n)|`.

articles.title: Each non-edge contributes a factor 2 to the partition function
articles.statement:
`fkZ G p q = 2^{#non-edges} · ecz_fkZEdge G p q`: each non-edge coordinate contributes a free
factor
`2`.

articles.title: Per-box $q = 2$ uniqueness off a countable set of tilts
articles.statement:
For `d ≥ 1`, a fixed box `Λ_N` with an edge witness, the free and wired `q = 2` measures
agree on every increasing event of `Λ_N` for all `t = logit(p)` outside a countable set in `t`.
This is the per-box `q = 2` case of `fkgq_countable_free_wired_disagreement`.

articles.title: Edge partition function of the random-cluster model
articles.statement: The edge partition function: the sum of FK weights over configurations closed off `E(G)`.

articles.title: Upper envelope for the per-edge free energy
articles.statement:
An upper envelope for `ecz_f` combining the per-edge value at scale `m` with the all-closed
bound.

articles.title: Number of non-edge coordinates of a graph
articles.statement: The number of coordinates `Sym2 V` that are not edges of `G`.

articles.title: Interface subadditivity of $-\log$ of the edge partition function
Per-edge free energy of boxes converges for $d \ge 1$
articles.statement: For `d ≥ 1`, the per-edge free energy `ecz_u d s n / |E(Λ_n)|` converges.

articles.title: Convergence of the per-edge free energy of boxes
articles.statement: The per-edge free energy `ecz_u d s n / |E(Λ_n)|` converges as `n → ∞`.

articles.title: Restriction of a box to all tiling tags
articles.statement: Restricting `Λ_n` to all tags gives back `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Sub-box as an induced subgraph of a larger box
articles.statement: `Λ_a` is isomorphic to the subgraph of `Λ_n` induced on `Λ_a`.

articles.title: Membership of a box vertex in a sub-box
articles.statement: A vertex of `Λ_n` lies in the sub-box `Λ_a`.

articles.title: Number of sub-box translates along a side of a box
articles.statement: The number `⌊(2n + 1)/(2m + 1)⌋` of translates of `Λ_m` that fit along one side of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Negative log edge partition function of a box
articles.statement: `-log ecz_fkZEdge` of the box `Λ_n` at `p = logistic(t)`, `q = 2`.

articles.title: Negative log edge partition function of a graph
articles.statement: `-log ecz_fkZEdge G p q`.

articles.title: Tiling cell of a box vertex
articles.statement: The tiling cell containing a vertex of `Λ_n`, or `none` if it lies in the leftover strip.

articles.title: Wired-marginal difference between a box and its translate
articles.statement:
The difference between the wired marginal of `eb'` on `Λ_{N+k}` and on the translate of
`Λ_{N+k}` by `v`, evaluated at the translated edge.

articles.title: Event that an edge is open
articles.statement: The event that the edge `e` is open.

articles.title: Monotone-coupled laws with equal edge marginals agree on up-sets
articles.statement:
Two monotonically coupled probability vectors with equal edge marginals agree on increasing
events. Restatement of `eventMass_eq_of_edgeMarg_eq` (`EdgeMarginal`), kept because other modules
use this name.

articles.title: Secant bound gives $q = 2$ edge-event uniqueness off a countable set
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`: assuming `φ^1_{p'}(e open) ≤ φ^0_p(e open)` for `p' < p` in `(0, 1)`, for all but
countably many `p` every measure between the free and wired infinite-volume measures on the
event
`{eb open}` agrees with both.

articles.title: Average edge density of a random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The average edge density `|E|^{-1} E_{φ_{G,p,q}}[#open edges]` at `p = logistic(s)`.

articles.title: Convex limit of centered tilt free energies of boxes for $d, q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `d ≥ 1` and `q ≥ 1`, the centered tilt free energies of the boxes `Λ_n` converge pointwise
to
a convex function `G` with `G(0) = 0`.

articles.title: Per-box uniqueness of the random-cluster measures off a countable set
articles.statement:
For `d ≥ 1`,
`q ≥ 1`, and every box `Λ_N`, the free and wired infinite-volume random-cluster measures on
`ℤ^d` at `p = logistic(t)` give the same mass to every increasing event of `Λ_N`, for all `t`
outside a countable set.

This is a per-box statement only: the countable exceptional set may depend on `N`, the
statement is in the logit parameter `t` rather than in `p ∈ (0, 1)` directly, and it concludes
agreement on increasing events of that one finite restriction, not equality of the
infinite-volume measures. No declaration here takes the countable union over `N`, transfers
it to `p`, or derives equality of the infinite-volume measures. (Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster
Model*, 2006, Theorem 4.60.)

articles.title: Total deviation of free unit-edge marginals from a free density
articles.statement:
The total deviation between the free density of `e` and the free unit-edge marginals on
`Λ_{⌊√n⌋}`, summed over directions.

articles.title: Free infinite-volume mass function on a box for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
The mass function on configurations of `Λ_N` of the free infinite-volume measure at
`p = logistic(s)`.

articles.title: Free unit-edge marginal at $0$ on $\Lambda_{\lfloor\sqrt n\rfloor}$
articles.statement:
The free marginal on `Λ_{⌊√n⌋}` of the unit edge at the origin in direction `dir`, at
`p = logistic(t)`.

articles.title: Wired unit-edge marginal at $0$ on $\Lambda_{\lfloor\sqrt n\rfloor}$
articles.statement:
The wired marginal on `Λ_{⌊√n⌋}` of the unit edge at the origin in direction `dir`, at
`p = logistic(t)`.

articles.title: Total deviation of wired unit-edge marginals from a wired density
articles.statement:
The total deviation between the wired unit-edge marginals on `Λ_{⌊√n⌋}` and the wired density
of
`e`, summed over directions.

articles.title: Wired infinite-volume mass function on a box for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement:
The mass function on configurations of `Λ_N` of the wired infinite-volume measure at
`p = logistic(s)`.

articles.title: Toggle-invariant coordinates are open with probability one half
articles.statement: A coordinate whose toggle preserves a probability mass function is open with probability `1/2`.

articles.title: Countable-exception $q = 2$ uniqueness from one-sided derivative data
articles.statement:
If the free and wired densities of the edges of `Λ_N` are the left and right derivatives of one
convex `G`, the free and wired `q = 2` measures agree on increasing events of `Λ_N` for all but
countably many `t`.

articles.title: Free average edge density collapse on boxes
articles.statement:
The average free edge density of `Λ_n` converges to the free infinite-volume density of every
edge
of `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Free densities of genuine box edges as left derivatives
articles.statement:
Every edge of `Λ_N` has free `q = 2` density at `p = logistic(t)` equal to the left derivative
`G'₋(t)`.

articles.title: Wired average edge density collapse on boxes
articles.statement:
The average wired edge density of `Λ_n` converges to the wired infinite-volume density of every
edge of `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Wired densities of genuine box edges as right derivatives
articles.statement:
Every edge of `Λ_N` has wired `q = 2` density at `p = logistic(t)` equal to the right
derivative
`G'₊(t)`.

articles.title: Per-coordinate free energy on a box
articles.statement:
The per-coordinate free energy on `Λ_N`: `G` on edges of the box graph and `s ↦ s/2` on
non-edges.

articles.title: Free infinite-volume edge density
articles.statement:
The edge density `φ^0_{p,q}(e open)` of the free infinite-volume random-cluster measure on
`ℤ^d`, set to `0` outside `p ∈ (0, 1)`, `q > 0`.

articles.title: Free-energy data give $q = 2$ box uniqueness off countably many $t$
articles.statement:
Given `fuc_HomogeneousFreeEnergyData`, the free and wired `q = 2` measures agree on every
increasing event of `Λ_N` for all but countably many `t`.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ infinite-volume mass function on a box
articles.statement:
The mass function on configurations of `Λ_N` of the free `q = 2` infinite-volume measure at
`p = logistic(t)`, restricted to `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Homogeneous free-energy data on a box at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
There is a convex `g` whose right and left derivatives at `t` are the wired and free `q = 2`
edge
densities at `p = logistic(t)`, for every edge of `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ infinite-volume mass function on a box
articles.statement:
The mass function on configurations of `Λ_N` of the wired `q = 2` infinite-volume measure at
`p = logistic(t)`, restricted to `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Two-sided free $q = 2$ bulk bounds from the free sandwich
articles.statement:
The free sandwich gives two-sided bulk bounds: free marginals within `δ_n` of the density,
since free marginals increase to the density.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ bulk sandwich from equal free edge densities
articles.statement:
If every free `q = 2` edge density equals that of `e'`, then each box `Λ_n` has a bulk set of
edges with that density whose free marginals are at least the density minus `δ_n → 0`, and the
non-bulk edge fraction tends to zero.

articles.title: Two-sided wired $q = 2$ bulk bounds from the wired sandwich
articles.statement:
The wired sandwich gives two-sided bulk bounds: wired marginals within `δ_n` of the density,
since wired marginals decrease to the density.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ bulk sandwich from equal wired edge densities
articles.statement:
If every wired `q = 2` edge density equals that of `e'`, then each box `Λ_n` has a bulk set of
edges with that density whose wired marginals are at most the density plus `δ_n → 0`, and the
non-bulk edge fraction tends to zero.

articles.title: Bulk edges of $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: The bulk edges of `Λ_n`: the edges of the inner box `Λ_{n - ⌊√n⌋}`.

articles.title: Shell edge fraction is at most $4d^2(n-m)/n$
articles.statement: The fraction of ordered edges of `Λ_n` outside `Λ_m` is at most `4 d² (n - m)/n`.

articles.title: Adjacent box vertices differ by a signed unit vector
articles.statement: The difference of adjacent box vertices is a signed unit vector. See also `rot_edge_dir`.

articles.title: Vanishing shell edge fraction when $(n - m(n))/n \to 0$
articles.statement:
If `(n - m(n))/n → 0`, the edges of `Λ_n` outside `Λ_{m(n)}` form a vanishing fraction of
the edges of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Lower bound on free bulk edge marginals
articles.statement: Every bulk edge of `Λ_n` has free marginal at least `density(e') - ocs_freeDelta`.

articles.title: Total deviation of free unit-edge marginals from the density
articles.statement:
The total deviation `∑_{(j, sign)} |density(e') - unit-edge marginal|` of the free unit-edge
marginals in `Λ_{⌊√n⌋}` from the free density of `e'`.

articles.title: Free off-centre lower bound by the recentred small-box marginal
articles.statement:
For `u, v` adjacent in `Λ_{n-R}`, the free marginal in `Λ_n` of the edge `{u, v}` is at least
the free marginal in `Λ_R` of the recentered edge `{0, v - u}`.

articles.title: Free off-centre sandwich from free rotation residues
articles.statement: The free off-centre sandwich from the free rotation residues for all pairs `e'` of `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Free rotation residue for a box pair
articles.statement:
The free rotation residue at tilt `t` for the box pair `e'`: every lattice edge of every box
has the free `q = 2` density of `e'` at `p = logistic t`.

articles.title: Free unit-edge marginals converge to the free density
articles.statement: The free marginal of a unit edge in `Λ_{⌊√n⌋}` converges to its free `q = 2` density.

articles.title: Wired unit-edge marginals converge to the wired density
articles.statement: The wired marginal of a unit edge in `Λ_{⌊√n⌋}` converges to its wired `q = 2` density.

articles.title: Unit edge $\{0, \pm e_j\}$ of a box
articles.statement: The unit edge `{0, ±e_j}` of the box `Λ_R`, `R ≥ 1`, indexed by `(j, sign)`.

articles.title: Free unit-edge marginal in the square-root box
articles.statement:
The free marginal at `p = logistic t` of the unit edge `(j, sign)` in `Λ_{⌊√n⌋}`, and `0`
when `⌊√n⌋ = 0`.

articles.title: Wired unit-edge marginal in the square-root box
articles.statement:
The wired marginal at `p = logistic t` of the unit edge `(j, sign)` in `Λ_{⌊√n⌋}`, and `0`
when `⌊√n⌋ = 0`.

articles.title: Wired bulk edges of $\Lambda_n$
articles.statement: The wired bulk edges of `Λ_n`: the edges of the inner box `Λ_{n - ⌊√n⌋ - 1}`.

articles.title: Upper bound on wired bulk edge marginals
articles.statement: Every wired bulk edge of `Λ_n` has wired marginal at most `density(e') + ocs_wiredDelta`.

articles.title: Total deviation of wired unit-edge marginals from the density
articles.statement:
The total deviation of the wired unit-edge marginals in `Λ_{⌊√n⌋}` from the wired density of
`e'`.

articles.title: Wired off-centre sandwich from wired rotation residues
articles.statement:
The wired off-centre sandwich from the wired rotation residues for all pairs `e'` of
`Λ_N`.

articles.title: Wired off-centre upper bound by the recentred small-box marginal
articles.statement:
For `u, v` adjacent in `Λ_{n-R-1}` and `R ≥ 1`, the wired marginal in `Λ_n` of `{u, v}` is at
most the wired marginal in `Λ_R` of the recentered edge `{0, v - u}`.

articles.title: Wired rotation residue for a box pair
articles.statement:
The wired rotation residue at tilt `t` for the box pair `e'`: every lattice edge of every box
has the wired `q = 2` density of `e'` at `p = logistic t`.

articles.title: Parametric agreement on increasing events off a countable set
articles.statement:
Parametric agreement: if for each `p` there is a monotone coupling of `μ p` and `ν p`, and edge
marginals agree at every continuity point of the monotone map `p ↦ ν_p(ω(e) = 1)`, then `μ p` and `ν
p` agree on increasing events for all `p` outside a countable set.

articles.title: Adjacent sites differ by a signed unit vector
articles.statement:
The difference of adjacent sites is a signed unit vector. See also `ocs_edge_dir_candMap`,
the same statement for vertices of a box.

articles.title: Unit edges at the origin have the free density of $\{0, e_0\}$
articles.statement: Every unit edge `{0, ±e_j}` has the free density of `{0, e_0}`.

articles.title: Box symmetries preserve the free $q = 2$ density of any pair of sites
articles.statement: Box symmetries preserve the free `q = 2` density of any edge of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Every lattice edge has the free $q = 2$ density of $\{0, e_0\}$
articles.statement: Every nearest-neighbour edge of `ℤ^d` has the free `q = 2` density of `{0, e_0}`.

articles.title: All box edges have the same free $q = 2$ density
articles.statement: The free rotation residue holds for every lattice edge `e'` of the box `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Coordinate permutation as a box symmetry
articles.statement: A coordinate permutation as a box symmetry.

articles.title: Coordinate permutation of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: The permutation of `ℤ^d` permuting coordinates by `π`: `(x ∘ π⁻¹)_i = x_{π⁻¹ i}`.

articles.title: Reference edge $\{0, e_0\}$ of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: The reference edge `{0, e_0}` of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Unit edges at the origin have the wired density of $\{0, e_0\}$
articles.statement: Every unit edge `{0, ±e_j}` has the wired density of `{0, e_0}`.

articles.title: Box symmetries preserve the wired $q = 2$ density of any pair of sites
articles.statement: Box symmetries preserve the wired `q = 2` density of any edge of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Every lattice edge has the wired $q = 2$ density of $\{0, e_0\}$
articles.statement: Every nearest-neighbour edge of `ℤ^d` has the wired `q = 2` density of `{0, e_0}`.

articles.title: All box edges have the same wired $q = 2$ density
articles.statement: The wired rotation residue holds for every lattice edge `e'` of the box `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Average wired $q = 2$ edge density of a box as a mean of marginals
articles.statement: The average wired edge density of `Λ_n` is the mean of the wired edge marginals.

articles.title: Wired FK edge marginals are at most one
articles.statement: Edge marginals of a wired FK measure are at most `1`.

articles.title: Nonnegativity of wired FK edge marginals
articles.statement: Edge marginals of a wired FK measure are nonnegative.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ edge density lies in $(0, 1)$
articles.statement: The free infinite-volume `q = 2` edge density lies in `[0, 1]`.

articles.title: Free growing-box collapse at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
Free growing-box collapse: for every edge `e'` of `Λ_N` and every `t`, the average free edge
density of `Λ_n` converges to the free infinite-volume density of `e'`.

articles.title: Free uniform bulk deviation at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
Free uniform bulk deviation: for every edge `e'` and `t`, each box `Λ_n` has a bulk edge set
with free marginals within `δ_n → 0` of the free density of `e'`, and the non-bulk edge
fraction tends to zero.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ edge density lies in $(0, 1)$
articles.statement: The wired infinite-volume `q = 2` edge density lies in `[0, 1]`.

articles.title: Wired uniform bulk deviation at $q = 2$
articles.statement:
Wired uniform bulk deviation: for every edge `e'` and `t`, each box `Λ_n` has a bulk edge set
with wired marginals within `δ_n → 0` of the wired density of `e'`, and the non-bulk edge
fraction tends to zero.

articles.title: Wired infinite-volume edge density
articles.statement:
The edge density `φ^1_{p,q}(e open)` of the wired infinite-volume random-cluster measure on
`ℤ^d`, set to `0` outside `p ∈ (0, 1)`, `q > 0`.

articles.title: Agreement of configurations off an edge set
articles.statement: `ω` agrees with `ψ` on every edge outside `F`.

articles.title: Edge parameters $p_e(\beta) = 1 - e^{-\beta J_e}$
articles.statement: The edge parameters `p_e(β) = 1 - exp (-β J_e)`.

articles.title: Logarithmic $\beta$-derivative of the random-cluster weight
articles.statement:
The logarithmic `β`-derivative of the random-cluster weight under `betaParams`:
`∑_{e ∈ E(G)} (J_e / p_e) (𝟙[e open] - p_e)`.

articles.title: Box symmetry of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement:
A symmetry of `ℤ^d` that preserves nearest-neighbour adjacency and every centered box
`Λ_n = [-n, n]^d`, such as a coordinate reflection or a coordinate permutation.

articles.title: Finite-energy constant of the random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The finite-energy constant `min (p / (p + q (1 - p))) (1 - p)`.

articles.title: Number of closed edges
articles.statement: The number `c(ω)` of closed edges of `G` in `ω`.

articles.title: Fibre of configurations agreeing off an edge set
articles.statement: The fibre of configurations agreeing with `ψ` off `F`.

articles.title: Domain Markov property (finite volume)
articles.statement:
Conditioned on the states of the edges outside `F`,
the random-cluster measure is the FK weight renormalized on the fibre
(Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, 2006, Lemma 4.13).

articles.title: Random-cluster measure conditioned on the edges off a set
articles.statement: The random-cluster measure conditioned on agreeing with `ψ` off `F`.

articles.title: Conditional probability that an edge is open given the rest
articles.statement:
The conditional probability under `φ_{G,p,q}` that `e` is open given the states of all
other edges: `φ(setOpen e ω) / (φ(setOpen e ω) + φ(setClosed e ω))`.

articles.title: Event that two vertices are joined by open edges
articles.statement: The event that `x` and `y` are joined by a path of open edges of `G`.

articles.title: Real-valued indicator that an edge is open
articles.statement: The real-valued state `𝟙[e open]` of the edge `e`.

articles.title: Event depending only on edges outside a set
articles.statement: Membership in `B` depends only on the states of edges outside `F`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous Bernoulli edge product
articles.statement: The inhomogeneous Bernoulli product `∏_{e ∈ E(G)} (pf e if e open, 1 - pf e if closed)`.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous Bernoulli product over all edges but one
articles.statement: The inhomogeneous Bernoulli product over the edges of `G` other than `e₀`.

articles.title: Bernoulli edge product
articles.statement: The Bernoulli edge product `∏_{e ∈ E(G)} (p if e open, 1 - p if e closed)`.

articles.title: Bernoulli product over the edges other than one edge
articles.statement: The Bernoulli product over the edges of `G` other than `e`.

articles.title: Fibre representatives with every edge of a set closed
articles.statement: Representatives of the fibres of `F`: configurations with every edge of `F` closed.

articles.title: Finite-energy property
articles.statement:
**Finite-energy property** of the random-cluster measure. For `p ∈ (0, 1)` and `q ≥ 1`, the
conditional probability that an edge is open given all other edges lies in
`[cFE p q, 1 - cFE p q]`. For edges of `G` the sharper bounds `p / (p + q (1 - p))` and `p` are
proved along the way. See G. Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model* (2006), Chapter 3.

articles.title: Covariance under the inhomogeneous random-cluster measure
articles.statement:
The covariance `E[f g] - E[f] E[g]` under the inhomogeneous random-cluster measure
(a finite form of Mathlib's `ProbabilityTheory.covariance`).

articles.title: Random-cluster expectation of an observable
articles.statement: The expectation `φ_{G,p,q}[X] = ∑_ω φ_{G,p,q}(ω) X(ω)` of an observable `X`.

articles.title: Expectation under the inhomogeneous random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The expectation of `g` under the inhomogeneous random-cluster measure.

articles.title: Unnormalized inhomogeneous random-cluster expectation
articles.statement: The unnormalized expectation `∑_ω g(ω) fkWeightW G pf q ω`.

articles.title: Ambient random-cluster law as a probability mass function
articles.statement:
The ambient extension of the random-cluster edge law as a `PMF` on all `Sym2 V`
configurations, with independent uniform bits on loops and nonedges.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous random-cluster probability
articles.statement: The inhomogeneous random-cluster probability `fkWeightW / fkZW`.

articles.title: Probability of an event under the inhomogeneous random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The probability of the event `A` under the inhomogeneous random-cluster measure.

articles.title: Probability of an ambient FK configuration
articles.statement:
The probability of an ambient configuration: `fkWeight G p q ω / fkZ G p q`.
For `0 < p < 1` and `q > 0`, its graph-edge marginal is the random-cluster law and
unused coordinates are uniform.

articles.title: Graph automorphisms preserve free FK edge marginals
articles.statement: Under the free FK measure, the edges `e` and `σ e` are open with the same probability.

articles.title: Boundary-preserving automorphisms preserve wired FK edge marginals
articles.statement: Under the wired FK measure, the edges `e` and `σ e` are open with the same probability.

articles.title: Graph automorphisms preserve the free FK probability
articles.statement:
Graph automorphisms preserve the free FK probability. See also `fvs_fkProb_reCfgIso` for
isomorphisms between two graphs.

articles.title: Box symmetries preserve the free $q = 2$ density of box edges
articles.statement:
Box symmetries preserve the free `q = 2` infinite-volume edge density. See also
`rot_free_density_boxSym` for the statement on edges of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Automorphism as an isomorphism of open subgraphs
articles.statement:
An automorphism `σ` of `G` is a graph isomorphism from the open subgraph of the relabelled
configuration `reCfg σ ω` to the open subgraph of `ω`.

articles.title: Reflection of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ in one coordinate
articles.statement: The reflection `x ↦ x` with the `j`-th coordinate negated.

articles.title: Coordinate reflection as a box symmetry
articles.statement: The reflection in the `j`-th coordinate as a box symmetry.

articles.title: Box symmetries preserve the wired $q = 2$ density of box edges
articles.statement:
Box symmetries preserve the wired `q = 2` infinite-volume edge density. See also
`rot_wired_density_boxSym` for the statement on edges of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Boundary-preserving automorphisms preserve the wired FK probability
articles.statement: Graph automorphisms preserving the boundary preserve the wired FK probability.

articles.title: Boundary-preserving automorphism as an isomorphism of wired graphs
articles.statement:
An automorphism `σ` of `G` preserving the boundary set is a graph isomorphism between the
wired graphs (open edges plus all boundary pairs) of `reCfg σ ω` and `ω`.

articles.title: At $q = 1$ the random-cluster weight is the Bernoulli product
articles.statement: At `q = 1` the random-cluster weight is the Bernoulli product weight.

articles.title: Inhomogeneous random-cluster weight
articles.statement: The inhomogeneous random-cluster weight `edgeProductW G pf ω · q ^ k(ω)`.

articles.title: Unnormalized random-cluster weight
articles.statement: The unnormalized random-cluster weight `p ^ o(ω) (1 - p) ^ c(ω) q ^ k(ω)`.

articles.title: Ambient FK normalizer
articles.statement:
The ambient FK normalizer, summing over every bit assignment on `Sym2 V`.
Each loop or nonedge contributes a factor of two relative to the edge partition function
`ecz_fkZEdge` defined in `EdgePartitionFunction`.

articles.title: Partition function of the inhomogeneous random-cluster measure
articles.statement: The partition function of the inhomogeneous random-cluster measure.

articles.title: Translation covariance of FK edge marginals on boxes
articles.statement:
The wired and free FK edge marginals on the translated box `v + Λ_m` are the marginals on the
centered box `Λ_m`, transported by `x ↦ x + v`.

articles.title: Boundary-matching isomorphisms transport FK edge marginals
articles.statement:
Graph isomorphisms transport the wired and the free FK edge marginals: `σ e` is open in `H`
with the same probability as `e` in `G`.

articles.title: Isomorphic graphs have equal free FK probabilities after relabelling
articles.statement:
Isomorphic graphs have the same free FK probability, up to relabelling by the isomorphism.
See also `fkTI_fkProb_reCfg`, the special case of an automorphism.

articles.title: Open-subgraph isomorphism for a pulled-back configuration
articles.statement:
An isomorphism `σ : G ≃ H` is a graph isomorphism from the open subgraph of the pulled-back
configuration `reCfgIso σ ω` to the open subgraph of `ω`.

articles.title: Pull-back along a permutation is relabelling
articles.statement: For a permutation `σ` of `V`, pulling back along `σ` is the relabelling `reCfg σ`.

articles.title: Vertex boundary of a translated box
articles.statement: The vertex boundary of `v + Λ_m`: the translate of the vertex boundary of `Λ_m`.

articles.title: Nearest-neighbour graph on a translated box
articles.statement: The nearest-neighbour graph of `ℤ^d` restricted to `v + Λ_m`.

articles.title: Some translated box leaves the centered box for $d \ge 1$
articles.statement:
For `d ≥ 1`, some translated box `v + Λ_m` is not contained in `Λ_m`, so translation is not a
box symmetry in the sense of `BoxSym`.

articles.title: Vertex type of a translated box
articles.statement: The vertices of the translated box `v + Λ_m`, as a subtype of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Translated box in $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: The translated box `v + Λ_m = {y ∈ ℤ^d : ‖y - v‖_∞ ≤ m}`.

articles.title: Translation from the centered box onto a translated box
articles.statement: The translation `x ↦ x + v` from the centered box `Λ_m` onto `v + Λ_m`.

articles.title: Boundary-matching isomorphisms preserve wired FK probabilities
articles.statement:
Isomorphic graphs with matching boundary sets have the same wired FK probability, up to
relabelling. See also `fkTI_wiredFkProb_reCfg`.

articles.title: Wired-graph isomorphism for a pulled-back configuration
articles.statement:
An isomorphism `σ : G ≃ H` matching the boundary sets is a graph isomorphism between the
wired graphs of `reCfgIso σ ω` and `ω`.

articles.title: Differential formula in `β`
articles.statement:
**Differential formula in `β`** for the random-cluster measure with edge parameters
`1 - exp (-β J_e)`: `d/dβ φ_β[g] = ∑_e (J_e / p_e) Cov(g, 𝟙[e open])`. See G. Grimmett,
*The Random-Cluster Model* (2006), Chapter 3.

articles.title: Differential formula
articles.statement:
**Differential formula** for the random-cluster measure: the derivative of `φ[g]` in the
parameter of the edge `e₀` is `Cov(g, 𝟙[e₀ open]) / (p (1 - p))` with `p = pf e₀`. See
G. Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model* (2006), Chapter 3.

articles.title: Derivative in $\beta$ of the edge parameter $1 - e^{-\beta J}$
articles.statement: The derivative of the edge parameter `p(β) = 1 - exp (-β J)` is `J exp (-β J)`.

articles.title: FK measure induced on a fibre
articles.statement:
The FK measure induced on the fibre `condFibre F ψ`: FK weight divided by the fibre's total
weight.

articles.title: Total FK weight of a fibre
articles.statement: The total FK weight of the fibre `condFibre F ψ`.

articles.title: Restriction of a box symmetry to a box
articles.statement: The restriction of a box symmetry to a permutation of the vertices of the box `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Opening an edge lowers the cluster count by at most one
articles.statement: Opening an edge lowers the number of clusters by at most one.

articles.title: Opening an edge does not increase the cluster count
articles.statement:
Opening an edge does not increase the number of clusters. This is a special case of
Mathlib's `SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.card_le_card_of_le`, which proves it.

articles.title: Number of open clusters
articles.statement:
The number `k(ω)` of open clusters: connected components of the open subgraph, isolated
vertices included.

articles.title: Number of open edges
articles.statement: The number `o(ω)` of open edges of `G` in `ω`.

articles.title: Open subgraph as the meet of $G$ with the open-edge graph
articles.statement: The open subgraph is `G ⊓ fromEdgeSet {e | ω e = true}` in Mathlib's terms.

articles.title: Monotonicity of the open subgraph in the configuration
articles.statement:
The open subgraph is monotone in the configuration. The same statement is
`StatMech.Sharpness.openSub_mono` in `BkCriterion`.

articles.title: Toggling a non-edge leaves the open subgraph unchanged
articles.statement: Off the edges of `G`, flipping `e` does not change the open subgraph.

articles.title: Open subgraph of an edge configuration
articles.statement:
The open subgraph of `G` under the edge configuration `ω`: the edges of `G` that `ω`
declares open.

articles.title: Closing the edges of a set in a configuration
articles.statement: The configuration that closes every edge of `F` and agrees with `ψ` elsewhere.

articles.title: Relabelling as a permutation of the configuration space
articles.statement:
Relabelling by `σ` as a permutation of the configuration space, with inverse relabelling
by `σ⁻¹`.

articles.title: Pull-back of configurations as an equivalence
articles.statement:
Pull-back along `σ` as an equivalence of configuration spaces, with inverse the pull-back
along `σ⁻¹`.

articles.title: Pull-back of an edge configuration along a vertex bijection
articles.statement:
The pull-back of a configuration `ω` on the edges of `W` along `σ : V ≃ W`: the edge `e` is
open in `reCfgIso σ ω` iff `σ e` is open in `ω`. For `V = W` it is `reCfg`
(`fvs_reCfgIso_eq_reCfg`).

articles.title: Relabelling of an edge configuration by a vertex permutation
articles.statement:
The configuration `ω ∘ σ` on edges: the edge `e` is open in `reCfg σ ω` iff `σ e` is open in
`ω`. See also `reCfgIso`, the same relabelling along an equivalence `V ≃ W`.

articles.title: Tilt factor between two edge parameters
articles.statement:
The tilt factor `λ = p₂ (1 - p₁) / ((1 - p₂) p₁)`, the ratio of the odds of an open edge
at `p₂` and at `p₁`.

articles.title: FKG inequality for connection events for $q \ge 1$
articles.statement: FKG for connection events: for `q ≥ 1`, `φ(x ↔ y) φ(u ↔ v) ≤ φ(x ↔ y, u ↔ v)`.

articles.title: Two-point function of the free random-cluster measure
articles.statement:
The two-point function of the free random-cluster measure on a finite graph: the probability
`φ(x ↔ y)` that `x` and `y` are connected by open edges.

articles.title: Almost-invariant events are trivial under an ergodic measure
articles.statement:
Under an ergodic measure, a measurable set invariant up to null sets has measure `0` or `1`.
See also Mathlib's `aeconst_of_forall_preimage_smul_ae_eq` for `ErgodicSMul`.

articles.title: Translation invariance of the free $q = 2$ infinite-volume measure
articles.statement: The free `q = 2` infinite-volume random-cluster measure on `ℤ^d` is translation invariant.

articles.title: Free off-centre sandwich hypothesis
articles.statement:
For every edge `e'` of `Λ_N` and every `t`, there are interior edge sets `I_n` of `Λ_n`
carrying
asymptotically all edges on which the free density equals that of `e'` and the free box
marginals
are at least that density minus `δ_n → 0`.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ box edge marginals are at most the free density
articles.statement:
Edge marginals of the free box measure are at most the free infinite-volume density (the case
`N = n` of `dfi_free_per_edge_le`).

articles.title: Empty boundary predicate
articles.statement: The empty boundary predicate.

articles.title: Wired off-centre sandwich hypothesis
articles.statement:
For every edge `e'` of `Λ_N` and every `t`, there are interior edge sets `I_n` of `Λ_n`
carrying
asymptotically all edges on which the wired density equals that of `e'` and the wired box
marginals
are at most that density plus `δ_n → 0`.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ box edge marginals are at least the wired density
articles.statement:
Edge marginals of the wired box measure are at least the wired infinite-volume density (the
case
`N = n` of `dfi_wired_per_edge_ge`).

articles.title: Translate of a vertex of $\Lambda_N$ as a vertex of $\Lambda_{N+r}$
articles.statement: The vertex of `Λ_{N+r}` obtained by translating a vertex of `Λ_N` by `v` with `‖v‖_∞ ≤ r`.

articles.title: Translate of an edge of $\Lambda_N$ as an edge of $\Lambda_{N+r}$
articles.statement: The edge of `Λ_{N+r}` obtained by translating an edge of `Λ_N` by `v` with `‖v‖_∞ ≤ r`.

articles.title: Shift vector moving $\Lambda_N$ to a disjoint box
articles.statement: The vector `(2N + 1) e_{i₀}`, which translates `Λ_N` to a disjoint box.

articles.title: Ergodicity of the wired random-cluster measure
articles.statement:
For `d ≥ 1` and `p ∈ (0, 1)`, the wired `q = 2`
infinite-volume random-cluster measure on `ℤ^d` is ergodic under translations
(Grimmett, *The Random-Cluster Model*, 2006, Theorem 4.19).

articles.title: Event that every edge of a set of box edges is open, on a box
articles.statement: The event that every edge of `t ⊆ E(Λ_N)` is open, on configurations of `Λ_N`.

articles.title: Submodule of functions with vanishing free shift decay
articles.statement:
The continuous functions whose shift-decay functional along the free box measures (on the
subsequence `φ`) tends to `0`, as a submodule.

articles.title: Free $q = 2$ multi-edge homogeneity under a translation
articles.statement:
The free `q = 2` infinite-volume measure gives every multi-open event the same mass as its
translate by `g⁻¹`.

articles.title: Monomial indicator as a bounded continuous function
articles.statement: `cdc_monomialCM s` as a bounded continuous function.

articles.title: Continuous monomial indicator that every edge of a set is open
articles.statement: The continuous function `ω ↦ ∏_{e ∈ s} ω(e)`, the indicator of `cdc_multiOpenEvent s`.

articles.title: Event that every edge of a finite set is open
articles.statement:
The event that every edge of `s` is open. Equal to `fmu_multiOpen` (see
`ftb_fmu_eq_cdc_multiOpen`).

articles.title: Submodule of functions with vanishing wired shift decay
articles.statement:
The continuous functions whose shift-decay functional along the wired box measures (on the
subsequence `φ`) tends to `0`, as a submodule.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ multi-edge homogeneity under a translation
articles.statement:
The wired `q = 2` infinite-volume measure gives every multi-open event the same mass as its
translate by `g⁻¹`.

articles.title: Disjoint-box cap hypothesis for multi-open events
articles.statement:
For every finite family of finite edge sets and scale `N`, some translation `g` and margin `r`
realize each pair `T`, `g⁻¹T'` in `Λ_{N+r}` with `g⁻¹T'` outside a set `F`, such that the
conditional masses of `O_T` on fibres of `F` (with a boundary graph containing the wired one)
are at
most `μ_N(O_T)` and the box mass of `g⁻¹O_{T'}` is at most `μ_N(O_{T'})`.

articles.title: Translated free box measure
articles.statement: The free finite-volume random-cluster measure on `Λ_n` translated by `g`.

articles.title: Translated wired box measure
articles.statement: The wired finite-volume random-cluster measure on `Λ_n` translated by `g`.

articles.title: Conditional product cap for multi-open events in boxes
articles.statement:
For every finite family of finite edge sets and box index `N`, some translation `g` satisfies,
for
all large `m`: each `O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}` is `A ∩ B` on `Λ_m` with `A` increasing and `B` depending
only
on edges outside some `F`, the conditional masses of `A` on the fibres of `F` (with a boundary
graph
containing the wired one) are at most `μ_N(O_T)`, and the mass of `B` is at most `μ_N(O_{T'})`.

articles.title: Extreme invariant measures are ergodic
articles.statement: An extreme point of the translation-invariant probability measures is ergodic.

articles.title: Unordered pair of two sites of a box $\Lambda_N$
articles.statement: The pair `{x, y}` as an element of `Sym2 Λ_N`, for sites `x, y ∈ Λ_N`.

articles.title: Translation invariance of free and wired densities if marginals merge
articles.statement:
Translation invariance of the free and wired densities of an edge under the merging
hypotheses of `fktc_wired_density_translation_inv` and `fktc_free_density_translation_inv`.

articles.title: An edge and its translate lie in a common centered box
articles.statement: The endpoints of an edge and of its translate lie in a common centered box.

articles.title: Free edge density is constant on orbits of a box symmetry
articles.statement: The free edge density is constant on each orbit of a box symmetry.

articles.title: Free upper bound on expected open edges along a box-symmetry orbit
articles.statement: `fktc_free_density_eq_const` for a set of edges contained in one orbit of a box symmetry.

articles.title: Constant free density gives an upper bound on expected open edges
articles.statement:
If the free density is constant on a set `EB` of box edges, the expected number of open edges
of `EB` under the free measure on any larger box is at most `|EB|` times that density.

articles.title: Equal free densities from merging free marginals
articles.statement:
If the free marginals of two box edges on `Λ_{N+k}` differ by a quantity tending to zero, the
two edges have the same free density.

articles.title: Translation invariance of the free density given merging marginals
articles.statement:
An edge and its translate have the same free density if their free marginals merge along the
boxes. See also `bdp_freeEdgeDensity_translation_inv`, which proves the conclusion without the
merging hypothesis.

articles.title: A site and its translate lie in a common centered box
articles.statement: A site and its translate lie in a common centered box.

articles.title: Unit translations are not box symmetries
articles.statement: Translation by a unit vector does not preserve the centered boxes, so it is not a `BoxSym`.

articles.title: Translation of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ by a vector
articles.statement: Translation `x ↦ x + v` as a permutation of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Wired edge density is constant on orbits of a box symmetry
articles.statement: The wired edge density is constant on each orbit of a box symmetry.

articles.title: Wired lower bound on expected open edges along a box-symmetry orbit
articles.statement: `fktc_wired_density_eq_const` for a set of edges contained in one orbit of a box symmetry.

articles.title: Constant wired density gives a lower bound on expected open edges
articles.statement:
If the wired density is constant on a set `EB` of box edges, `|EB|` times that density is at
most the expected number of open edges of `EB` under the wired measure on any larger box.

articles.title: Equal wired densities from merging wired marginals
articles.statement:
If the wired marginals of two box edges on `Λ_{N+k}` differ by a quantity tending to zero,
the two edges have the same wired density.

articles.title: Translation invariance of the wired density given merging marginals
articles.statement:
An edge and its translate have the same wired density if their wired marginals merge along
the boxes. See also `bdp_wiredEdgeDensity_translation_inv`, which proves the conclusion without
the merging hypothesis.

articles.title: Inclusion of a subset of sites into a larger one
articles.statement: The inclusion of a subset of sites into a larger one, as a map of subtypes.

articles.title: Box edge set included into $\Lambda_m$ and translated by $v$
articles.statement: The edge set `t` of `Λ_N`, included into `Λ_m` and translated by `v`.

articles.title: Sup norm of a site of $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: The sup-norm `max_i |v_i|` of a site `v`.

articles.title: Translation invariance of the wired $q = 2$ infinite-volume measure
articles.statement: The wired `q = 2` infinite-volume random-cluster measure on `ℤ^d` is translation invariant.

articles.title: Cylinder approximation of events under a finite measure
articles.statement:
Every measurable event is approximated by a cylinder event in symmetric difference; the general
form of `exists_cylinder_symmDiff_lt` (`Ergodicity`).

articles.title: Translation-invariant self-mixing measures are ergodic
articles.statement: A translation-invariant self-mixing probability measure is ergodic.

articles.title: Self-mixing on cylinder events
articles.statement:
For every cylinder event `A` and `ε > 0` there is a translation `g` with
`|μ(A ∩ g⁻¹A) - μ(A)²| < ε`.

articles.title: Mixing for finite families of cylinder events
articles.statement: The analogue of `fmu_PairMixing` for finite families of cylinder events.

articles.title: Product indicator of a multi-open event
articles.statement: The indicator of `O_T` as the product `∏_{e ∈ T} ω(e)`.

articles.title: Event that every coordinate of a finite set is open
articles.statement:
The event `O_T` that every coordinate in `T` is open. See also `cdc_multiOpenEvent` and
`med_genericMultiOpenEvent`.

articles.title: Pair mixing of multi-open events
articles.statement:
For every finite family of finite sets `T` and `δ > 0` there is one translation `g` with
`|μ(O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}) - μ(O_T) μ(O_{T'})| < δ` for all `T, T'` in the family.

articles.title: Inclusion–exclusion coefficient of a multi-open event
articles.statement:
The inclusion–exclusion coefficient of `O_T` in the expansion of the trace indicator of `τ` on
`F`.

articles.title: Indicator of agreeing with a pattern on a finite set
articles.statement: The indicator that `ω` agrees with `τ` on `F`.

articles.title: Upper decay of correlations of multi-open events
articles.statement: The one-sided form of `fmu_PairMixing`: `μ(O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}) ≤ μ(O_T) μ(O_{T'}) + δ`.

articles.title: Coordinate state as a real number
articles.statement: The state of coordinate `e` as a real number in `{0, 1}`.

articles.title: Far-box product domination of multi-open events
articles.statement:
For every finite family of finite edge sets, box index `m`, and `δ > 0`, some translation `g`
satisfies `μ(O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}) ≤ μ_m(O_T) μ_m(O_{T'}) + δ` for all `T, T'` in the family.

articles.title: Finite-box disjoint product domination of multi-open events
articles.statement:
For every finite family of finite edge sets and box index `N`, some translation `g` satisfies,
for
all large `m`, `μ_m(O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}) ≤ μ_N(O_T) μ_N(O_{T'})` for all `T, T'` in the family.

articles.title: Wired box products approximate infinite-volume products
articles.statement:
For `q = 2`, products of wired box probabilities of open-edge events approximate the wired
infinite-volume products within `δ`, for some box `Λ_m` with `m ≥ N₀`.

articles.title: Every finite family of edge sets is realized in some box
articles.statement: Every finite family of finite edge sets is realized in some box.

articles.title: Finite-box product domination from the factorization bound
articles.statement:
Under the factorization bound for the wired measures, for some translation `g` and all large
`m`, `φ¹_{Λ_m}(T open, g·T' open) ≤ φ¹_{Λ_N}(T open) φ¹_{Λ_N}(T' open)` for all `T, T' ∈ P`.

articles.title: Realized edge sets stay realized in larger boxes
articles.statement: An edge set realized in `Λ_(N₀)` is realized in every larger box.

articles.title: Upper decorrelation of the wired measure from factorization
articles.statement:
The factorization bound for the wired `q = 2` box measures gives upper decorrelation of the
wired infinite-volume measure.

articles.title: Domain monotonicity of wired $q = 2$ box measures
articles.statement:
For `q = 2` and `N ≤ m`, the wired `Λ_m` measure of an increasing `Λ_N` cylinder event is at
most its wired `Λ_N` measure.

articles.title: Domain monotonicity for translated pairs of multi-open events
articles.statement: The same for the event "`T` open and `g·T'` open", when `T ∪ g⁻¹·T'` lies in `Λ_N`.

articles.title: All-open Dirac mass satisfies the factorization bound
articles.statement:
The factorization bound is satisfiable: the Dirac mass on the all-open configuration satisfies
it.

articles.title: Disjoint-box factorization bound for box measures
articles.statement:
The disjoint-box factorization bound for a family of box measures `μbox`: for every finite
family `P` of edge sets realized in `Λ_N` there are a translation `g` and `r` such that each
`T ∪ g⁻¹·T'` lies in `Λ_(N+r)` and `μbox (N+r) (T open, g·T' open) ≤ μbox N (T open) ·
μbox N (T' open)`. The parameters `p` only index the family.

articles.title: Domain monotonicity for edge sets realized in a box
articles.statement: The same for an edge set of `ℤ^d` given as the image of `Λ_N` edges.

articles.title: Wired $q = 2$ measure is ergodic under the factorization bound
articles.statement: If the wired `q = 2` box measures satisfy the factorization bound, the wired infinite-volume measure is ergodic under translations of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Domain monotonicity of wired multi-open probabilities
articles.statement:
For `q = 2` and `N ≤ m`, the wired `Λ_m` probability that a set of `Λ_N` edges is open is at
most its wired `Λ_N` probability.

articles.title: Edge-open indicator as a bounded continuous function
articles.statement: The edge indicator `ω ↦ 1{ω_e = 1}` as a bounded continuous function.

articles.title: Edge-open indicator as a continuous function
articles.statement: The indicator `ω ↦ 1{ω_e = 1}` of the edge `e` being open, as a continuous function.

articles.title: Cylinder algebra generated by edge indicators
articles.statement: The subalgebra of continuous functions generated by the edge indicators.

articles.title: Density of cylinder functions among bounded continuous functions
articles.statement:
The cylinder functions are dense in the bounded continuous functions, by Stone–Weierstrass
on the compact configuration space.

articles.title: Cylinder algebra as bounded continuous functions
articles.statement: The cylinder algebra viewed as a set of bounded continuous functions.

articles.title: Cylinder decay along the free box measures
articles.statement:
The decay functional tends to zero along the free box measures for every cylinder
function.

articles.title: Translation invariance of the free FK measure from cylinder decay
articles.statement:
The free infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if cylinder decay holds for
every shift and every convergent box subsequence. See also `bdp_freeIV_isTranslationInvariant`
(unconditional for `q = 2`).

articles.title: Free box integral of an edge indicator is the free edge marginal
articles.statement:
The integral of the indicator of a box edge against the free box measure on `Λ_m` is the
free edge marginal.

articles.title: Wired box integral of an edge indicator is the wired edge marginal
articles.statement:
The integral of the indicator of a box edge against the wired box measure on `Λ_m` is the
wired edge marginal.

articles.title: Decay of the edge-indicator functional from equal wired densities
articles.statement:
If the box edge `e` and its shift `g⁻¹ e` have the same wired `q = 2` density, the decay
functional of the indicator of `e` along the wired box measures tends to zero.

articles.title: Cylinder decay along the wired box measures
articles.statement:
The decay functional tends to zero along the wired box measures for every cylinder
function.

articles.title: Translation invariance of the wired FK measure from cylinder decay
articles.statement:
The wired infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if cylinder decay holds for
every shift and every convergent box subsequence. See also `flc_wiredIV_isTranslationInvariant`
(unconditional for `q = 2`).

articles.title: Extreme point of the invariant probability measures
articles.statement:
`μ` is a translation-invariant probability measure that is not a nontrivial convex combination
of
two distinct translation-invariant probability measures.

articles.title: Shift-decay functional of a sequence of measures
articles.statement:
The difference `∫ f dμ_n - ∫ f ∘ θ_g dμ_n` between the integrals of `f` and of its shift by
`g` against the `n`-th measure.

articles.title: Free shift decay on a dense set of test functions
articles.statement:
Decay of `D_n` along the free box measures `φ^0_{Λ_{φ(n)}}` on some dense set of bounded
continuous functions.

articles.title: Free translation invariance from decay on a dense set
articles.statement:
The free infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if, for every shift and every
convergent box subsequence, `D_n` decays on a dense set. See also
`bdp_freeIV_isTranslationInvariant` (unconditional for `q = 2`).

articles.title: Shift decay extends from a dense set of test functions
articles.statement:
If `D_n(f') → 0` for all `f'` in a dense set of bounded continuous functions, then
`D_n(f) → 0` for every bounded continuous `f`. This is the equicontinuity argument of
`EquicontinuousAt.tendsto_of_mem_closure`, specialized to the uniformly Lipschitz family
`f ↦ D_n(f)`.

articles.title: Wired shift decay on a dense set of test functions
articles.statement:
Decay of `D_n` along the wired box measures `φ^1_{Λ_{φ(n)}}` on some dense set of bounded
continuous functions.

articles.title: Wired translation invariance from decay on a dense set
articles.statement:
The wired infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if, for every shift and every
convergent box subsequence, `D_n` decays on a dense set. See also
`flc_wiredIV_isTranslationInvariant` (unconditional for `q = 2`).

articles.title: Identity shift satisfies the free decay hypothesis
articles.statement: The identity shift satisfies the free decay hypothesis, so it is not vacuous.

articles.title: Free integral shift decay along a box sequence
articles.statement:
Along the box sequence `φ`, the free box integrals of `f` and of `f ∘ θ_g` differ by a
quantity tending to zero, for every bounded continuous `f`.

articles.title: Free translation invariance from integral shift decay
articles.statement:
The free infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if the integral decay hypothesis
holds for every shift and every convergent box subsequence. See also
`bdp_freeIV_isTranslationInvariant`, which proves invariance for `q = 2` without hypotheses.

articles.title: Identity shift satisfies the wired decay hypothesis
articles.statement: The identity shift satisfies the wired decay hypothesis, so it is not vacuous.

articles.title: Wired integral shift decay along a box sequence
articles.statement:
Along the box sequence `φ`, the wired box integrals of `f` and of `f ∘ θ_g` differ by a
quantity tending to zero, for every bounded continuous `f`.

articles.title: Wired translation invariance from integral shift decay
articles.statement:
The wired infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if the integral decay
hypothesis holds for every shift and every convergent box subsequence. See also
`flc_wiredIV_isTranslationInvariant`, which proves invariance for `q = 2` without hypotheses.

articles.title: Free translation invariance from the placement hypothesis
articles.statement:
The free `q = 2` infinite-volume FK measure on `ℤ^d` is translation invariant if every shift
satisfies the free placement hypothesis.

articles.title: Equal free probabilities for $t$ and $v + t$ from matching box limits
articles.statement:
If the translated free box masses also converge to the free infinite-volume probability of the
shifted set `v + t`, the free infinite-volume measure gives `t` and `v + t` the same
probability.

articles.title: Free infinite-volume measure is homogeneous under the identity shift
articles.statement: The free infinite-volume measure is homogeneous under the identity shift.

articles.title: Free placement gives shift homogeneity on all-open events
articles.statement:
The free placement hypothesis for `g` gives `g`-homogeneity of the free infinite-volume
measure on all events "every edge of `s` is open".

articles.title: Identity shift satisfies the free placement hypothesis
articles.statement: The identity shift satisfies the free placement hypothesis.

articles.title: Free placement hypothesis for a shift via box-mass limits
articles.statement:
The placement hypothesis for the shift `g` and the free measure: every finite edge set lies in
a box whose translated free box masses converge to the free infinite-volume probability of the
set shifted by `g⁻¹`.

articles.title: Translated wired box mass equals the centered box mass
articles.statement:
The translated wired box mass equals the probability of the unshifted event under the wired
finite-volume measure on the centered box `Λ_m`.

articles.title: Translated free box mass equals the centred box probability
articles.statement:
The translated free box mass equals the probability of the unshifted event under the free
finite-volume measure on the centered box `Λ_m`.

articles.title: Translated free box masses converge to the free infinite-volume value
articles.statement:
The translated free box masses converge to the free infinite-volume probability that all edges
of `t` are open.

articles.title: Translated free box mass of an edge set
articles.statement:
The probability, under the free `q = 2` FK measure on the translated box `v + Λ_m`, that all
edges of the translated copy of `t ⊆ E(Λ_N)` are open.

articles.title: Translated wired box masses converge to the infinite-volume mass
articles.statement:
The translated wired box masses converge to the wired infinite-volume probability that all
edges of `t` are open.

articles.title: Wired all-open probability on a translated box
articles.statement:
The probability, under the wired `q = 2` FK measure on the translated box `v + Λ_m`, that all
edges of the translated copy of `t ⊆ E(Λ_N)` are open.

articles.title: Translated box edges are shifted centered box edges
articles.statement: Including a translated box edge equals shifting the included centered box edge by `v`.

articles.title: Edge inclusion of a translated box into $\mathbb{Z}^d$
articles.statement: The inclusion of edges of the translated box `v + Λ_m` into the edges of `ℤ^d`.

articles.title: Images of translated edge sets are shifted images
articles.statement:
The image of a translated edge set in `ℤ^d` is the shift by `v` of the image of the centered
set.

articles.title: Wired translation invariance from the placement hypothesis
articles.statement:
The wired `q = 2` infinite-volume FK measure on `ℤ^d` is translation invariant if every shift
satisfies the wired placement hypothesis.

articles.title: Wired shift invariance of an all-open event from matching limits
articles.statement:
If the translated wired box masses also converge to the wired infinite-volume probability of
the shifted set `v + t`, the wired infinite-volume measure gives `t` and `v + t` the same
probability.

articles.title: Wired shift invariance of an all-open event from decaying differences
articles.statement:
If the translated wired box masses differ from the centered box masses of a set `t'` with `v +
t = t'` by a sequence tending to zero, the wired infinite-volume measure gives `t` and `v + t`
the same probability.

articles.title: Wired infinite-volume measure is homogeneous under the identity shift
articles.statement: The wired infinite-volume measure is homogeneous under the identity shift.

articles.title: Wired placement gives shift homogeneity on all-open events
articles.statement:
The placement hypothesis for `g` gives `g`-homogeneity of the wired infinite-volume measure on
all events "every edge of `s` is open".

articles.title: Identity shift satisfies the wired placement hypothesis
articles.statement: The identity shift satisfies the wired placement hypothesis.

articles.title: Wired placement hypothesis for a shift
articles.statement:
The placement hypothesis for the shift `g`: every finite edge set lies in a box whose
translated wired box masses converge to the wired infinite-volume probability of the set
shifted by `g⁻¹`.

articles.title: Extension by zero of a current inside a set
articles.statement: Extension by zero of a current on the edges inside `S` to all edges of `G`.

articles.title: Extension by zero of a current outside a set
articles.statement: Extension by zero of a current on the edges not inside `S` to all edges of `G`.

articles.title: Outside part of a gated double-current summand
articles.statement:
The outside part of a double-current summand: weights of the two outside currents with sources
`B` and `D`, gated by `P`.

articles.title: Cluster lower bound for double-current sums
articles.statement:
The cluster lower bound: for `β, J ≥ 0`, `o, x ∉ S`, `y, g ∈ S`, `y ≠ g` and `⟨σ_yσ_g⟩ > 0`, the
double-current sum with sources `{y, g} ∆ {o, x}` and `∅` on the event that the vertices not
connected to `o` form `S` is at least `⟨σ_yσ_g⟩⁻¹` times the sum with sources `{o, x}` and `∅` on
the same event and `y ↔ g`. Reference: M. Aizenman, D. J. Barsky, R. Fernández, "The phase
transition in a general class of Ising-type models is sharp", J. Stat. Phys. 47 (1987) 343–374.

articles.title: Outside summand of a gated double-current sum
articles.statement:
The summand of the outside double-current sum: weights of the outside part and of the second
current, gated by `P` on their sum.

articles.title: Coupling restricted to the edges inside a set
articles.statement: The coupling `J` restricted to the edges inside `S` (zero on all other edges).

articles.title: Edges of a graph inside a set
articles.statement: The edges of `G` inside `S`.

articles.title: Inside weight with prescribed sources
articles.statement: The weight of the inside part of a current, restricted to source set `A`.

articles.title: Gated double-current sum over edge-indexed currents
articles.statement:
The gated double-current sum `∑_{∂n₁ = A, ∂n₂ = B} w(n₁) w(n₂) 1_{P(n₁ + n₂)}` over edge-indexed
currents.

articles.title: Vertex subsets as ghost-free subsets of the extended vertex set
articles.statement: Subsets of `V` correspond to subsets of `V ⊔ {ghost}` not containing the ghost.

articles.title: Bond term $\Delta_e$ of the magnetization derivative
articles.statement:
The bond term `Δ_e`: the ghost-graph double-current sum with sources `hcaBondSource o e` and `∅`
in which `o` is not connected to the ghost.

articles.title: Ghost source set of a bond covariance
articles.statement:
The ghost-graph source set `{ghost} ∪ ({o} ∆ {x, y})` attached to the bond covariance `Cov(σ_o,
σ_xσ_y)`.

articles.title: Random-current form of the $\beta$-derivative of the magnetization
articles.statement:
The `β`-derivative of the magnetization in random-current form: `∂_β ⟨σ_o⟩_{β,h} = Z⁻² (∑_{e ∈
E(G)} Δ_e + h ∑_z Δ_z)`, with `Z` the sourceless ghost-graph current sum. Reference: M. Aizenman, D.
J. Barsky, R. Fernández, "The phase transition in a general class of Ising-type models is sharp", J.
Stat. Phys. 47 (1987) 343–374.

articles.title: Field term $\Delta_z$ of the magnetization derivative
articles.statement:
The field term `Δ_z`: the ghost-graph double-current sum with sources `hcaFieldSource o z` and
`∅` in which `o` is not connected to the ghost.

articles.title: Ghost source set of a field covariance
articles.statement: The ghost-graph source set `{o} ∆ {z}` attached to the field covariance `Cov(σ_o, σ_z)`.

articles.title: Switching gap of a current
articles.statement:
The switching gap of a current `m` with sources `A`: the number of sub-currents (subsets of edge
copies) with sources `A` minus the number with sources `A ∆ {u, v}`; zero if the sources of `m` are
not `A`.

articles.title: Gap-weighted current sum restricted to a predicate
articles.statement:
The current sum `∑_m 1_{P m} · gap(m) · w(m)` of the switching gap weighted by the current
weight, restricted to currents satisfying `P`.

articles.title: Edge lying inside a set
articles.statement: An edge of `G` lies inside `S`.

articles.title: Random-current cut mass of a vertex set
articles.statement:
The cut mass `Z⁻² Z(∂n₁ = ∂n₂ = ∅; {v : v ↮ g in n₁ + n₂} = S)`, with `Z` the sourceless current
sum.

articles.title: Four-source lower bound for the pattern sum
articles.statement:
The four-source lower bound: for `β ≥ 0`, `J ≥ 0`, distinct `o, x, y, g` and `⟨σ_yσ_g⟩ > 0`, the
pattern sum `Δ(o, x, y, g)` is at least `⟨σ_yσ_g⟩⁻¹` times the lower mass. Reference: M. Aizenman,
D. J. Barsky, R. Fernández, "The phase transition in a general class of Ising-type models is sharp",
J. Stat. Phys. 47 (1987) 343–374.

articles.title: Lower mass of the four-source bound
articles.statement:
The lower mass `∑_S ⟨σ_oσ_x⟩_{J|S} · Z(∂ = ∅, C(g)ᶜ = S)` over sets `S` containing `o, x` and
not `y, g`, where `C(g)ᶜ` is the set of vertices not connected to `g`.

articles.title: Four-source double-current sum with a connection pattern
articles.statement:
The double-current sum with sources `{o, g} ∆ {x, y}` and `∅` restricted to `o ↔ x`, `y ↔ g` and
`o ↮ g` in the summed current.

articles.title: Lower mass in the degenerate case $x = o$
articles.statement:
The lower mass in the degenerate case `x = o`: `∑_S Z(∂ = ∅, C(g)ᶜ = S)` over `S ∋ o` with `y, g
∉ S`.

articles.title: Subgraph of edges inside a vertex set
articles.statement: The subgraph of `G` with the edges inside `T`.

articles.title: Integrated mean-field lower bound without an initial condition
articles.statement:
If `(m²)' ≥ (2/β)(1 - m²)` above `β₀ > 0` and `m ≥ 0`, then `m(β) ≥ √(1 - (β₀/β)²)` for `β ≥
β₀`. This strengthens `meanfield_lower_bound` by dropping `m(β₀) = 0`.

articles.title: Integrated mean-field lower bound from $m(\beta_0) = 0$
Vertices not connected to a vertex by positive current
