articles.statement: The set of vertices not connected to `g` by edges carrying positive current.

articles.title: Regrouping a split pair of currents
articles.statement:
Regrouping a pair of currents split along `S` into the pair of inside parts and the pair of
outside parts.

articles.title: Reassembly of a current from its inside and outside parts
articles.statement: Reassembly of a current from its parts inside and outside `S`.

articles.title: Boundary covariance error
articles.statement: The boundary error `∑_{x ∈ Λ_n} #(exterior neighbours of x) · Cov(σ_0, σ_x)`.

articles.title: Origin–site covariance in a box
articles.statement: The covariance `⟨σ_0σ_x⟩_{Λ_n} - ⟨σ_0⟩_{Λ_n}⟨σ_x⟩_{Λ_n}` in the box at `(β, h)`.

articles.title: Nearest-neighbour graph on a box
articles.statement: The nearest-neighbour graph induced on `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Membership of a larger-box site in a smaller box
articles.statement: A site of `Λ_m` lies in `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Smaller box as a subtype of a larger box
articles.statement: For `n ≤ m`, `Λ_n` is equivalent to the subtype of `Λ_m` of sites lying in `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Free-boundary site magnetization in a box
articles.statement: The free-boundary magnetization `⟨σ_x⟩_{Λ_n, β, h}` at a site `x ∈ Λ_n`.

articles.title: Origin as a site of a box
articles.statement: The origin as a site of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: All sites of a box
articles.statement: All sites of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Box $\Lambda_n$ as a type
articles.statement: The box `Λ_n = [-n, n]^d ⊆ ℤ^d` as a type.

articles.title: Lattice site as a box site, defaulting to the origin
articles.statement: A site of `ℤ^d` as a site of `Λ_n` (the origin if it lies outside).

articles.title: Minimal magnetization ratio for $n$-dependent site types
articles.statement: The minimal ratio `min_{y ∈ sites n} M(n)/m(n, y)` for site types depending on `n`.

articles.title: Minimal magnetization ratio for sites indexed by $\mathbb{N}$
articles.statement: The minimal ratio `min_{y ∈ sites n} M(n)/m(n, y)` for sites indexed by `ℕ`.

articles.title: Edge with exactly one endpoint in a cut set
articles.statement: An edge has exactly one endpoint in `T`.

articles.title: Boundary error of the finite-volume mean-field inequality
articles.statement: The boundary error `∑_{T ∋ 0}` (external boundary correlation of `T`) × (cut mass of `T`).

articles.title: Cut mass of a box set rooted at the field ghost
articles.statement: The cut mass of `T` in `Λ_n` with the field ghost as root.

articles.title: Lattice sites underlying a set of box sites
articles.statement: The sites of `ℤ^d` underlying a set `T` of sites of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Identification of a box cut set with its lattice sites
articles.statement: The identification of `T` with `sctCutSites T`.

articles.title: Boundary correlation of an edge crossing a cut
articles.statement:
For an edge crossing the cut `T`, the correlation `⟨σ_0σ_x⟩_T` at its endpoint `x ∈ T`; zero
otherwise.

articles.title: Symmetrized cut mass of an edge
articles.statement: The symmetrized cut mass `sctOrientedCutMass x y + sctOrientedCutMass y x` of an edge.

articles.title: Exterior neighbours of a site
articles.statement: The lattice neighbours of `x` outside `Λ_n`.

articles.title: External boundary correlation of a cut, over edges leaving the box
articles.statement: The sum of `⟨σ_0σ_x⟩_T` over boundary edges `(x, y)` of `T` with `y ∉ Λ_n`.

articles.title: Pairs of a box site and an outside lattice neighbour
articles.statement: Pairs `(x, y)` with `x ∈ Λ_n` and `y` a lattice neighbour of `x` outside `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Field sequence $h_k = 1/(k + 1)$
articles.statement: The field sequence `h_k = 1/(k + 1)`.

articles.title: Finite-volume mean-field inequality for the Ising model
articles.statement:
The finite-volume mean-field inequality: for `β, h > 0` and `inf_S φ_β(S) ≥ φ₀`, `∂_β
⟨σ_0⟩²_{Λ_n} ≥ 2 c_n ((φ₀/β)(1 - ⟨σ_0⟩²) - ε_n)`. Reference: H. Duminil-Copin, V. Tassion, "A new
proof of the sharpness of the phase transition for Bernoulli percolation and the Ising model", Comm.
Math. Phys. 343 (2016) 725–745.

articles.title: Infinite-volume magnetization in a field as a supremum over boxes
articles.statement:
The infinite-volume magnetization in field `h`, the supremum over `n` of the origin
magnetizations in the boxes `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Infinite-volume mean-field function $\beta^2(1 - m(\beta,h)^2)$
articles.statement: `β²(1 - m(β, h)²)` for the infinite-volume magnetization in field `h`.

articles.title: Origin magnetization with the outer-layer field switched off
articles.statement: The origin magnetization in `Λ_n` with the field switched off on the outer layer.

articles.title: Field switched off on the outer layer
articles.statement: The site field equal to `βh` on `Λ_{n-1}` and `0` on the outer layer.

articles.title: Internal boundary correlation of a cut in the box
articles.statement: The sum of `sctEdgeBoundaryCorr` over the edges of `Λ_n`.

articles.title: Minimal origin-to-site magnetization ratio in a box
articles.statement: The minimal ratio `min_{x ∈ Λ_n} ⟨σ_0⟩_{Λ_n}/⟨σ_x⟩_{Λ_n}`.

articles.title: Mean-field lower bound for the spontaneous magnetization
articles.statement:
The mean-field lower bound for the spontaneous magnetization: if `β̃_c > 0` and its defining set
is bounded, then `m*(β) ≥ √(1 - (β̃_c/β)²)` for `β ≥ β̃_c`. Reference: H. Duminil-Copin, V. Tassion,
"A new proof of the sharpness of the phase transition for Bernoulli percolation and the Ising
model", Comm. Math. Phys. 343 (2016) 725–745.

articles.title: Box mean-field function $\beta^2(1 - \langle\sigma_0\rangle^2)$
$\beta$-derivative of the box mean-field function
articles.statement: The `β`-derivative of `g_n`.

articles.title: Error term bounding the derivative of the box mean-field function
articles.statement: The error `2β(1 - c_n)(1 - ⟨σ_0⟩²) + 2β² c_n ε_n` bounding `g_n'` from above.

articles.title: Oriented cut mass over cuts $T \ni 0, x$ with $y \notin T$
articles.statement: The sum over cut sets `T ∋ 0, x` with `y ∉ T` of `⟨σ_0σ_x⟩_T` times the cut mass of `T`.

articles.title: $\beta$-derivative of the origin magnetization in a box
articles.statement: The `β`-derivative of the origin magnetization in `Λ_n`, as the covariance of `σ_0` with `-H`.

articles.title: $\beta$-derivative of the squared origin magnetization in a box
articles.statement: The `β`-derivative of the squared origin magnetization.

articles.title: Origin magnetization in a box
articles.statement: The origin magnetization `⟨σ_0⟩_{Λ_n, β, h}`.

articles.title: Covariance sum over the outer layer
articles.statement: The sum of `Cov(σ_0, σ_x)` over the outer layer `Λ_n \ Λ_{n-1}`.

articles.title: Outer-layer indicator as a field direction
articles.statement: The indicator of the outer layer `Λ_n \ Λ_{n-1}`, used as a field direction.

articles.title: Translation onto a translated box
articles.statement: Translation by `-y` as an equivalence `Λ_n ≃ Λ_n - y`.

articles.title: Nearest-neighbour graph on a translated box
articles.statement: The nearest-neighbour graph induced on `Λ_n - y`.

articles.title: Translated box $\Lambda_n - y$
articles.statement: The translate `Λ_n - y`.

articles.title: Translated box as a subtype of the doubled box
articles.statement: For `y ∈ Λ_n`, `Λ_n - y` is equivalent to the subtype of `Λ_{2n}` of sites lying in it.

articles.title: Membership of a doubled-box site in a translated box
articles.statement: A site of `Λ_{2n}` lies in `Λ_n - y`.

articles.title: Zero-field limit of the positive-field magnetization
articles.statement:
The zero-field limit `m⁺(β) = inf_k m(β, h_k)` of the infinite-volume magnetization in positive
field.

articles.title: Bond energy of a configuration
articles.statement: The bond energy `∑_{e ∈ E(G)} σ_e` of a configuration, where `σ_{xy} = σ_x σ_y`.

articles.title: Bond term: ghost-graph disconnection sum for a bond covariance
articles.statement: The bond term: the ghost-graph disconnection sum for `Cov(σ_o, σ_e)` with couplings `J`.

articles.title: Energy with general couplings and a uniform field
articles.statement: The energy `∑_e J_e σ_e + h ∑_x σ_x`.

articles.title: Gibbs expectation with general couplings and a uniform field
articles.statement: The Gibbs expectation with couplings `J` and field `h`.

articles.title: Field term: ghost-graph disconnection sum for a site covariance
articles.statement: The field term: the ghost-graph disconnection sum for `Cov(σ_o, σ_z)` with couplings `J`.

articles.title: Boltzmann weight with general couplings and a uniform field
articles.statement: The Boltzmann weight `exp(β (∑_e J_e σ_e + h ∑_x σ_x))`.

articles.title: Partition function with general couplings and a uniform field
articles.statement: The partition function with couplings `J` and field `h`.

articles.title: Vertex set that no edge of the graph crosses
articles.statement: Every edge of `G` lies inside `S` or inside its complement.

articles.title: Sourced current sum as correlation times sourceless sum
Internal edge of a vertex set
articles.statement: Both endpoints of `e` lie in `S`.

articles.title: Restriction of a current to an edge predicate
articles.statement: The restriction of the current `n` to the edges satisfying `p` (zero elsewhere).

articles.title: Adjacency through an edge of an edge set
articles.statement: `a` and `b` are distinct endpoints of an edge in `P`.

articles.title: Adjacency through an edge of a multigraph edge set
articles.statement: `a ≠ b` are the endpoints of an edge of `K`.

articles.title: Canonical backbone path of a current
articles.statement: A canonical backbone path: the least one for a given linear order on backbone paths.

articles.title: Boltzmann weight with couplings
articles.statement: The Boltzmann weight `exp(β ∑_e J_e σ_e)` with couplings `J`.

articles.title: Odd-degree vertices in a cluster
articles.statement: The odd-degree vertices of `m` in the cluster of `u`.

articles.title: Cluster of a site in an edge set
articles.statement: The cluster of `u` in the edge set `P`.

articles.title: Cluster of a vertex in a multigraph edge set
articles.statement: The cluster of `u` in `K`.

articles.title: Connectivity in a multigraph edge set
articles.statement: Connectivity in `K`: the reflexive transitive closure of `adjStep`.

articles.title: Connectivity through the edges of an edge set
articles.statement: Connectivity through the edges of `P`: the reflexive-transitive closure of `adjP P`.

articles.title: Edge copies of a current
articles.statement: The edge copies of a current `m`: `m_e` copies of each edge `e`.

articles.title: Current as a multiplicity on unordered pairs
articles.statement:
A current: a multiplicity in `ℕ` on every unordered pair. See also
`StatMech.Sharpness.Current`.

articles.title: Connectivity through edges carrying positive current
articles.statement: `x` and `y` are joined by a path of edges carrying positive current.

articles.title: Random-current representation
articles.statement:
The random-current representation: `⟨σ_A⟩_{β,J} = Z(∂ = A)/Z(∂ = ∅)`. Reference: M. Aizenman,
"Geometric analysis of φ⁴ fields and Ising models", Comm. Math. Phys. 86 (1982) 1–48; J. Ginibre
(1970); H. Duminil-Copin, "Random currents expansion of the Ising model", lecture notes (2016),
arXiv:1607.06933.

articles.title: Subgraph of edges carrying positive current
articles.statement: The subgraph of `G` of edges with `n_e ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Current sum with prescribed sources
articles.statement: The current sum `Z(∂ = A) = ∑_{∂n = A} w(n)` over currents on the edges of `G`.

articles.title: Current: a multiplicity in $\mathbb{N}$ for each unordered pair
articles.statement: A current on the edges of `V`: a multiplicity `n_e ∈ ℕ` for every unordered pair `e`.

articles.title: Degree of a vertex in a multigraph edge set
articles.statement: The degree of `x` in the multigraph edge set `T`.

articles.title: Degree of a site in an edge set
articles.statement: The number of edges of `P` incident to `x`.

articles.title: Sub-subset-weighted pair sum on a multigraph
articles.statement:
For a multigraph `ends`, the sum over edge subsets `m` with sources `A` of `F m` times the
number of sub-subsets `K ⊆ m` with sources `A`, restricted to `m` satisfying `P`.

articles.title: Multigraph edge lying inside a vertex set
articles.statement: Both endpoints of the multigraph edge `i` lie in `S`.

articles.title: Unordered pair inside a set
articles.statement: An unordered pair `e` is inside `S` if both of its endpoints lie in `S`.

articles.title: Endpoints of an edge copy
articles.statement: The endpoints of an edge copy.

articles.title: Correlation function with couplings
articles.statement: The correlation `⟨σ_A⟩_{β,J}` with couplings `J`.

articles.title: Random-current representation with a field for even source sets
articles.statement:
The random-current representation with a field: for `|A|` even, `⟨σ_A⟩_{β,h} = Z_ghost(∂ =
A)/Z_ghost(∂ = ∅)` on the ghost graph. Reference: M. Aizenman, D. J. Barsky, R. Fernández, "The
phase transition in a general class of Ising-type models is sharp", J. Stat. Phys. 47 (1987)
343–374; H. Duminil-Copin, "Random currents expansion of the Ising model", lecture notes (2016),
arXiv:1607.06933.

articles.title: Global spin flip
articles.statement: The global spin flip `σ ↦ -σ`.

articles.title: Term of the exponential expansion of an edge weight
articles.statement: The `k`-th term `(βJ_e σ_e)^k / k!` of the expansion of `exp(βJ_e σ_e)`.

articles.title: Coupling on the ghost graph with uniform field
articles.statement: The coupling on the ghost graph: `J` on the edges of `G` and `h` on the ghost edges.

articles.title: Ghost edges
articles.statement: The ghost edges `{x, ghost}`.

articles.title: Ghost vertex of the extended vertex set
articles.statement: The ghost vertex `none` of `Option V`.

articles.title: Incident flux of a current on an edge set
articles.statement: The total multiplicity of the edges of `E` incident to `x`.

articles.title: Incident flux of a current at a vertex
articles.statement: The total multiplicity `∑_{e ∋ x} n_e` of the edges of `G` incident to `x`.

articles.title: Backbone paths along odd-current edges
articles.statement: Backbone paths from `x` to `y`: paths in the subgraph of odd edges.

articles.title: Switching lemma
articles.statement:
**Switching lemma** (counting form). If `u ≠ v` are connected by the odd edges of `n₁ + n₂`,
the sub-currents of `n₁ + n₂` with sources `A ∆ {u, v}` and with sources `A` are
equinumerous.

R. B. Griffiths, C. A. Hurst and S. Sherman, J. Math. Phys. 11 (1970); M. Aizenman,
*Geometric analysis of φ⁴ fields and Ising models*, Comm. Math. Phys. 86 (1982).

articles.title: Switching lemma
articles.statement:
**Switching lemma** (weighted form). If `u ≠ v` are connected by odd edges of `m`, the
weighted sums over splittings with sources `A ∆ {u, v}` and `A` agree.

M. Aizenman, *Geometric analysis of φ⁴ fields and Ising models*, Comm. Math. Phys. 86 (1982).

articles.title: Multigraph edge set with no edge crossing a vertex set
articles.statement: Every edge of `m` lies inside `S` or inside `Sᶜ`.

articles.title: Current with no edge crossing a set's boundary
articles.statement:
The current `n` uses no edge joining `S` to `Sᶜ`: every edge with `n e ≥ 1` is inside `S` or
inside `Sᶜ`.

articles.title: Vertices not connected to a root through a multigraph edge set
articles.statement: The vertices not connected to `o` using edges of `m` in the multigraph `ends`.

articles.title: Edges of an edge set with odd multiplicity
articles.statement: The edges of `E` with odd multiplicity.

articles.title: Subgraph of edges with odd current
articles.statement: The subgraph of `G` of edges with odd multiplicity.

articles.title: Extension of an edge function to a current
articles.statement: Extension of a function on the edges of `G` to a current, zero off `E(G)`.

articles.title: Graph edges as ghost-graph edges
articles.statement: The edges of `G`, as edges of the ghost graph.

articles.title: Reparametrizing pairs of functions by their sum and one summand
articles.statement: Pairs `(p, q)` of functions to `ℕ` correspond to a sum `m = p + q` together with `p ≤ m`.

articles.title: Partition function with couplings
articles.statement: The partition function with couplings `J`.

articles.title: Trace of a current as a bond configuration
articles.statement: The trace of a current: the bond configuration with `e` open iff `n_e ≥ 1`.

articles.title: Edges of an edge set with positive multiplicity
articles.statement: The edges of `E` with positive multiplicity.

articles.title: Profile of a set of edge copies
articles.statement: The profile of a set of copies: the number of copies of each edge it contains.

articles.title: Reflection as an involution of the sub-currents of a current
articles.statement: Reflection along `P` as an involutive equivalence of the sub-currents of `m`.

articles.title: Reflection of a sub-current along an edge set
articles.statement: The reflection of a sub-current `n ≤ m` along `P`: `m e - n e` on `P` and `n e` elsewhere.

articles.title: Current with a walk removed
articles.statement: The current `n` with one unit removed from each traversal of an edge of `p`.

articles.title: Restriction of a current to a set
articles.statement: The restriction `n|_S` of a current to the edges inside `S`, zero elsewhere.

articles.title: Weight of currents with a given selected backbone
articles.statement: `Z_ω`: the total weight of currents with sources `{x, y}` whose selected backbone is `ω`.

articles.title: Odd-current path as a backbone path
articles.statement: A path with odd current on every edge as a backbone path.

articles.title: Least backbone path between two vertices
articles.statement: The least backbone path from `x` to `y`, if any.

articles.title: Odd-current paths between two vertices
articles.statement: The paths from `x` to `y` all of whose edges carry odd current.

articles.title: Odd current on every edge of a path
articles.statement: Every edge of the path carries odd current.

articles.title: Backbone weight $\rho(\omega)$
articles.statement: The backbone weight `ρ(ω) = Z_ω/Z(∂ = ∅)`.

articles.title: Subsets of a sigma type as families of fibre subsets
articles.statement: Subsets of `Σ e, β e` correspond to families of subsets of the fibres.

articles.title: Embedding of vertices into the ghost graph
articles.statement: The embedding `V ↪ Option V`.

articles.title: Double-current sum restricted to disconnection
articles.statement: The double-current sum `∑_{∂n₁ = A, ∂n₂ = B} w(n₁) w(n₂) 1_{u ↮ v in n₁ + n₂}`.

articles.title: Double-current sum with prescribed sources
articles.statement: The double-current sum `∑_{∂n₁ = A, ∂n₂ = B} w(n₁) w(n₂)`.

articles.title: Triple-current sum with prescribed sources
articles.statement: The triple-current sum `∑_{∂n₁ = A, ∂n₂ = B, ∂n₃ = C} w(n₁) w(n₂) w(n₃)`.

articles.title: Sources of a multigraph edge set
articles.statement: The odd-degree vertices of the multigraph edge set `T`.

articles.title: Source set of a current on an edge set
articles.statement:
The source set of a current: the sites with odd incident flux. See also
`StatMech.Sharpness.sources` and `StatMech.Ising.sources_edgeFinset_eq`.

articles.title: Sources on a graph's edge set agree with random-current sources
articles.statement: The source set of a current on the edges of `G` is `Sharpness.sources G`.

articles.title: Sources of a current
articles.statement: The sources `∂n`: the vertices with odd incident flux.

articles.title: Weighted sum over splittings with prescribed sources
articles.statement: The weighted sum `F ∑_K w(K) w(m - K)` over sub-currents `K ≤ m` with sources `A`.

articles.title: Odd-degree sites of an edge set
articles.statement: The sites of odd degree in the edge set `P`.

articles.title: Sum over edge sets split into parts with sources $A$ and $B$
articles.statement:
The sum over edge sets `m` with sources `A ∆ B` and over splittings `m = K ⊔ (m \ K)` with
sources `A` and `B` of `F m`.

articles.title: Switching lemma for multigraph currents
articles.statement:
The switching lemma: for `m` with sources `A` and `u ≠ v`, `∑_{K ⊆ m, ∂K = A ∆ {u, v}} F(m) =
∑_{K ⊆ m, ∂K = A} F(m) 1_{u ↔ v in m}`. Reference: M. Aizenman, "Geometric analysis of φ⁴ fields and
Ising models", Comm. Math. Phys. 86 (1982) 1–48; H. Duminil-Copin, "Random currents expansion of the
Ising model", lecture notes (2016), arXiv:1607.06933.

articles.title: Reparametrizing triples of functions by their sum and two summands
articles.statement:
Triples of functions to `ℕ` correspond to a sum `m` together with two functions with pointwise
sum `≤ m`.

articles.title: Single-edge current weight $(\beta J_e)^k/k!$
articles.statement: The single-edge weight `(βJ_e)^k / k!`.

articles.title: Number of walk edges at a vertex
articles.statement: The number of edges of the walk `p` incident to `x`.

articles.title: Current weights are nonnegative for nonnegative $\beta$ and couplings
articles.statement: Current weights are nonnegative for `β ≥ 0` and nonnegative couplings.

articles.title: Weight of a random current
articles.statement: The current weight `w(n) = ∏_{e ∈ E(G)} (βJ_e)^{n_e}/n_e!`.

articles.title: Four-vertex multigraph with edges $\{0, 1\}$ and $\{2, 3\}$
articles.statement: A multigraph on `Fin 4` with the two edges `{0, 1}` and `{2, 3}`.

articles.title: Full edge set of the four-vertex multigraph
articles.statement: All edges of `witEnds`.

articles.title: Graph with a ghost vertex joined to every site
articles.statement: The graph on `V ⊔ {ghost}` with the edges of `G` and an edge from every site to the ghost.

articles.title: Simon radius of a finite set
articles.statement:
One more than the largest `ℓ¹` distance from the origin of a point of `T` or of the outer
endpoint of a boundary edge of `T`.

articles.title: Tail set of plus-state correlations
articles.statement: The set of values `⟨σ_0σ_z⟩^+_β` with `‖z‖₁ ≥ n`, together with `0`.

articles.title: Tail supremum of plus-state correlations
articles.statement: The tail supremum `sup {⟨σ_0σ_z⟩^+_β | ‖z‖₁ ≥ n}` (and `0`).

articles.title: Window sum of plus-state correlations
articles.statement: The window sum `∑_{z ∈ L} ⟨σ_0σ_z⟩^+_β`.

articles.title: Supremum of plus-state window sums over windows of at most $n$ sites
articles.statement: The supremum of the window sums over windows with at most `n` sites.

articles.title: Abstract form of the sharpness theorem
articles.statement:
Abstract form of the sharpness theorem: a magnetization satisfying the mean-field differential
inequality above `β_c` obeys `m(β) ≥ √(1 - (β_c/β)²)`, and correlations satisfying Simon's
self-consistent bound with `φ < 1` are summable with sum at most `|S|/(1 - φ)`. The hypotheses are
inputs; the unconditional statement is `ising_sharp_phase_transition`.

articles.title: Sharpness of the Ising phase transition on $\mathbb{Z}^d$, $d \ge 2$
articles.statement:
Sharpness of the phase transition for the Ising model on `ℤ^d`, `d ≥ 2`: for `β ≥ β_c`, `m*(β) ≥
√(1 - (β_c/β)²)`; for `0 ≤ β < β_c`, the plus-state two-point function `z ↦ ⟨σ_0σ_z⟩^+_β` is
summable and decays as `exp(-c‖z‖₁)`. Reference: H. Duminil-Copin, V. Tassion, "A new proof of the
sharpness of the phase transition for Bernoulli percolation and the Ising model", Comm. Math. Phys.
343 (2016) 725–745, Theorem 1.2; first proved in M. Aizenman, D. J. Barsky, R. Fernández, "The phase
transition in a general class of Ising-type models is sharp", J. Stat. Phys. 47 (1987) 343–374.
Scope: `β_c` is `Ising.betaC d`, the infimum of the inverse temperatures with positive spontaneous
magnetization, and distance is the `ℓ¹` distance (equivalent to the Euclidean one up to constants).
The statement does not include `0 < β_c < ∞`; positivity follows from `tildeBetaCIsing_pos` and the
identification `β_c = β̃_c` in the proof, finiteness from the Peierls transition.

articles.title: Auxiliary critical point $\tilde\beta_c(d)$ is positive for $d \ge 2$
articles.statement:
For `d ≥ 2` the auxiliary critical point `β̃_c(d)` is positive: `φ_β({0}) ≤ 2dβ < 1` for small
`β`.

articles.title: Conditional finite-volume Aizenman–Barsky–Fernández inequality
articles.statement:
A conditional finite-volume form of the Aizenman–Barsky–Fernández inequality: if the GHS
bound holds at `o` and the GHS bounds sum to `J ⟨σ_o⟩ χ(o)`, then the bond-energy
susceptibility is at most `J ⟨σ_o⟩ χ(o)`.

articles.title: Bond-energy susceptibility
articles.statement: The bond-energy susceptibility `∑_{e ∈ E} Cov(σ_o, σ_e)`.

articles.title: Two-point spin covariance
articles.statement: The spin covariance `Cov(σ_x, σ_y) = ⟨σ_xσ_y⟩ - ⟨σ_x⟩⟨σ_y⟩`.

articles.title: Covariance of a spin with a bond variable
articles.statement:
The covariance `⟨σ_o σ_x σ_y⟩ - ⟨σ_o⟩⟨σ_x σ_y⟩` of `σ_o` with the bond variable of `e = {x,
y}`.

articles.title: GHS bound for a bond
articles.statement: The GHS bound `Cov(σ_o, σ_x)⟨σ_y⟩ + Cov(σ_o, σ_y)⟨σ_x⟩` for the bond `e = {x, y}`.

articles.title: GHS three-point inequality at a site for every edge
articles.statement:
The GHS inequality at `o` for every edge: `cov3sym ≤ ghsBoundSym`, equivalently `u₃(o, x, y)
≤ 0` for every edge `{x, y}`.

articles.title: Negative Hamiltonian of the Ising model
articles.statement: The negative Hamiltonian `∑_{xy ∈ E} σ_xσ_y + h ∑_x σ_x`.

articles.title: Ising one-point function
articles.statement: The one-point function `⟨σ_x⟩`.

articles.title: Ising susceptibility at a site
articles.statement: The susceptibility `χ(o) = ∑_x Cov(σ_o, σ_x)`.

articles.title: Bond parameter $1 - e^{-\beta}$
articles.statement: The bond parameter `1 - exp(-β)` as an element of `ℝ≥0`.

articles.title: Free origin correlation in a set, extended by zero
articles.statement: The function `x ↦ ⟨σ_0σ_x⟩_S`, extended by `0` outside `S` (and identically `0` if `0 ∉ S`).

articles.title: Free-boundary zero-field two-point function in a finite set
articles.statement:
The free-boundary zero-field two-point function `⟨σ_aσ_b⟩_S` in the induced graph on `S` (equal
to `1` when `a = b`).

articles.title: Induced subgraph of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ on a finite set
articles.statement: The subgraph of `ℤ^d` induced by a finite set `S`, on the vertex type `S`.

articles.title: Percolation quantity $\varphi_p(S)$ at $p = 1 - e^{-\beta}$
articles.statement: The percolation quantity `φ_p(S)` at `p = 1 - exp(-β)`.

articles.title: Duminil-Copin–Tassion quantity $\varphi_\beta(S)$ for the Ising model
articles.statement: The Duminil-Copin–Tassion quantity `φ_β(S) = tanh β ∑_{(x,y) ∈ ∂S} ⟨σ_0σ_x⟩_S`.

articles.title: Inverse temperatures with an Ising witness $\varphi_\beta(S) < 1$
articles.statement: Inverse temperatures `β ≥ 0` with a finite `S ∋ 0` such that `φ_β(S) < 1`.

articles.title: Auxiliary critical point $\tilde\beta_c$ of the Ising model
articles.statement: The auxiliary critical point `β̃_c(d) = sup {β ≥ 0 | ∃ S ∋ 0, φ_β(S) < 1}`.

articles.title: Inverse temperatures with a percolation witness $\varphi(S) < 1$
articles.statement: Inverse temperatures `β ≥ 0` with a finite `S ∋ 0` such that `φ_{1-e^{-β}}(S) < 1`.

articles.title: Percolation auxiliary critical point on the $\beta$ scale
articles.statement: The percolation auxiliary critical point on the `β` scale, the supremum of `tildeBetaCPercoSet`.

articles.title: Indicator current of an edge set
articles.statement: The current equal to `1` on the edges of `F` and `0` elsewhere.

articles.title: Edge set with prescribed odd-degree vertices
articles.statement: The set of vertices of odd degree in the edge set `F` is exactly `A`.

articles.title: Chosen first-exit data
articles.statement: A choice of first-exit data, from `exists_highTempFirstExit`.

articles.title: First-exit data for a high-temperature edge set
articles.statement:
First-exit data for an edge set `K` with boundary `{o} ∆ {z}` and a set `S ∋ o`, `z ∉ S`: an
exit edge `xy` of `K` with `x ∈ S`, `y ∉ S`, and a subset `Q ⊆ K` of edges inside `S` with boundary
`{o} ∆ {x}` not containing `xy`.

articles.title: Edges of a graph inside a set
articles.statement: The edges of `G` inside `S`.

articles.title: Edge sets with a given boundary
articles.statement: The edge sets `F ⊆ E` with boundary `A`.

articles.title: High-temperature source sum
articles.statement: The high-temperature source sum `∑_{F ⊆ E, ∂F = A} ∏_{e ∈ F} t_e`.

articles.title: High-temperature weight of an edge set
articles.statement: The high-temperature weight `∏_{e ∈ F} tanh(βJ_e)` of an edge set.

articles.title: Weight of a switching input
articles.statement: The weight `∏_{e ∈ F} t_e ∏_{e ∈ H} t_e` of an input.

articles.title: Input pair of the high-temperature switching
articles.statement: A pair of edge sets `(F, H)`, the input of the switching.

articles.title: Finite set of valid switching inputs
articles.statement: The finite set of valid inputs.

articles.title: Switching map between valid inputs and outputs
articles.statement: The switching as a map between the finite sets of valid inputs and outputs.

articles.title: Weight of a switching output
articles.statement: The weight `∏_{e ∈ A} t_e · t_{xy} · ∏_{e ∈ B} t_e` of an output.

articles.title: Output tuple of the high-temperature switching
articles.statement: A tuple `(x, y, A, B)` of an exit edge and two edge sets, the output of the switching.

articles.title: Finite set of valid switching outputs
articles.statement: The finite set of valid outputs.

articles.title: High-temperature switching map
articles.statement: The switching map: cut `F ∆ H` at its first exit from `S` and redistribute the pieces.

articles.title: Boundary edges of a finite volume
articles.statement: The edges touching `Λ` that are not inside `Λ`.

articles.title: Field induced by the plus boundary condition
articles.statement:
The field on `x ∈ Λ` induced by the plus boundary condition: the number of edges from `x` to
sites outside `Λ`.

articles.title: Simon–Lieb inequality in the infinite-volume plus state
articles.statement:
The Simon–Lieb inequality in the infinite-volume plus state: for `β ≥ 0`, a finite `T ∋ 0` and
`z ∉ T`, `⟨σ_0σ_z⟩^+_β ≤ ∑_{(x,y) ∈ ∂T} tanh β ⟨σ_0σ_x⟩_T ⟨σ_yσ_z⟩^+_β`. Reference: B. Simon,
"Correlation inequalities and the decay of correlations in ferromagnets", Comm. Math. Phys. 77
(1980) 111–126; E. H. Lieb, "A refinement of Simon's correlation inequality", Comm. Math. Phys. 77
(1980) 127–135.

articles.title: Plus-state two-point function at zero field
articles.statement: The plus-state two-point function `⟨σ_xσ_y⟩^+_β` at zero field.

articles.title: Underlying lattice sites of a subset of a volume
articles.statement: The sites of `ℤ^d` underlying a set `T` of sites of `Λ`.

articles.title: Identification of volume sites with lattice sites
articles.statement: The identification of `T` (as sites of `Λ`) with `plusCutSites T` (as sites of `ℤ^d`).

articles.title: Simon–Lieb boundary sum against a measure
articles.statement: The Simon–Lieb boundary sum `∑_{(x,y) ∈ ∂S} tanh β ⟨σ_0σ_x⟩_S ∫ σ_yσ_z dμ` for a measure `μ`.

articles.title: Simon–Lieb boundary sum in the plus state
articles.statement: The Simon–Lieb boundary sum `∑_{(x,y) ∈ ∂S} tanh β ⟨σ_0σ_x⟩_S ⟨σ_yσ_z⟩^+_β` in the plus state.

articles.title: Simon constant of a weight function
articles.statement: The Simon constant `φ = ∑_{x ∈ S} ∑_{y ∈ B} w(x, y)`.

articles.title: Simon–Lieb type inequality for a nonnegative two-point function
articles.statement:
A Simon–Lieb type inequality for a nonnegative two-point function `τ`, root `o`, set `S`,
weights `w` and boundary targets `B`: `τ(o, z) ≤ ∑_{x ∈ S} ∑_{y ∈ B} w(x, y) τ(y, z)` for every `z ∉
S`.

articles.title: Simon–Lieb weight
articles.statement: The Simon–Lieb weight `tanh(βJ_{xy}) ⟨σ_oσ_x⟩_{J|S}`.

articles.title: Simon weight of a boundary pair
articles.statement: The Simon weight `w(x, y) = tanh(βJ_{xy}) ⟨σ_oσ_x⟩_{J|S}`.

articles.title: Sites of a volume lying in a set
articles.statement: The sites of `Λ` that lie in `T`.

articles.title: Source pair $\{a\} \triangle \{b\}$
articles.statement: The source set `{a} ∆ {b}` (empty when `a = b`).

articles.title: Spin pair product as a bounded continuous function
articles.statement: The bounded continuous function `σ ↦ σ_x σ_y` on configuration space.

articles.title: Simon–Lieb inequality on a finite graph
articles.statement:
The Simon–Lieb inequality: for `β, J ≥ 0`, `o ∈ S` and `z ∉ S`, `⟨σ_oσ_z⟩ ≤ ∑_{x ∈ S} ∑_{y ∉ S}
tanh(βJ_{xy}) ⟨σ_oσ_x⟩_{J|S} ⟨σ_yσ_z⟩`. Reference: B. Simon, "Correlation inequalities and the decay
of correlations in ferromagnets", Comm. Math. Phys. 77 (1980) 111–126; E. H. Lieb, "A refinement of
Simon's correlation inequality", Comm. Math. Phys. 77 (1980) 127–135.

articles.title: Two-point function with couplings
articles.statement: The two-point function `⟨σ_aσ_b⟩_{β,J}` (equal to `1` when `a = b`).

articles.title: Unit coupling on the edges of a graph
articles.statement: The coupling equal to `1` on the edges of `G` and `0` elsewhere.

articles.title: Valid switching outputs
articles.statement:
Valid outputs: `x ∈ S`, `y ∉ S`, `A` inside `S` with boundary `{o} ∆ {x}`, and `B ⊆ E(G)` with
boundary `{y} ∆ {z}`.

articles.title: Valid switching inputs
articles.statement: Valid inputs: `F ⊆ E(G)` with boundary `{o} ∆ {z}` and `H` inside `S` with empty boundary.

articles.title: Gibbs expectation with a site field
articles.statement: The Gibbs expectation with site field `H`.

articles.title: Two-point function with a site field
articles.statement: The two-point function `⟨σ_aσ_b⟩_{β,J,H}` with site field `H`.

articles.title: Boltzmann weight with a site field
articles.statement: The Boltzmann weight `exp(β(∑_e J_e σ_e + ∑_x H_x σ_x))` with a site field `H`.

articles.title: Partition function with a site field
articles.statement: The partition function with site field `H`.

articles.title: Ghost-graph coupling with a site field
articles.statement:
The coupling on `G` plus a ghost vertex: `J` on the edges of `G` and `H_x` on the edge `{x,
ghost}`.

articles.title: Ising model as a Physlib canonical ensemble
articles.statement:
The Ising model on a finite graph `G` with field `h`, as Physlib's finite canonical ensemble:
microstates are spin configurations, the energy is `hamiltonian G h`, and the measure is the
counting measure.

articles.title: Hamiltonian agrees with Physlib's Ising energy
articles.statement:
The Hamiltonian `hamiltonian G h` is Physlib's Ising energy
`CondensedMatter.IsingModel.energy` of the model with coupling `J = 1` and field `h`, on the region
of all vertices.

articles.title: Isomorphism of the hypercubic lattice with Physlib's crystal graph
articles.statement:
The nearest-neighbour graph `hypercubicLattice d` on `ℤ^d` is isomorphic to the bond graph of
Physlib's hypercubic crystal `CondensedMatter.Crystal.hypercubicGraph d`, by sending `x` to the
site in cell `x`.

articles.title: Ising Gibbs probability agrees with Physlib's canonical probability
articles.statement:
The Ising Gibbs probability at inverse temperature `T.β` is Physlib's canonical probability of
`canonicalEnsemble G h` at temperature `T`.

articles.title: Ising partition function agrees with Physlib's partition function
articles.statement:
The Ising partition function at inverse temperature `T.β` is Physlib's mathematical partition
function of `canonicalEnsemble G h` at temperature `T`.

articles.title: Sites at $\ell^1$ distance one are those differing by a unit vector
articles.statement: Two sites of `ℤ^d` are at `ℓ¹` distance one exactly when they differ by a unit vector.

articles.title: Boolean spin agrees with Physlib's Ising spin
articles.statement: The Boolean spin value `spinB` is Physlib's `CondensedMatter.IsingModel.spin`.

articles.title: Edge bond sum is half the sum over ordered adjacent pairs
articles.statement: The edge sum of `bond s` is half the sum of `σ_x σ_y` over ordered adjacent pairs.

articles.title: Configuration equivalence induced by a vertex relabeling
articles.statement:
The equivalence of configuration spaces induced by a vertex equivalence `σ : V ≃ W`: `ω ↦ ω ∘
σ`.

articles.title: Configurations on a disjoint union as pairs of configurations
articles.statement: The equivalence between configurations on `V ⊕ W` and pairs of configurations on `V` and `W`.

articles.title: Bond variable takes values $\pm 1$
articles.statement: A bond variable is `1` or `-1`.

articles.title: Bond variable of an unordered pair
articles.statement: The bond variable `σ_x σ_y` of an unordered pair `e = {x, y}`.

articles.title: Ising Hamiltonian on a finite graph
articles.statement:
The Ising Hamiltonian `H(s) = -∑_{xy ∈ E(G)} σ_x σ_y - h ∑_x σ_x` on a finite graph `G` with
unit coupling and external field `h`. See also `CondensedMatter.IsingModel.energy` and
`StatMech.Ising.hamiltonian_eq_energy`.

articles.title: Finite-volume Ising Gibbs probability mass function
articles.statement: The finite-volume Ising Gibbs distribution as a probability mass function on configurations.

articles.title: Ising Gibbs probabilities sum to one
articles.statement: The Gibbs probabilities sum to one.

articles.title: Gibbs probability of an Ising configuration
articles.statement:
The Gibbs probability `exp (-β H(s)) / Z` of a configuration. See also
`CanonicalEnsemble.probability` and `StatMech.Ising.isingProb_eq_probability`.

articles.title: Boltzmann weight of an Ising configuration
articles.statement: The Boltzmann weight `exp (-β H(s))` of a configuration at inverse temperature `β`.

articles.title: Positivity of the Ising partition function
articles.statement: The partition function is positive.

articles.title: Ising partition function
articles.statement:
The partition function `Z = ∑_s exp (-β H(s))`. See also
`CanonicalEnsemble.mathematicalPartitionFunction` and
`StatMech.Ising.isingZ_eq_mathematicalPartitionFunction`.

articles.title: Spin of a configuration at a site
articles.statement: The spin `σ_x ∈ {1, -1}` of the configuration `s` at `x`: `1` for `true`, `-1` for `false`.

articles.title: Global spin flip as an involutive equivalence
articles.statement: The global spin flip as an involutive equivalence of configurations.

articles.title: Global spin flip
articles.statement: The global spin flip `σ ↦ -σ`.

articles.title: Perfect matching with n edges
articles.statement: The perfect matching with `n` edges, the disjoint union of `n` single edges.

articles.title: Lee–Yang circle property of a graph
articles.statement:
The Lee–Yang circle property: every complex zero of the Lee–Yang polynomial of `G` at inverse
temperature `β` has modulus one.

articles.title: Vertex type of the perfect matching with n edges
articles.statement: The vertex type of the perfect matching with `n` edges: `n` disjoint copies of `Fin 2`.

articles.title: Single-edge graph on two vertices
articles.statement: The graph on two vertices joined by one edge.

articles.title: Asano's contraction lemma
articles.statement:
Asano's contraction lemma: the Asano contraction of a multi-affine polydisc-stable polynomial is
polydisc stable (Asano, Phys. Rev. Lett. 24 (1970)).

articles.title: Asano contraction of two variables
articles.statement:
The Asano contraction of the variables `i` and `j`: for `p = A + B z_i + C z_j + D z_i z_j` it
is `A + D z_i`, computed from the values of `p` at `z_i, z_j ∈ {0, 1}`.

articles.title: Asano's lemma in one variable
articles.statement:
Asano's lemma in one variable: if `A + E t + D t²` has no zero in the open unit disk, then
neither has `A + D t`.

articles.title: Lee–Yang circle theorem
articles.statement:
For the Ising model on a finite graph with uniform ferromagnetic
coupling and `β ≥ 0`, every complex zero of the partition function in the fugacity `z =
e^{-2βh}` lies on the unit circle (Lee and Yang, *Statistical theory of equations of state and
phase transitions. II*, Phys. Rev. 87 (1952)).

articles.title: Multi-affine function of several complex variables
articles.statement:
A function of finitely many complex variables is multi-affine if it is affine in each variable
separately.

articles.title: Term of a vertex factor selected by a Boolean choice
articles.statement: The term of `1 + z_v` selected by a Boolean choice.

articles.title: Vertex part of the half-edge polynomial
articles.statement: The vertex part `∏_v (1 + z_v)` of the half-edge polynomial.

articles.title: Anchor variables of the vertices with plus spin
articles.statement: The anchor variables of the vertices with spin `true`.

articles.title: Anchor variable of a vertex
articles.statement: The anchor variable of a vertex.

articles.title: Selection indicator of a choice on the variables
articles.statement: Whether a choice selects each variable.

articles.title: Set of variables selected by a choice
articles.statement: The set of variables selected by a choice, the support of its monomial.

articles.title: Term of the expanded half-edge polynomial for a choice
articles.statement:
The term of the expanded half-edge polynomial selected by a choice at every vertex and every
edge.

articles.title: Coefficient of a term of the expanded half-edge polynomial
articles.statement:
The coefficient of a term of the expanded half-edge polynomial: `e^{-2β}` for every edge whose
two choices differ.

articles.title: Ferromagnetic Lee–Yang polynomial has no zero in the open unit disk
articles.statement: The Lee–Yang polynomial of a ferromagnetic Ising model has no zero in the open unit disk.

articles.title: Consistency of a variable set with a list of incidences
articles.statement:
A set of variables is consistent with a list of incidences if each listed half-edge variable is
selected exactly when the anchor variable of its vertex is.

articles.title: Successive Asano contraction along a list of incidences
articles.statement:
Successive Asano contraction of the half-edge variable of each incidence in the list into the
anchor variable of its vertex.

articles.title: Half-edge polynomial with every incidence contracted
articles.statement: The half-edge polynomial after contracting every incidence.

articles.title: Diagonal point with anchors at q and half-edge variables at zero
articles.statement: The point with every anchor variable equal to `q` and every half-edge variable equal to `0`.

articles.title: Term of an edge factor selected by two Boolean choices
articles.statement: The term of the edge factor selected by a pair of Boolean choices, one per endpoint.

articles.title: Edge factor has no zero in the open unit bidisk for 0 ≤ r ≤ 1
articles.statement:
The two-variable edge factor `1 + ab + r (a + b)` with `0 ≤ r ≤ 1` has no zero in the open unit
bidisk.

articles.title: Edge part of the half-edge polynomial
articles.statement: The edge part of the half-edge polynomial: the product of the edge factors.

articles.title: Chosen first endpoint of an edge
articles.statement: A chosen first endpoint of an edge.

articles.title: Other endpoint of an edge
articles.statement: The other endpoint of an edge.

articles.title: Removal of listed half-edge variables from a variable set
articles.statement: Remove from a set of variables the half-edge variables of the listed incidences.

articles.title: Half-edge polynomial of a graph
articles.statement:
The half-edge polynomial: the product of `1 + z_v` over the vertices and of the edge factors
over the edges.

articles.title: Half-edge variable of an incidence
articles.statement: The half-edge variable of the incidence `(v, e)`.

articles.title: Vertex–edge incidences of a graph
articles.statement: The incidences `(v, e)` of `G`, with `v` an endpoint of `e`.

articles.title: Monomial of a set of variables
articles.statement: The monomial `∏_{i ∈ S} z_i`.

articles.title: Edge factor in half-edge variables
articles.statement:
The edge factor `1 + w_u w_v + e^{-2β} (w_u + w_v)` of the edge `e = {u, v}`, in its half-edge
variables.

articles.title: Real disagreement weight of a spin configuration
articles.statement: The real weight `∏_e e^{-2β [σ_u ≠ σ_v]}` of a spin configuration.

articles.title: Edge choices induced by a spin configuration
articles.statement:
The edge choices induced by a spin configuration: each edge copies the spins of its
endpoints.

articles.title: Variables of the half-edge polynomial
articles.statement:
The variables of the half-edge polynomial: one anchor variable per vertex and one half-edge
variable per incidence `(v, e)`.

articles.title: Polydisc stability of a function of complex variables
articles.statement:
A function of complex variables is polydisc stable if it has no zero when every variable lies in
the open unit disk.

articles.title: Lee–Yang polynomial with complex coefficients
articles.statement:
The Lee–Yang polynomial with complex coefficients, whose zeros the Lee–Yang circle theorem
locates.

articles.title: Lee–Yang polynomial of a finite Ising model
articles.statement:
The Lee–Yang polynomial `∑_σ exp (β ∑_e σ_x σ_y) X^k(σ)` of the Ising model on `G`, where `k(σ)`
is the number of minus spins; its variable is the fugacity `exp (-2βh)`.

articles.title: Number of minus spins of a configuration
articles.statement: The number of minus spins (sites with value `false`) of a configuration.

articles.title: Zero-field Boltzmann weight of a configuration
articles.statement: The zero-field Boltzmann weight `exp (β ∑_{e ∈ E(G)} σ_x σ_y)` of a configuration.

articles.title: Log-partition sequence of independent copies
articles.statement: The sequence `log Z_n` for `n` independent copies.

articles.title: Pressure from independent copies
articles.statement: The pressure: the limit of `log Z_n / n` for independent copies, obtained from subadditivity.

articles.title: Outer vertex boundary of a box
articles.statement: The outer vertex boundary `Λ_{n+1} ∖ Λ_n` of the box.

articles.title: Partition function of a finite system
articles.statement: The partition function `Z(β) = ∑_s e^{-βE(s)}` of a finite system.

articles.title: Partition function of independent copies
articles.statement: The partition function of `n` independent copies of the system.
